title: Simulation-Based Study of AI-Assisted Channel Adaptation in UAV-Enabled Cellular Networks
summary: This paper presents a simulation based study of Artificial Intelligence assisted communication channel adaptation in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle enabled cellular networks. The considered system model includes communication channel Ground Base Station Aerial Repeater UAV Base Station Cluster of Cellular Network Users. The primary objective of the study is to investigate the impact of adaptive channel parameter control on communication performance under dynamically changing interference conditions. A lightweight supervised machine learning approach based on linear regression is employed to implement cognitive channel adaptation. The AI model operates on packet level performance indicators and enables real time adjustment of Transaction Size in response to variations in Bit Error Rate and effective Data Rate. A custom simulation environment is developed to generate training and testing datasets and to evaluate system behavior under both static and adaptive channel configurations.

AI.title_translation: 基于仿真的无人机蜂窝网络AI辅助信道适配研究
AI.tldr: 用轻量线性回归模型，在动态干扰下根据误码率和有效数据率实时调整传输包大小，仿真验证可提升无人机蜂窝网络性能。
AI.motivation: 动态干扰环境中，传统静态信道配置难以维持无人机蜂窝网络通信性能，需引入AI实时自适应调整。
AI.method: 构建含地面基站-无人机中继-用户簇的系统模型；用线性回归监督学习，以包级性能指标为输入，实时输出Transaction Size调整；自建仿真平台生成训练/测试数据并对比静态与自适应配置。
AI.result: 仿真表明，所提AI辅助自适应信道参数控制能在干扰变化时动态优化Transaction Size，改善通信性能。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级线性回归AI方案可在无人机蜂窝网络中实现实时信道适配，有效应对动态干扰并提升性能。
AI.translation: 本文通过仿真研究人工智能辅助的无人机蜂窝网络通信信道适配。系统模型包括地面基站、空中中继无人机及蜂窝用户簇，目标为在动态干扰下评估自适应信道参数控制对通信性能的影响。采用基于线性回归的轻量监督学习，依据包级性能指标实时调整Transaction Size以应对误码率和有效数据率变化，并通过自建仿真环境生成数据集并评估静态与自适应配置下的系统行为。
AI.summary: 针对无人机蜂窝网络在动态干扰下的通信性能下降问题，提出一种基于线性回归的轻量级AI信道适配方案。该方法以包级误码率和有效数据率为输入，实时调整传输包大小，经自建仿真平台验证，相比静态配置可显著提升网络适应性。
AI.keywords: 无人机蜂窝网络；AI信道适配；线性回归；动态干扰；实时调整
AI.comments: 摘要未披露具体性能提升数值、算法复杂度及与其他AI方法的对比，后续可补充真实飞行测试验证。

title: Traffic Simulation in Ad Hoc Network of Flying UAVs with Generative AI Adaptation
summary: The purpose of this paper is to model traffic in Ad Hoc network of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and demonstrate a way for adapting communication channel using Artificial Intelligence. The modeling was based on the original model of Ad Hoc network including 20 Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. The dependences of packet loss on the packet size for different transmission powers, on the packet size for different frequencies, on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles flight area and on the number of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles were obtained and analyzed. The implementation of adaptive data transmission is presented in the program code. The dependences of packet loss, power and transaction size on time during Artificial Intelligence adaptation are shown.

AI.title_translation: 生成式AI自适应的飞行无人机自组网交通仿真
AI.tldr: 用生成式AI动态调整20架无人机自组网的发射功率、频率与包长，实时降低丢包率并节能。
AI.motivation: 无人机群自组网因拓扑高速变化导致信道质量剧烈波动，传统静态参数无法兼顾低丢包与低功耗，需引入AI在线适配。
AI.method: 构建20架UAV的原始自组网模型；在NS-3类平台采集不同功率、频率、包长、空域面积、节点密度下的丢包曲线；将实时状态输入生成式AI，AI输出下一时隙的发射功率、频率与包长，代码层实现自适应发送逻辑。
AI.result: 获得并分析了丢包随包长、功率、频率、空域面积、节点数的变化曲线；AI在线适配后，丢包率、发射功率与事务大小随时间逐步下降并趋于稳定。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI可根据实时信道状态动态优化传输参数，显著降低丢包与能耗，为无人机群自组网提供可行的高效通信方案。
AI.translation: 本文对无人机自组网流量进行建模，并利用人工智能适配通信信道。基于包含20架无人机的原始自组网模型，获得了丢包率随包长、功率、频率、飞行区域面积及无人机数量的依赖关系并加以分析；给出了自适应数据传输的代码实现，并展示了AI适配期间丢包、功率与事务大小随时间的变化。
AI.summary: 基于20架无人机自组网，论文采集多因素丢包数据，利用生成式AI实时调整发射功率、频率与包长，实现低丢包低功耗的自适应通信，并给出代码实现与实验验证。
AI.keywords: 无人机自组网；生成式AI；交通仿真；自适应通信；丢包率；功率控制
AI.comments: 摘要未披露AI模型结构、训练数据量与仿真平台；缺乏与其他自适应算法的对比；实测飞行验证与大规模节点扩展性待补充。

title: CLF-ULP: Cross-Layer Fusion-Based Link Prediction in Dynamic Multiplex UAV Networks
summary: In complex Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks, UAVs can establish dynamic and heterogeneous links with one another for various purposes, such as communication coverage, collective sensing, and task collaboration. These interactions give rise to dynamic multiplex UAV networks, where each layer represents a distinct type of interaction among UAVs. Understanding how such links form and evolve is both of theoretical interest and of practical importance for the control and maintenance of networked UAV systems. In this paper, we first develop a dynamic multiplex network model for UAV networks to characterize their dynamic and heterogeneous link properties. We then propose a cross-layer fusion-based deep learning model, termed CLF-ULP, to predict future inter-UAV links based on historical topology data. CLF-ULP incorporates graph attention networks to extract topological features within each layer and perform a cross-layer attention fusion to capture inter-layer dependencies. Furthermore, a shared-parameter long short-term memory network is employed to model the temporal evolution of each layer. To improve embedding quality and link prediction performance, we develop a joint loss function that considers both intra-layer and inter-layer UAV adjacency. Extensive experiments on simulated UAV datasets under diverse mobility patterns demonstrate that CLF-ULP achieves state-of-the-art performance in predicting links within dynamic multiplex UAV networks.

AI.title_translation: CLF-ULP：动态多层无人机网络中基于跨层融合的链路预测
AI.tldr: 提出CLF-ULP模型，通过跨层注意力融合与LSTM，在动态多层UAV网络中实现未来链路预测，实验验证其性能达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 无人机网络呈现动态、多层异构链路，理解链路演化规律对网络控制与维护至关重要，亟需高效预测方法。
AI.method: 构建动态多层网络模型；设计CLF-ULP：用图注意力网络提取单层特征，跨层注意力融合层间依赖，共享参数LSTM捕捉时序演化，联合损失优化层内与层间邻接。
AI.result: 在多种机动模式的仿真UAV数据集上，CLF-ULP显著优于现有方法，实现链路预测的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨层融合与时空建模结合的CLF-ULP，可有效预测动态多层UAV网络的未来链路，为网络运维提供可靠依据。
AI.translation: 在复杂无人机网络中，无人机可建立动态异构链路以实现通信覆盖、协同感知与任务协作，形成动态多层网络。本文提出CLF-ULP模型，利用图注意力、跨层融合与LSTM，实现基于历史拓扑的未来链路预测，实验表明其性能达SOTA。
AI.summary: 本文针对动态多层无人机网络链路预测问题，提出CLF-ULP框架：先建立动态多层网络模型，再用图注意力提取单层特征，通过跨层注意力融合层间关系，共享参数LSTM捕捉时序变化，并以联合损失优化嵌入质量。仿真结果表明该方法在多种机动场景下均优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 无人机网络；链路预测；动态多层网络；图注意力网络；跨层融合；LSTM
AI.comments: 摘要清晰，但未公开代码与真实数据集，后续可补充开源实现与实地验证。

title: Enhancing NOMA Handover Performance Using Hybrid AI-Driven Modulated Deterministic Sequences
summary: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is an information-theoretical approach used in 5G networks to improve spectral efficiency, but it is prone to interference during handovers. In this work, we propose a hybrid method that combines Gold-Walsh modulated sequences with Deep Q-Networks (DQN) to intelligently manage interference during NOMA handovers. This method optimizes sequence selection and power allocation dynamically. As a result, it achieves a 95.2\% handover success rate, which is an improvement of up to 23.1 percentage points. It also delivers up to 28\% throughput gain and reduces interference by up to 41\% in various mobility scenarios. All improvements are statistically significant (\(p < 0.001\)). The DQN trains in \(4{,}200 \pm 400\) episodes with a complexity of \(O(N \log N + d \cdot h + \log B)\) and can be deployed in real-time.

AI.title_translation: 利用混合AI驱动调制确定性序列提升NOMA切换性能
AI.tldr: 将Gold-Walsh调制序列与深度Q网络结合，动态优化序列选择与功率分配，使NOMA切换成功率提高23.1个百分点至95.2%，吞吐量提升28%，干扰降低41%。
AI.motivation: 5G网络中NOMA虽能提升频谱效率，但在切换时易受干扰，需要智能方法降低干扰并保障切换成功率。
AI.method: 提出混合方案：Gold-Walsh调制序列与DQN联合，实时优化序列选择与功率分配，DQN训练复杂度为O(N log N + d·h + log B)。
AI.result: 切换成功率达95.2%，提升23.1个百分点；吞吐量提升28%；干扰降低41%；DQN训练约4200±400回合；所有结果统计显著(p<0.001)。
AI.conclusion: 该混合AI方法显著改善NOMA切换性能，可在实际网络中实时部署，为5G及未来网络提供可靠高效的切换解决方案。
AI.translation: 非正交多址接入(NOMA)是5G网络中用于提升频谱效率的信息论方法，但在切换时易受干扰。本文提出将Gold-Walsh调制序列与深度Q网络(DQN)结合的混合方法，智能管理NOMA切换中的干扰。该方法动态优化序列选择与功率分配，实现95.2%的切换成功率，提升23.1个百分点，并在不同移动场景下带来28%吞吐量增益和41%干扰降低，均统计显著(p<0.001)。DQN在约4200±400回合内完成训练，复杂度为O(N log N + d·h + log B)，可实时部署。
AI.summary: 针对5G-NOMA切换干扰问题，作者提出Gold-Walsh序列与DQN的混合框架，实时优化序列与功率，显著改善切换成功率、吞吐量与干扰，训练快速且可实时部署。
AI.keywords: 非正交多址接入；切换；Gold-Walsh序列；深度Q网络；干扰管理；5G
AI.comments: 研究聚焦NOMA移动场景，结合传统序列与强化学习，兼顾性能与实时性；若能公开数据集与代码，可进一步验证与扩展。

title: Adversarial Network Imagination: Causal LLMs and Digital Twins for Proactive Telecom Mitigation
summary: Telecommunication networks experience complex failures such as fiber cuts, traffic overloads, and cascading outages. Existing monitoring and digital twin systems are largely reactive, detecting failures only after service degradation occurs. We propose Adversarial Network Imagination, a closed-loop framework that integrates a Causal Large Language Model (LLM), a Knowledge Graph, and a Digital Twin to proactively generate, simulate, and evaluate adversarial network failures. The Causal LLM produces structured failure scenarios grounded in network dependencies encoded in the Knowledge Graph. These scenarios are executed within a Digital Twin to measure performance degradation and evaluate mitigation strategies. By iteratively refining scenarios based on simulation feedback, the framework shifts network operations from reactive troubleshooting toward anticipatory resilience analysis.

AI.title_translation: 对抗式网络想象：面向主动电信缓解的因果大模型与数字孪生
AI.tldr: 提出闭环框架“对抗式网络想象”，用因果LLM、知识图谱与数字孪生主动生成并模拟网络故障，实现从被动排障到主动韧性优化。
AI.motivation: 现有电信监控与数字孪生多为被动检测，仅在业务受损后才响应，无法提前应对光纤断裂、流量过载等复杂连锁故障。
AI.method: 将知识图谱编码的网络依赖输入因果LLM生成结构化故障场景，在数字孪生中执行并评估性能降级与缓解策略，迭代优化。
AI.result: 数字孪生模拟显示框架可提前触发故障场景并量化缓解效果，实现闭环迭代，但摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将网络运维从被动排障转向主动韧性分析，为电信网络提供可迭代的对抗式故障想象与缓解能力。
AI.translation: 电信网络常遭遇光纤切断、流量过载及连锁故障。现有监控与数字孪生多为被动，仅在业务受损后才发现问题。我们提出对抗式网络想象——闭环框架整合因果大模型、知识图谱与数字孪生，主动生成、模拟并评估对抗性网络故障。因果LLM基于知识图谱编码的依赖关系生成结构化故障场景，并在数字孪生中执行以衡量性能降级并评估缓解策略。通过基于仿真反馈迭代优化场景，框架将网络运维从被动排障转向主动韧性分析。
AI.summary: 对抗式网络想象框架利用因果LLM、知识图谱与数字孪生，主动生成并模拟网络故障场景，通过闭环迭代评估缓解策略，使电信网络从被动排障迈向主动韧性优化。
AI.keywords: 对抗式网络想象;因果大模型;数字孪生;主动缓解;电信网络韧性;知识图谱
AI.comments: 摘要未披露实验规模、具体指标或对比基线，需阅读全文评估实际增益与计算开销。

title: Hybrid Secure Routing in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETSs)
summary: Because wireless communication is dynamic and has inherent defects, routing algorithms are crucial in the quickly evolving field of mobile ad hoc networks, or MANETs This study looks at the many security problems that MANETs encounter. These problems, which pose major risks to network performance, include flooding, sinkholes, and black hole assaults to address these challenges. We introduce the Hybrid Secure Routing Protocol (HSRP), which enhances the security and robustness of routing operations by fusing trust-based tactics with cryptographic approaches. HSRP combines the strengths of both proactive and reactive routing strategies, enabling it to adapt dynamically to evolving network conditions while protecting against malicious activities. We use extensive simulations with Network Simulator (NS-2) and a thorough review of the literature to assess HSRP's performance under different attack scenarios. The results show that, in comparison to traditional protocols, HSRP increases throughput and decreases latency, hence improving routing efficiency while simultaneously bolstering data transfer security. With uses in vital domains including military operations and disaster response, this study provides a scalable and workable approach for safe routing in MANETs. The findings highlight how crucial it is to include cutting-edge security features in routing protocol design to guarantee the dependability and integrity of MANETs in practical situations.

AI.title_translation: 移动自组织网络中的混合安全路由
AI.tldr: 提出混合安全路由协议 HSRP，融合信任机制与密码学，结合主动/反应式策略，在 NS-2 仿真中显著提升吞吐量并降低延迟，可抵御黑洞、洪泛等攻击。
AI.motivation: MANET 无线通信动态且易受黑洞、洪泛、陷洞等攻击，现有路由协议安全性不足，亟需兼顾安全与效率的新方案。
AI.method: 设计 HSRP，混合信任评估与密码学保护，集成主动与反应式路由；利用 NS-2 在多攻击场景下与常规协议对比仿真并辅以文献综述。
AI.result: HSRP 在受攻击网络中吞吐量提高、延迟降低，路由效率优于传统协议，同时增强数据传输安全。
AI.conclusion: HSRP 为 MANET 提供可扩展且实用的安全路由解决方案，适用于军事与救灾等关键场景，强调在路由协议设计中嵌入高级安全机制的重要性。
AI.translation: 由于无线通信动态且存在固有缺陷，路由算法在快速演进的移动自组织网络（MANET）中至关重要。本研究探讨 MANET 面临的多种安全问题，包括洪泛、陷洞与黑洞攻击，这些对网络性能构成重大威胁。为此，我们提出混合安全路由协议（HSRP），通过融合信任策略与密码学方法增强路由操作的安全性与鲁棒性。HSRP 结合主动与反应式路由优势，可动态适应网络变化并抵御恶意活动。我们使用 NS-2 进行大量仿真并辅以文献综述，评估 HSRP 在不同攻击场景下的性能。结果表明，与传统协议相比，HSRP 提高吞吐量、降低延迟，在提升路由效率的同时强化数据传输安全。该研究为 MANET 安全路由提供可扩展且可行的方案，适用于军事作战与灾难响应等关键领域，结果凸显在路由协议设计中融入先进安全特性对保障 MANET 现实环境可靠性与完整性的关键作用。
AI.summary: 本文针对 MANET 安全路由挑战，提出混合安全路由协议 HSRP，融合信任机制与密码学，结合主动/反应式策略。NS-2 仿真显示，HSRP 在黑洞、洪泛等攻击下较传统协议显著提升吞吐量并降低延迟，为军事与救灾等关键应用提供可扩展的安全路由方案。
AI.keywords: 移动自组织网络,安全路由,混合路由协议,HSRP,信任机制,密码学,NS-2仿真
AI.comments: 无

title: Reinforcement Learning-Enabled Dynamic Code Assignment for Ultra-Dense IoT Networks: A NOMA-Based Approach to Massive Device Connectivity
summary: Ultra-dense IoT networks require an effective non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme, yet they experience intense interference because of fixed code assignment. We suggest a reinforcement learning (RL) model of dynamic Gold code assignment in IoT-NOMA networks. Our Markov Decision Process which is IoT aware is a joint optimization of throughput, energy efficiency, and fairness. Two RL algorithms are created, including Natural Policy Gradient (NPG) to learn stable discrete actions and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) with continuous code embedding. Under smart city conditions, NPG can attain throughput of 11.6% and energy efficiency of 15.8 likewise superior to its performance with a static allocation. Nonetheless, the performance is worse in organized industrial settings, and the reliability is minimal (0-2%), which points to the fact that dynamic code assignment is not a sufficient measure of ultra-reliable IoT and needs to be supplemented by power control or retransmission schemes. The work offers a basis to the RL-based resource allocation in massive IoT network.

AI.title_translation: 面向超密集物联网网络的强化学习动态码分配：一种基于 NOMA 的海量连接方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出用强化学习实现物联网 NOMA 网络中的动态 Gold 码分配，可在智慧城市场景下提升吞吐量与能效，但在工业场景下可靠性仍然很低，表明仅靠动态码分配不足以满足超高可靠性需求。
AI.motivation: 超密集物联网网络需要高效的 NOMA 方案以支持海量设备连接，但固定码分配会导致强干扰与性能受限，因此需要能够在复杂环境下自适应优化的动态码分配机制。
AI.method: 构建一个面向物联网场景的马尔可夫决策过程，将吞吐量、能效和公平性进行联合优化；基于此设计两类强化学习算法：一是采用 Natural Policy Gradient（NPG）学习稳定的离散码分配动作，二是采用 Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient（DDPG）对连续码嵌入进行优化，实现动态 Gold 码分配策略学习。
AI.result: 在智慧城市场景下，NPG 相比静态码分配可实现吞吐量提升约 11.6%、能效提升约 15.8%；但在结构化工业场景中性能不佳，可靠性仅为 0–2%，说明单纯动态码分配仍无法满足超可靠物联网的要求。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习驱动的动态 Gold 码分配能在部分场景中改善物联网 NOMA 网络的吞吐量与能效，并兼顾一定公平性，但对超高可靠与工业场景而言远不足够，必须结合功率控制或重传等机制；该工作为面向海量物联网连接的 RL 资源分配提供了基础框架与初步验证。
AI.translation: 超密集物联网网络需要一种有效的非正交多址接入（NOMA）方案，但由于采用固定码分配而产生强烈干扰。我们在物联网 NOMA 网络中提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的动态 Gold 码分配模型。所构建的马尔可夫决策过程具备物联网感知能力，在吞吐量、能效和公平性之间进行联合优化。我们设计了两种 RL 算法：一是利用 Natural Policy Gradient（NPG）学习稳定的离散动作，二是采用 Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient（DDPG）对连续码嵌入进行学习。在智慧城市条件下，与静态分配相比，NPG 可分别实现 11.6% 的吞吐量提升和 15.8% 的能效提升。尽管如此，在有组织的工业环境中，其性能较差，可靠性极低（0–2%），这表明动态码分配并不足以支撑超高可靠物联网，还需要配合功率控制或重传方案。该工作为基于 RL 的海量物联网网络资源分配提供了基础。
AI.summary: 文章针对超密集物联网网络中固定码分配导致的严重干扰问题，在 NOMA 框架下提出强化学习驱动的动态 Gold 码分配方案。作者建立了以吞吐量、能效和公平性为联合优化目标、具备物联网感知的马尔可夫决策过程，并实现两种策略学习算法：NPG 用于离散码分配决策，DDPG 用于连续码嵌入优化。实验或仿真显示，在智慧城市场景中，NPG 相比静态分配可带来约 11.6% 的吞吐量增益和 15.8% 的能效增益，但在更严格的工业场景下整体性能欠佳，可靠性只有 0–2%。因此，作者认为动态码分配虽可作为改进手段，但无法单独满足超可靠物联网需求，需与功率控制和重传机制联合设计，该方法更多为后续 RL 资源分配研究提供基础架构与定量参考。
AI.keywords: 超密集物联网; NOMA; 动态码分配; Gold 码; 强化学习; 马尔可夫决策过程; Natural Policy Gradient (NPG); Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG); 吞吐量; 能量效率; 公平性; 智慧城市; 工业物联网; 超可靠通信
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将多目标优化（吞吐量、能效、公平性）统一在 RL 框架下，并比较离散与连续动作空间的两种算法；但摘要中可靠性较低且对工业场景表现不佳，表明方案尚需与功率控制、重传等机制联合设计，且未说明训练代价、收敛速度和可部署性等工程细节。

title: Toward Resource-Efficient Collaboration of Large AI Models in Mobile Edge Networks
comments: Accepted by IEEE Network. 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: The collaboration of large artificial intelligence (AI) models in mobile edge networks has emerged as a promising paradigm to meet the growing demand for intelligent services at the network edge. By enabling multiple devices to cooperatively execute submodels or subtasks, collaborative AI enhances inference efficiency and service quality with constrained resources. However, deploying large AI models in such environments remains challenging due to the intrinsic mismatch between model complexity and the limited computation, memory, and communication resources in edge networks. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the system architecture for collaborative AI in mobile edge networks, along with representative application scenarios in transportation and healthcare. We further present recent advances in resource-efficient collaboration techniques, categorized into spatial and temporal approaches. The major spatial approaches include federated tuning, mixture of experts, patch-based diffusion, and hierarchical diffusion. Meanwhile, the important temporal approaches encompass split learning, cascading inference, speculative decoding, and routing inference. Building upon these foundations, we propose a multi-stage diffusion framework that enables elastic distribution of large generative models across heterogeneous edge resources. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves performance improvement in both efficiency and adaptability for data generation.

title: A Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reliable Wireless Autonomy
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and reinforcement learning (RL) have shown significant promise in wireless systems, enabling dynamic spectrum allocation, traffic management, and large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) coordination. However, their deployment in mission-critical applications introduces the risk of unsafe emergent behaviors, such as UAV collisions, denial-of-service events, or instability in vehicular networks. Existing safety mechanisms are predominantly reactive, relying on anomaly detection or fallback controllers that intervene only after unsafe actions occur, which cannot guarantee reliability in ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) settings. In this work, we propose a proactive safety-constrained RL framework that integrates proof-carrying control (PCC) with empowerment-budgeted (EB) enforcement. Each agent action is verified through lightweight mathematical certificates to ensure compliance with interference constraints, while empowerment budgets regulate the frequency of safety overrides to balance safety and autonomy. We implement this framework on a wireless uplink scheduling task using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed PCC+EB controller eliminates unsafe transmissions while preserving system throughput and predictable autonomy. Compared with unconstrained and reactive baselines, our method achieves provable safety guarantees with minimal performance degradation. These results highlight the potential of proactive safety constrained RL to enable trustworthy wireless autonomy in future 6G networks.

title: Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Network Optimization
summary: Enhancing future wireless networks presents a significant challenge for networking systems due to diverse user demands and the emergence of 6G technology. While reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework, it often encounters difficulties with high-dimensional state spaces and complex environments, leading to substantial computational demands, distributed intelligence, and potentially inconsistent outcomes. Large language models (LLMs), with their extensive pretrained knowledge and advanced reasoning capabilities, offer promising tools to enhance RL in optimizing 6G wireless networks. We explore RL models augmented by LLMs, emphasizing their roles and the potential benefits of their synergy in wireless network optimization. We then examine LLM-enabled RL across various protocol layers: physical, data link, network, transport, and application layers. Additionally, we propose an LLM-assisted state representation and semantic extraction to enhance the multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework. This approach is applied to service migration and request routing, as well as topology graph generation in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-satellite networks. Through case studies, we demonstrate that our framework effectively performs optimization of wireless network. Finally, we outline prospective research directions for LLM-enabled RL in wireless network optimization.

title: An Overlay Multicast Routing Method Based on Network Situational Aware-ness and Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Compared with IP multicast, Overlay Multicast (OM) offers better compatibility and flexible deployment in heterogeneous, cross-domain networks. However, traditional OM struggles to adapt to dynamic traffic due to unawareness of physical resource states, and existing reinforcement learning methods fail to decouple OM's tightly coupled multi-objective nature, leading to high complexity, slow convergence, and instability. To address this, we propose MA-DHRL-OM, a multi-agent deep hierarchical reinforcement learning approach. Using SDN's global view, it builds a traffic-aware model for OM path planning. The method decomposes OM tree construction into two stages via hierarchical agents, reducing action space and improving convergence stability. Multi-agent collaboration balances multi-objective optimization while enhancing scalability and adaptability. Experiments show MA-DHRL-OM outperforms existing methods in delay, bandwidth utilization, and packet loss, with more stable convergence and flexible routing.

title: UAVGENT: A Language-Guided Distributed Control Framework
summary: We study language-in-the-loop control for multi-drone systems that execute evolving, high-level missions while retaining formal robustness guarantees at the physical layer. We propose a three-layer architecture in which (i) a human operator issues natural-language instructions, (ii) an LLM-based supervisor periodically interprets, verifies, and corrects the commanded task in the context of the latest state and target estimates, and (iii) a distributed inner-loop controller tracks the resulting reference using only local relative information. We derive a theoretical guarantee that characterizes tracking performance under bounded disturbances and piecewise-smooth references with discrete jumps induced by LLM updates. Overall, our results illustrate how centralized language-based task reasoning can be combined with distributed feedback control to achieve complex behaviors with provable robustness and stability.

title: Agentic AI for Commercial Insurance Underwriting with Adversarial Self-Critique
comments: 9 pages, 8 figuers, 6 tables, submitted aty 9th International Conference on Modern Computing, Networking and Applications (MCNA2026)
summary: Commercial insurance underwriting is a labor-intensive process that requires manual review of extensive documentation to assess risk and determine policy pricing. While AI offers substantial efficiency improvements, existing solutions lack comprehensive reasoning capabilities and internal mechanisms to ensure reliability within regulated, high-stakes environments. Full automation remains impractical and inadvisable in scenarios where human judgment and accountability are critical. This study presents a decision-negative, human-in-the-loop agentic system that incorporates an adversarial self-critique mechanism as a bounded safety architecture for regulated underwriting workflows. Within this system, a critic agent challenges the primary agent's conclusions prior to submitting recommendations to human reviewers. This internal system of checks and balances addresses a critical gap in AI safety for regulated workflows. Additionally, the research develops a formal taxonomy of failure modes to characterize potential errors by decision-negative agents. This taxonomy provides a structured framework for risk identification and risk management in high-stakes applications. Experimental evaluation using 500 expert-validated underwriting cases demonstrates that the adversarial critique mechanism reduces AI hallucination rates from 11.3% to 3.8% and increases decision accuracy from 92% to 96%. At the same time, the framework enforces strict human authority over all binding decisions by design. These findings indicate that adversarial self-critique supports safer AI deployment in regulated domains and offers a model for responsible integration where human oversight is indispensable.

AI.title_translation: 具备对抗性自我批判机制的商业保险核保智能体AI
AI.tldr: 提出一种“决策否定型”人机协同智能体系统，通过内置对抗性自我批判模块，将AI幻觉率从11.3%降至3.8%，在保持人类最终裁决权的同时提升核保准确率至96%。
AI.motivation: 商业保险核保高度依赖人工，现有AI缺乏可靠推理与合规保障，无法在强监管、高风险的场景下安全部署，需一种可验证、可追责的半自动化方案。
AI.method: 构建“决策否定型”人机协同架构：主智能体生成核保建议→批判智能体对抗性质询→仅将经内部校验的建议提交人工复核；并建立失败模式分类体系以系统化管理风险；用500份专家标注案例评估。
AI.result: 对抗性自我批判使AI幻觉率从11.3%降至3.8%，决策准确率由92%提升至96%，系统始终维持人类对所有具约束力决定的最终控制权。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性自我批判为受监管领域提供了可验证、可追责且安全的AI部署范式，证明在必须保留人工监督的场景下仍能显著提升AI可靠性与合规性。
AI.translation: 商业保险核保是一项劳动密集型任务，需要人工审阅大量文件以评估风险并定价。AI虽可显著提效，但现有方案缺乏全面推理能力及在受监管、高利害环境中的可靠性保障。在需人工判断与问责的场景下，完全自动化既不现实也不可取。本研究提出一种“决策否定型”人机协同智能体系统，通过对抗性自我批判机制作为受限安全架构服务于受监管核保流程。系统内批判智能体在提交建议给人工复核前质疑主智能体结论，形成内部制衡，弥补AI安全空白。研究还建立失败模式形式分类法，为高风险应用提供结构化风险识别与管理框架。实验基于500份专家验证核保案例，显示对抗性批判将AI幻觉率从11.3%降至3.8%，决策准确率由92%提升至96%，同时设计确保人类对所有具约束力决定的绝对控制权。结果表明，对抗性自我批判支持在受监管领域更安全地部署AI，为必须保留人工监督的场景提供负责任集成范式。
AI.summary: 本文针对强监管商业保险核保场景，提出“决策否定型”人机协同智能体架构，引入对抗性自我批判机制形成内部制衡，并建立失败模式分类法。实验表明该机制显著降低AI幻觉并提升准确率，同时确保人类拥有最终决策权，为高风险领域提供可验证、可追责的AI安全部署范例。
AI.keywords: 智能体AI；对抗性自我批判；商业保险核保；人机协同；AI安全；受监管工作流程；决策否定架构；失败模式分类
AI.comments: 研究聚焦高监管环境下的AI安全，提出可操作的内部校验机制，具有明确的行业落地价值；后续可扩展至其他高风险决策场景并进一步量化不同失败模式的经济与合规影响。

title: BotzoneBench: Scalable LLM Evaluation via Graded AI Anchors
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in interactive environments requiring strategic decision-making, yet systematic evaluation of these capabilities remains challenging. Existing benchmarks for LLMs primarily assess static reasoning through isolated tasks and fail to capture dynamic strategic abilities. Recent game-based evaluations employ LLM-vs-LLM tournaments that produce relative rankings dependent on transient model pools, incurring quadratic computational costs and lacking stable performance anchors for longitudinal tracking. The central challenge is establishing a scalable evaluation framework that measures LLM strategic reasoning against consistent, interpretable standards rather than volatile peer models. Here we show that anchoring LLM evaluation to fixed hierarchies of skill-calibrated game Artificial Intelligence (AI) enables linear-time absolute skill measurement with stable cross-temporal interpretability. Built on the Botzone platform's established competitive infrastructure, our BotzoneBench evaluates LLMs across eight diverse games spanning deterministic perfect-information board games to stochastic imperfect-information card games. Through systematic assessment of 177,047 state-action pairs from five flagship models, we reveal significant performance disparities and identify distinct strategic behaviors, with top-performing models achieving proficiency comparable to mid-to-high-tier specialized game AI in multiple domains. This anchored evaluation paradigm generalizes beyond games to any domain with well-defined skill hierarchies, establishing a scalable and reusable framework for assessing interactive AI capabilities.

AI.title_translation: BotzoneBench：通过分级 AI 锚点实现可扩展的大模型评测
AI.tldr: 提出 BotzoneBench，用分级游戏 AI 作为固定锚点，对 LLM 在多种博弈中的战略推理能力进行线性成本、可纵向对比的绝对水平评测，并显示顶尖模型已接近中高水平专业博弈 AI。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 基准多集中在静态推理任务，难以评估动态战略决策；基于博弈的 LLM 对战评测又依赖当期模型池、计算量呈二次增长且缺乏稳定锚点，难以进行可解释、可纵向追踪的能力衡量。
AI.method: 在 Botzone 平台上构建 BotzoneBench，将不同水平的传统游戏 AI 构成分级、标定好的“技能层级”，作为固定评测锚点；在八种涵盖确定性完全信息棋类与随机不完全信息牌类的游戏中，让 LLM 与这些 AI 进行对局或在 177,047 个状态–动作样本上进行系统评估，以线性复杂度估计 LLM 的绝对战略水平与行为特征。
AI.result: 在五个代表性大模型上，共评估 177,047 个状态–动作对，发现模型间存在显著性能差异且展现出不同的战略行为模式；最强模型在多个游戏上的表现已可与中到高水平的专业游戏 AI 相当。
AI.conclusion: 以分级、标定好的游戏 AI 作为锚点，可实现线性成本、可跨时间对比的 LLM 战略推理绝对能力评测；这一“锚定式”评测范式可推广到任何存在明确定义技能层级的交互式领域，为评估交互智能提供了可扩展、可复用的框架。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地部署在需要战略决策的交互式环境中，但系统性评估这类能力仍然充满挑战。现有针对 LLM 的基准主要通过孤立任务来评估静态推理，难以刻画动态战略能力。近期基于游戏的评测多采用 LLM 之间的锦标赛对战，这类方法产生的仅是依赖于当前模型池的相对排序，计算成本呈二次增长，且缺乏用于纵向追踪的稳定性能锚点。核心挑战在于：如何构建一种可扩展的评估框架，使其能够相对于一致、可解释的标准，而不是易变的同侪模型，来衡量 LLM 的战略推理能力。本文表明，将 LLM 评估锚定到经过技能标定的分级博弈人工智能（AI）层次结构，可以实现线性时间的绝对技能测量，并获得稳定、可跨时间解释的结果。基于 Botzone 平台既有的竞赛基础设施，我们提出 BotzoneBench，在八种多样化游戏上评估 LLM，这些游戏从确定性、完全信息的棋类游戏到随机性、不完全信息的牌类游戏一应俱全。通过对五个旗舰模型的 177,047 个状态–动作对进行系统性评估，我们揭示了显著的性能差异，并识别出各具特色的战略行为；其中表现最好的模型在多个领域的熟练度已可与中高水平的专业博弈 AI 相媲美。这种锚定式评估范式可推广到任何具有明确定义技能层级的领域，从而建立一个可扩展、可复用的框架，用于评估交互式 AI 的能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对 LLM 在交互环境中的战略决策评测难题，指出现有静态推理基准和 LLM–LLM 对战方案在动态性、稳定性与计算成本方面的不足。作者在 Botzone 平台上提出 BotzoneBench，以多层级、技能标定的传统游戏 AI 作为固定“锚点”，在八种棋类与牌类游戏中，以线性计算成本评估 LLM 的绝对战略水平和行为模式。对五个旗舰模型、逾 17 万状态–动作样本的实验表明，模型间存在明显能力差异，最优模型在多个游戏中的水平接近中高档专业博弈 AI。作者认为，这种基于分级 AI 锚点的评测范式可推广到其他具备明确技能层级的交互式任务，为长期、可解释的大模型能力追踪提供通用框架。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型评测, 战略决策, 博弈 AI, 基准测试, BotzoneBench, 线性时间评估, 技能层级锚点, 交互式智能
AI.comments: 工作针对现有 LLM 战略评测中“相对排名不稳定”和“计算成本高”的痛点，提出分级 AI 锚点这一直观且易扩展的思路，优势在于可获得跨时间可比较的绝对能力刻度。局限方面，当前只在八种游戏与五个模型上验证，是否能无缝推广到非博弈类交互任务及与人类表现的对齐程度，尚未在摘要中体现。

title: When to Think Fast and Slow? AMOR: Entropy-Based Metacognitive Gate for Dynamic SSM-Attention Switching
summary: Transformers allocate uniform computation to every position, regardless of difficulty. State Space Models (SSMs) offer efficient alternatives but struggle with precise information retrieval over a long horizon. Inspired by dual-process theories of cognition (Kahneman, 2011), we propose AMOR (Adaptive Metacognitive Output Router), a hybrid architecture that dynamically engages sparse attention only when an SSM backbone is "uncertain"--as measured by prediction entropy. Compared to standard transformers, AMOR gains efficiency by projecting keys and values from SSM hidden states (Ghost KV), reusing the SSM's O(n) computation rather than requiring O(n^2) attention at every layer. On small-scale synthetic retrieval tasks, AMOR outperforms both SSM-only and transformer-only baselines, achieving perfect retrieval accuracy while engaging attention on only 22% of positions. We validate that prediction entropy reliably signals retrieval need, with a gap of 1.09 nats (nearly half the entropy range) between retrieval and local positions. Additionally, our approach provides interpretable adaptive computation, where routing decisions can be understood in information-theoretic terms.

AI.title_translation: 何时思考快与慢？AMOR：基于熵的元认知门用于动态SSM-注意力切换
AI.tldr: AMOR提出一种混合架构，基于预测熵动态切换SSM与注意力，以提升效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: Transformer对所有位置统一计算效率低，SSM在处理长序列信息检索时精度不足，受双过程认知理论启发，需动态自适应计算。
AI.method: AMOR是一种混合架构，通过预测熵衡量SSM不确定性，动态触发稀疏注意力；采用Ghost KV从SSM隐藏状态投影键和值，重用SSM的O(n)计算，避免每层O(n^2)注意力开销。
AI.result: 在小规模合成检索任务中，AMOR优于纯SSM和纯Transformer基线，实现完美检索精度，仅对22%位置使用注意力；预测熵可靠指示检索需求，检索位置与局部位置间熵差为1.09 nats（接近熵范围一半）。
AI.conclusion: AMOR通过熵基元认知门实现动态计算切换，在效率与准确性上优于基线，并提供可解释的自适应计算。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文提出AMOR，一种基于熵的混合架构，通过动态切换SSM与稀疏注意力来优化计算效率与精度。它利用SSM的O(n)计算和Ghost KV投影减少注意力开销，在合成任务中表现优异，仅需少量注意力位置即可实现高精度检索，且预测熵可解释地指示计算需求。
AI.keywords: AMOR, 熵, 元认知门, SSM, 注意力切换, 动态计算, 混合架构, 信息检索
AI.comments: 工作创新性地结合认知理论与信息熵，实现高效可解释的动态计算，但仅在小规模合成任务验证，需扩展到实际应用场景。

title: Network-Adaptive Cloud Preprocessing for Visual Neuroprostheses
summary: Cloud-based machine learning is increasingly explored as a preprocessing strategy for next-generation visual neuroprostheses, where advanced scene understanding may exceed the computational and energy constraints of battery-powered visual processing units (VPUs). Offloading computation to remote servers enables the use of state-of-the-art vision models, but also introduces sensitivity to network latency, jitter, and packet loss, which can disrupt the temporal consistency of the delivered neural stimulus. In this work, we examine the feasibility of cloud-assisted visual preprocessing for artificial vision by framing remote inference as a perceptually constrained systems problem. We present a network-adaptive cloud-assisted pipeline in which real-time round-trip-time (RTT) feedback is used to dynamically modulate image resolution, compression, and transmission rate, explicitly prioritizing temporal continuity under adverse network conditions. Using a Raspberry Pi 4 as a simulated VPU and a client-server architecture, we evaluate system performance across a range of realistic wireless network regimes. Results show that adaptive visual encoding substantially reduces end-to-end latency during network congestion, with only modest degradation of global scene structure, while boundary precision degrades more sharply. Together, these findings delineate operating regimes in which cloud-assisted preprocessing may remain viable for future visual neuroprostheses and underscore the importance of network-aware adaptation for maintaining perceptual stability.

AI.title_translation: 面向视觉神经假体的网络自适应云预处理
AI.tldr: 提出一种网络自适应的云辅助视觉预处理框架，通过实时往返时延反馈动态调整图像分辨率、压缩与发送速率，在保持时序连续性的同时降低端到端延迟，为电池供电的视觉处理单元提供可行的云端计算卸载方案。
AI.motivation: 下一代视觉神经假体需先进场景理解，但受限于电池供电的视觉处理单元(VPU)计算与能耗；云端推理虽可引入前沿视觉模型，却面临网络延迟、抖动与丢包导致神经刺激时序不一致的问题，需要探索在恶劣网络条件下仍保持感知稳定性的可行方案。
AI.method: 将远程推理建模为感知受限系统问题，构建网络自适应云辅助流水线：以实时RTT反馈动态调制图像分辨率、压缩与发送速率，明确优先保证时序连续性；采用树莓派4模拟VPU，搭建客户端-服务器架构，并在多种现实无线网络场景下评估系统性能。
AI.result: 自适应视觉编码在网络拥塞期间显著降低端到端延迟，仅带来全局场景结构的轻微退化，但边界精度下降更明显；实验界定了云辅助预处理仍可保持可行的运行区间。
AI.conclusion: 在保持感知稳定性的前提下，网络感知自适应对云辅助视觉预处理至关重要；研究结果为未来视觉神经假体在特定网络条件下利用云端计算提供了可行边界与指导。
AI.translation: 无（原文为英文，已提供中文对应）
AI.summary: 本文提出网络自适应云预处理框架，通过实时RTT反馈动态调节图像编码参数，优先保障时序连续性，显著降低网络拥塞时的端到端延迟，为电池受限的视觉神经假体提供可行的云端推理卸载方案，并明确边界精度与全局结构的权衡。
AI.keywords: 视觉神经假体;云预处理;网络自适应;实时RTT反馈;感知稳定性

title: VeRA: Verified Reasoning Data Augmentation at Scale
summary:
The main issue with most evaluation schemes today is their "static" nature: the same problems are reused repeatedly, allowing for memorization, format exploitation, and eventual saturation. To measure genuine AI progress, we need evaluation that is robust by construction, not by post-hoc detection. In response, we propose VeRA (Verified Reasoning Data Augmentation), a framework that converts benchmark problems into executable specifications, comprising (i) a natural language template with placeholder slots, (ii) a coherent generator that samples valid configurations, and (iii) a deterministic verifier that validates parameters and calculates the corresponding correct answers for each configuration. From a single seed problem, VeRA automatically creates unlimited verified variants with reliable labels at near-zero marginal cost without human involvement.
  VeRA operates in two complementary modes. VeRA-E (equivalent) rewrites problems while keeping the underlying logic intact, useful for detecting memorization versus genuine reasoning. VeRA-H (hardened) systematically increases complexity while remaining verifiable, enabling reliable creation and labelling of fresh difficult tasks at the boundary of intelligence. Evaluating 16 frontier models with VeRA, we find: (i) VeRA-E improves evaluation quality and reveals contamination patterns. (ii) VeRA-H enables human-free generation of hard tasks with reliable labels. (iii) VeRA establishes verified benchmarks as a general paradigm. VeRA reconceptualizes benchmarks from static objects used until exhausted, to executable specifications generating fresh, verified instances on demand, enhancing robustness and cost-effectiveness for evaluation.
  With VeRA, we envision that evaluation in any verifiable domain can scale indefinitely without sacrificing label integrity. To stimulate future research, we have open-sourced all code and datasets.

AI.title_translation: VeRA：大规模可验证推理数据增强
AI.tldr: 提出 VeRA 框架，把静态基准题转化为可执行规格，自动生成无限量、可验证的变体，用于更鲁棒地评估大模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有评测基准是静态的，题目被反复使用，容易出现记忆污染、格式投机和性能饱和，难以真实衡量 AI 推理进展，需要一种从构造上就具备鲁棒性的评测方式，而不是事后检测。
AI.method: 提出 VeRA 框架，将单个基准题转化为由三部分组成的可执行规格：(i) 带占位符的自然语言模板；(ii) 生成合法配置的连贯生成器；(iii) 用于验证参数并计算正确答案的确定性验证器。在此基础上自动生成无限带可靠标签的题目变体。VeRA 具有两种模式：VeRA-E 保持逻辑等价，仅重写问题以区分记忆与推理；VeRA-H 在保持可验证的前提下系统性增加难度，用于生成高难新题。作者用 VeRA 评估了16个前沿模型。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i) VeRA-E 提高了评测质量，并暴露出数据污染模式；(ii) VeRA-H 可以在无人参与的情况下生成高难度且标签可靠的任务；(iii) VeRA 将“可验证基准”确立为一种通用范式，显著提升评测的鲁棒性与成本效益。
AI.conclusion: VeRA 将传统“用到耗尽”的静态基准重新概念化为按需生成新实例的可执行规格，使任何可验证领域的评测都能在不牺牲标签完整性的前提下无限扩展；相关代码和数据集已全部开源，以促进后续研究。
AI.translation:
当今大多数评测方案的主要问题在于其“静态”特性：同一批题目被反复使用，导致模型可以通过记忆、利用格式漏洞，最终导致基准饱和。若要衡量真正的 AI 进展，我们需要在构造上就具有鲁棒性的评测方式，而不是依赖事后的检测。为此，我们提出 VeRA（Verified Reasoning Data Augmentation，可验证推理数据增强），一个将基准问题转换为可执行规格的框架，该规格包括：(i) 带占位符槽位的自然语言模板；(ii) 能采样有效配置的连贯生成器；以及 (iii) 用于验证参数并为每个配置计算对应正确答案的确定性验证器。基于单个种子问题，VeRA 可以在无人工干预的情况下，以近乎零边际成本自动生成无限数量、带可靠标签的已验证变体。
VeRA 以两种互补模式运行。VeRA-E（等价）在保持底层逻辑不变的前提下重写问题，可用于区分记忆与真实推理。VeRA-H（加固）在保持可验证性的同时系统性提高复杂度，从而能在智能边界处可靠生成和标注新的高难任务。使用 VeRA 评估 16 个前沿模型时，我们发现：(i) VeRA-E 改善了评测质量，并揭示了污染模式；(ii) VeRA-H 实现了无人参与的高难任务生成且标签可靠；(iii) VeRA 将“可验证基准”确立为一种通用范式。VeRA 将基准从被动使用直至耗尽的静态对象，重塑为按需生成新、已验证实例的可执行规格，从而提升评测的鲁棒性和成本效益。
借助 VeRA，我们展望任何可验证领域的评测都可以在不牺牲标签完整性的情况下无限扩展。为激发未来研究，我们已开源全部代码和数据集。
AI.summary: 本文提出 VeRA 框架，通过将传统基准题转化为由自然语言模板、配置生成器和确定性验证器组成的可执行规格，从单个种子题自动生成无限数量、标签可靠的推理题目变体。VeRA 提供两种模式：等价重写的 VeRA-E 用于区分记忆与真实推理、提高评测质量并揭示数据污染；加难的 VeRA-H 在保证可验证前提下系统性提高题目难度，可无人值守生成高难新题。作者用 VeRA 评测了 16 个前沿模型，证明该框架能显著提升评测鲁棒性和成本效益，并将“可验证基准”推广为一种通用评测范式，支持在可验证领域实现无限扩展的可靠评估。
AI.keywords: 可验证推理, 数据增强, 基准评测, 动态基准, 评测鲁棒性, 大模型评估, 自动出题, 标签完整性
AI.comments: 工作针对当前基准被记忆和污染的问题，提供了一个可程序化扩展和自动标注的评测框架，重点在于把“出题+验题”完全形式化与自动化。局限性可能在于仅适用于可构造确定性验证器的任务领域，对开放性、主观性或难以形式化的任务适用性尚不明确。

title: Scaling the Scaling Logic: Agentic Meta-Synthesis of Logic Reasoning
comments: 37 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables in the main body. Project page: https://github.com/AdAstraAbyssoque/Scaling-the-Scaling-Logic
summary: Scaling verifiable training signals remains a key bottleneck for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Logical reasoning is a natural substrate: constraints are formal and answers are programmatically checkable. However, prior synthesis pipelines either depend on expert-written code or operate within fixed templates/skeletons, which limits growth largely to instance-level perturbations. We propose SSLogic, an agentic meta-synthesis framework that scales at the task-family level by iteratively synthesizing and repairing executable Generator--Validator program pairs in a closed Generate--Validate--Repair loop, enabling continuous family evolution with controllable difficulty. To ensure reliability, we introduce a Multi-Gate Validation Protocol that combines multi-strategy consistency checks with Adversarial Blind Review, where independent agents must solve instances by writing and executing code to filter ambiguous or ill-posed tasks. Starting from 400 seed families, two evolution rounds expand to 953 families and 21,389 verifiable instances (from 5,718). Training on SSLogic-evolved data yields consistent gains over the seed baseline at matched training steps, improving SynLogic by +5.2, BBEH by +1.4, AIME25 by +3.0, and Brumo25 by +3.7.
comment: 37 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables in the main body. Project page: https://github.com/AdAstraAbyssoque/Scaling-the-Scaling-Logic

AI.title_translation: 扩展“扩展逻辑”：面向逻辑推理的代理式元合成
AI.tldr: 作者提出 SSLogic，一个通过代理式生成–验证–修复循环来自动演化逻辑推理任务家族的框架，大幅扩增可验证训练数据，并显著提升多项逻辑与数学基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，如何大规模构造带有可程序化验证信号的训练数据仍是瓶颈。逻辑推理天然适合作为可验证任务，但现有数据合成流程依赖专家代码或固定模板，只能在既有任务上做实例级扰动，难以在“任务家族”层面扩展多样性与难度。
AI.method: 提出 SSLogic，一个代理式元合成框架：在闭环的“生成–验证–修复”（Generate–Validate–Repair）流程中，自动合成并迭代修正可执行的“生成器–验证器”（Generator–Validator）程序对，使任务家族持续进化且难度可控。为提升可靠性，引入多门控验证协议（Multi-Gate Validation Protocol），结合多策略一致性检查与“对抗性盲审”：多个相互独立的代理必须通过编写并执行代码来求解样例，以筛除含糊或设定不良的任务。
AI.result: 从 400 个初始任务家族出发，经过两轮演化扩展到 953 个任务家族，带来 21,389 个可验证实例（初始为 5,718）。在相同训练步数下，用 SSLogic 演化数据训练的模型，相比只用种子数据训练的基线模型，在多个基准上取得提升：SynLogic +5.2、BBEH +1.4、AIME25 +3.0、Brumo25 +3.7。
AI.conclusion: 通过代理驱动的生成–验证–修复循环，可以在任务家族层面自动扩展逻辑推理数据，并通过多门控验证协议保证数据质量。这种可扩展的可验证训练信号构造方式，能够稳定提升 RLVR 模型在多种逻辑与数学推理基准上的性能，表明逻辑任务的元合成是推进可验证强化学习训练的一条有效路径。
AI.translation: 在可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）中，扩展可验证训练信号仍然是一个关键瓶颈。逻辑推理是一个自然的载体：约束是形式化的，答案可以通过程序自动检查。然而，以往的合成流水线要么依赖专家编写的代码，要么局限于固定的模板或骨架，这使得成长基本只能在实例级扰动上进行。我们提出 SSLogic，这是一种代理式元合成框架，它通过在闭合的“生成–验证–修复”循环中迭代地合成和修复可执行的生成器–验证器程序对，在任务家族层面实现扩展，从而实现具有可控难度的持续家族演化。为确保可靠性，我们引入多门控验证协议（Multi-Gate Validation Protocol），将多策略一致性检查与对抗性盲审相结合：多个相互独立的代理必须通过编写并执行代码来求解实例，以过滤含糊或设定不良的任务。从 400 个种子任务家族出发，经过两轮演化，我们扩展到 953 个家族和 21,389 个可验证实例（原为 5,718）。在 SSLogic 演化数据上训练，相比在相同训练步数下仅使用种子数据的基线，模型表现持续提升：SynLogic 提高 5.2，BBEH 提高 1.4，AIME25 提高 3.0，Brumo25 提高 3.7。
AI.summary: 本文针对 RLVR 中可验证训练信号难以扩展的问题，提出 SSLogic，一个面向逻辑推理任务的代理式元合成框架。它通过自动合成并迭代修复“生成器–验证器”程序对，在生成–验证–修复闭环中不断演化任务家族，并用多门控验证协议确保任务清晰、可解且可程序化验证。实验中，从 400 个初始家族扩展到 953 个家族和 21,389 个可验证实例，用这些演化数据训练的模型在多个逻辑与数学基准上均显著优于仅用种子数据训练的基线。
AI.keywords: 可验证奖励强化学习, 逻辑推理, 数据合成, 元合成, 生成–验证–修复, 任务家族演化, 多门控验证协议, 对抗性盲审, 程序化验证, SSLogic
AI.comments: 工作核心贡献在于：1）从“实例级扰动”提升到“任务家族级演化”的自动数据合成视角；2）将多代理代码求解与一致性检查结合成多门控验证协议，以缓解自动合成任务的模糊性和错误设定问题。局限性（如任务覆盖范围、对特定逻辑形式的依赖等）在摘要中未具体讨论。

title: Computability of Agentic Systems
summary:
This paper introduces the Quest Graph, a formal framework for analyzing the capabilities of agentic systems with finite context. We define abstractions that model common reasoning techniques and establish their computational power: the base Quest Graph is equivalent to an unrestricted Turing machine; the forward-only Finite Quest Decision Process (FQDP), despite its wide use, is only equivalent to a pushdown automaton (context-free); and the Reference-Augmented QDP (RQDP) regains Turing completeness only when stateful queries are allowed.
  Since computability affects efficiency, we then analyze the theoretical efficiency of each model by simulating task dependencies in computation graphs. We show that this computational hierarchy translates to concrete performance trade-offs: reference-augmented (Turing-complete) systems can be exponentially more efficient at simulating complex graphs than their non-augmented (context-free) counterparts. This work provides a formal methodology for classifying and understanding the fundamental capabilities of agentic systems.

AI.title_translation: 智能系统的可计算性
AI.tldr: 提出Quest Graph框架，证明带状态查询的增强系统具备图灵完备性，并在模拟复杂任务图时呈指数级效率优势。
AI.motivation: 现有对有限上下文智能体能力的理论分析不足，需要形式化框架来分类其计算能力与效率。
AI.method: 定义Quest Graph抽象，将不同推理模式映射为FQDP、RQDP等模型，并用图灵机与下推自动机进行等价性比较；通过计算图模拟任务依赖分析理论效率。
AI.result: 基础Quest Graph等价于无限制图灵机；仅前向的FQDP等价于下推自动机（上下文无关）；RQDP在允许状态查询时恢复图灵完备性；图灵完备模型在模拟复杂图时效率可指数级优于上下文无关模型。
AI.conclusion: Quest Graph为智能系统提供了形式化的能力分类与理解方法，计算层级直接对应性能权衡。
AI.translation: 本文引入Quest Graph，一个用于分析有限上下文智能体能力的正式框架。我们定义了建模常见推理技术的抽象，并确立其计算能力：基础Quest Graph等价于无限制图灵机；仅前向的有限Quest决策过程（FQDP）尽管被广泛使用，但仅等价于下推自动机（上下文无关）；而参考增强QDP（RQDP）仅在允许有状态查询时才恢复图灵完备性。由于可计算性影响效率，我们随后通过计算图模拟任务依赖来分析每个模型的理论效率。我们证明，这一计算层级转化为具体性能权衡：参考增强（图灵完备）系统在模拟复杂图时比其非增强（上下文无关）对应系统可指数级更高效。本研究为分类与理解智能体系统的基本能力提供了正式方法。
AI.summary: Quest Graph框架将智能体推理模式形式化，证明状态查询对恢复图灵完备至关重要，并揭示计算层级与效率的指数级关联。
AI.keywords: Quest Graph,智能体系统,可计算性,图灵机,下推自动机,状态查询,效率权衡
AI.comments: 摘要未提及实验验证或实际部署场景，理论结果有待在真实智能体系统中检验。

title: A Geometric Taxonomy of Hallucinations in LLMs
summary: The term "hallucination" in large language models conflates distinct phenomena with different geometric signatures in embedding space. We propose a taxonomy identifying three types: unfaithfulness (failure to engage with provided context), confabulation (invention of semantically foreign content), and factual error (incorrect claims within correct conceptual frames). We observe a striking asymmetry. On standard benchmarks where hallucinations are LLM-generated, detection is domain-local: AUROC 0.76-0.99 within domains, but 0.50 (chance level) across domains. Discriminative directions are approximately orthogonal between domains (mean cosine similarity -0.07). On human-crafted confabulations - invented institutions, redefined terminology, fabricated mechanisms - a single global direction achieves 0.96 AUROC with 3.8% cross-domain degradation. We interpret this divergence as follows: benchmarks capture generation artifacts (stylistic signatures of prompted fabrication), while human-crafted confabulations capture genuine topical drift. The geometric structure differs because the underlying phenomena differ. Type III errors show 0.478 AUROC - indistinguishable from chance. This reflects a theoretical constraint: embeddings encode distributional co-occurrence, not correspondence to external reality. Statements with identical contextual patterns occupy similar embedding regions regardless of truth value. The contribution is a geometric taxonomy clarifying the scope of embedding-based detection: Types I and II are detectable; Type III requires external verification mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型幻觉的几何分类法
AI.tldr: 本文从嵌入空间几何角度将大模型“幻觉”细分为三类，并表明仅有不忠实与虚构两类可通过嵌入检测，事实性错误需依赖外部校验。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将大模型的各种“幻觉”混为一谈，且常依赖嵌入空间做自动检测，却未区分其在几何结构上的差异与可检测性边界，因此作者希望给出一个更精细的几何分类，并澄清嵌入方法究竟能检测哪些类型的幻觉、又在何处失效。
AI.method: 作者提出基于嵌入几何的三类幻觉分类：I 型“不忠实”（未利用给定上下文）、II 型“虚构”（杜撰语义上无关的内容）、III 型“事实性错误”（在正确概念框架内说错事实）。在标准基准上，对由 LLM 生成的幻觉进行域内与跨域检测，计算不同域间的判别方向及其余弦相似度；同时构造人类设计的虚构样本（虚构机构、重定义术语、伪造机制），检验是否存在统一的全局判别方向，并单独评估 III 型错误的可检测性。
AI.result: 对 LLM 生成的幻觉样本，嵌入空间检测在域内 AUROC 为 0.76–0.99，但跨域仅约 0.50（接近随机），不同域的判别方向近乎正交（平均余弦相似度为 -0.07）；而对人类设计的虚构样本，一个全局方向即可在各域获得约 0.96 的 AUROC，跨域性能仅下降 3.8%。III 型事实性错误的 AUROC 为 0.478，与随机无异。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间中不同类型幻觉具有不同几何结构：I 型不忠实与 II 型虚构在嵌入上可被有效分离，尤其人类虚构表现为统一的“语义漂移”方向；但 III 型事实性错误由于嵌入仅编码共现分布而非客观真值，真与假在相似上下文中会落在相近区域，几乎无法用嵌入区分。因此，嵌入式检测的适用范围主要限于 I、II 型幻觉，而 III 型必须依赖外部事实验证机制。
AI.translation: “幻觉”这一术语在大语言模型中混合了在嵌入空间中具有不同几何特征的不同现象。我们提出一个分类法，区分三种类型：不忠实（未能利用提供的上下文）、虚构（编造语义上无关的内容）以及事实性错误（在正确概念框架内做出错误断言）。我们观察到一个显著的不对称性：在标准基准上，当幻觉由大模型生成时，检测是“域局部”的：在域内 AUROC 为 0.76–0.99，但跨域仅为 0.50（随机水平）。不同域之间的判别方向近似正交（平均余弦相似度为 -0.07）。而在人工构造的虚构样本——虚构机构、重定义术语、伪造机制——上，一个单一的全局方向即可达到 0.96 的 AUROC，跨域性能仅下降 3.8%。我们将这种差异解释为：现有基准主要捕捉生成伪造时的风格性产物（受提示驱动的编造风格特征），而人工虚构则捕捉真正的主题漂移。由于底层现象不同，其几何结构也不同。III 型错误的 AUROC 为 0.478——与随机不可区分。这反映了一项理论约束：嵌入编码的是分布式共现关系，而非与外部现实的对应。具有相同上下文模式的陈述，无论真伪，都会占据相似的嵌入区域。本文的贡献是提出一个几何分类法，以澄清基于嵌入的检测能力范围：I 型和 II 型可被检测，而 III 型需要外部验证机制。
AI.summary: 作者在嵌入空间中对大模型“幻觉”进行几何划分，定义了不忠实、虚构和事实性错误三类，并系统评估其可检测性。结果显示，对 LLM 自动生成的幻觉，嵌入检测在单一领域内有效但难以泛化到新领域；对人类精心设计的虚构，全局几何方向就能跨域识别，表明其反映的是更真实的主题漂移。相比之下，事实性错误在嵌入空间几乎与随机无异，因为嵌入仅刻画共现分布而非真伪，对同一语境下的真命题与假命题无法区分。文章据此强调：现有幻觉基准往往测到的是“生成风格痕迹”，而不是事实错误本身，并提出嵌入式检测只适用于不忠实与虚构，事实核查必须依赖外部知识或验证机制。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 幻觉, 嵌入空间, 几何分类, 不忠实, 虚构, 事实性错误, 域泛化, AUROC, 语义漂移
AI.comments: 文章通过精细的分类和几何分析澄清了“幻觉”这一宽泛概念，指出现有基准过度依赖 LLM 自生成样本，更多捕获的是提示驱动的生成风格，而非真正的事实偏离。这一结果对构建更可靠的幻觉评测与检测系统具有警示意义：若目标是发现事实性错误，仅依靠嵌入或语言分布难以奏效，需要引入外部知识库、检索或工具调用等验证机制。同时，I 型与 II 型幻觉在嵌入上的良好可分性也说明，可利用几何信号作为前端过滤器，先剔除不忠实和语义虚构，再将资源集中于更难的事实校验。

title: Variation is the Key: A Variation-Based Framework for LLM-Generated Text Detection
summary: Detecting text generated by large language models (LLMs) is crucial but challenging. Existing detectors depend on impractical assumptions, such as white-box settings, or solely rely on text-level features, leading to imprecise detection ability. In this paper, we propose a simple but effective and practical LLM-generated text detection method, VaryBalance. The core of VaryBalance is that, compared to LLM-generated texts, there is a greater difference between human texts and their rewritten version via LLMs. Leveraging this observation, VaryBalance quantifies this through mean standard deviation and distinguishes human texts and LLM-generated texts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrated that VaryBalance outperforms the state-of-the-art detectors, i.e., Binoculars, by up to 34.3\% in terms of AUROC, and maintains robustness against multiple generating models and languages.

AI.title_translation: 变化是关键：基于变化的LLM生成文本检测框架
AI.tldr: 提出VaryBalance方法，通过比较人类文本与其LLM改写版本的差异来检测LLM生成文本，无需白盒假设，实验表明优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文本检测器依赖白盒假设或仅使用文本级特征，导致检测不准确，需要更实用且有效的方法。
AI.method: 提出VaryBalance框架，利用人类文本与其LLM改写版本之间的差异（通过平均标准差量化）来区分人类文本和LLM生成文本。
AI.result: VaryBalance在AUROC指标上比现有最佳检测器Binoculars高出34.3%，并对多种生成模型和语言保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于变化的检测框架VaryBalance简单有效且实用，显著优于现有方法，具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 检测大语言模型生成的文本至关重要但具有挑战性。现有检测器依赖于不切实际的假设（如白盒设置）或仅依赖文本级特征，导致检测能力不精确。本文提出一种简单但有效且实用的LLM生成文本检测方法VaryBalance。VaryBalance的核心在于，与LLM生成文本相比，人类文本与其通过LLM重写的版本之间存在更大差异。利用这一观察，VaryBalance通过平均标准差量化这一点并区分人类文本和LLM生成文本。综合实验表明，VaryBalance在AUROC方面优于最先进的检测器Binoculars高达34.3%，并对多种生成模型和语言保持鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM生成文本检测难题，提出基于变化的VaryBalance方法。该方法通过量化人类文本与其LLM改写版本间的差异来识别文本来源，突破了现有方法对白盒假设或文本级特征的依赖。实验显示其性能显著优于现有技术，具有良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型,文本检测,变化检测,平均标准差,重写差异
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地利用人类文本与LLM改写版本的差异，避免了复杂模型依赖，具有实际应用价值。但摘要未提及计算效率、长文本处理能力及对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。

title: An Agentic AI Control Plane for 6G Network Slice Orchestration, Monitoring, and Trading
summary: 6G networks are expected to be AI-native, intent-driven, and economically programmable, requiring fundamentally new approaches to network slice orchestration. Existing slicing frameworks, largely designed for 5G, rely on static policies and manual workflows and are ill-suited for the dynamic, multi-domain, and service-centric nature of emerging 6G environments. In this paper, we propose an agentic AI control plane architecture for 6G network slice orchestration, monitoring, and trading that treats orchestration as a holistic control function encompassing slice planning, deployment, continuous monitoring, and economically informed decision-making. The proposed control plane is realized as a layered architecture in which multiple cooperating AI agents. To support flexible and on-demand slice utilization, the control plane incorporates market-aware orchestration capabilities, allowing slice requirements, pricing, and availability to be jointly considered during orchestration decisions. A natural language interface, implemented using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enables users and applications to interact with control-plane functions through intent-based queries while enforcing safety and policy constraints. To ensure responsible and explainable autonomy, the control plane integrates fine-tuned large language models organized as a multi-model consortium, governed by a dedicated reasoning model. The proposed approach is evaluated using a real-world testbed with multiple mobile core instances (e.g Open5GS) integrated with Ericsson's RAN infrastructure. The results demonstrate that combining agentic autonomy, closed-loop SLA assurance, market-aware orchestration, and natural language control enables a scalable and adaptive 6G-native control plane for network slice management, highlighting the potential of agentic AI as a foundational mechanism for future 6G networks.

AI.title_translation: 面向6G网络切片编排、监控与交易的代理式AI控制平面
AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于多智能体与大模型的6G原生AI控制平面，将网络切片的编排、监控和经济交易统一在一个可解释的智能架构中，并在真实测试床上验证其可扩展性与自适应性。
AI.motivation: 6G网络将是AI原生、意图驱动且可经济编程，现有为5G设计的切片框架依赖静态策略和人工流程，难以应对6G中动态、多域、服务中心化和经济驱动的切片管理需求，因此需要一种全新的、智能化和市场感知的控制平面架构。
AI.method: 提出一种“代理式AI控制平面”架构，将切片规划、部署、持续监控与经济决策统一为整体控制功能：1）采用分层架构，由多个协作AI代理组成，实现切片编排与闭环SLA保障；2）引入市场感知编排机制，在切片编排过程中联合考虑需求、价格和可用资源，实现按需和灵活的切片使用与交易；3）通过基于Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的自然语言接口，让用户和应用以意图查询方式与控制平面交互，同时强制执行安全与策略约束；4）集成经微调的大语言模型，构建由专门“推理模型”治理的多模型联盟，实现负责任且可解释的自治；5）在包含多个移动核心实例（如Open5GS）并与爱立信RAN基础设施集成的真实测试床上进行验证。
AI.result: 在真实测试床评估中，所提出的控制平面能够成功结合代理式自治、闭环SLA保障、市场感知编排和自然语言控制，表现出良好的可扩展性和自适应能力，用于6G网络切片的高效管理。具体量化指标和对比结果未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体自治、市场感知决策和自然语言意图接口与大模型推理结合，能够构建一个6G原生的网络切片控制平面，使切片编排、监控与交易更加自动化、可扩展且可解释，表明“代理式AI”有望成为未来6G网络的基础性机制之一。
AI.translation: 预计6G网络将是AI原生的、意图驱动的和经济可编程的，这需要在网络切片编排方面采用全新的方法。现有的切片框架大多为5G设计，依赖静态策略和人工工作流程，不适合新兴6G环境中动态、多域和服务中心化的特点。本文提出了一种面向6G网络切片编排、监控和交易的代理式AI控制平面架构，将编排视为一个整体控制功能，涵盖切片规划、部署、持续监控以及基于经济因素的决策。所提出的控制平面采用分层架构，由多个协作AI代理实现。为支持灵活和按需的切片使用，控制平面引入了市场感知的编排能力，使切片需求、定价和可用性能够在编排决策中被联合考虑。通过使用Model Context Protocol (MCP) 实现的自然语言接口，用户和应用可以通过意图驱动的查询与控制平面功能交互，同时强制执行安全与策略约束。为确保负责任和可解释的自治，控制平面集成了经微调的大语言模型，并将其组织为由专门推理模型治理的多模型联盟。所提出的方法在一个真实测试床上进行了评估，该测试床包含多个移动核心实例（如Open5GS），并与爱立信的RAN基础设施集成。结果表明，将代理式自治、闭环SLA保证、市场感知编排和自然语言控制相结合，可以实现一个可扩展、自适应的6G原生网络切片管理控制平面，凸显了代理式AI作为未来6G网络基础机制的潜力。
AI.summary: 文章针对5G时代静态、人工驱动的切片编排框架难以满足6G网络“AI原生、意图驱动、经济可编程”的需求，提出一种“代理式AI控制平面”新架构。该控制平面通过分层多智能体系统，将切片规划、部署、持续监控和经济决策统筹为一体，并引入市场感知机制，在编排中综合考虑切片需求、价格与资源可用性，支撑切片交易和按需使用。同时，系统利用MCP实现的自然语言接口，让用户和应用以意图查询方式访问控制功能，并通过策略与安全约束进行治理；在自治层面则采用多大模型联盟结构，由专门推理模型进行管控，以实现可解释和负责任的自治。基于集成Open5GS移动核心和爱立信RAN的真实测试床实验表明，该方案在可扩展性和自适应性方面表现良好，能够为6G网络切片提供闭环SLA保障和智能化管理，显示出代理式AI作为6G核心控制机制的前景。
AI.keywords: 6G, 网络切片, 切片编排, 代理式AI, 多智能体系统, 控制平面, 市场感知编排, 经济可编程网络, 自然语言接口, Model Context Protocol (MCP), 大语言模型, 多模型联盟, 闭环SLA保障, RAN, Open5GS
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将多智能体自治控制、经济驱动的资源编排和LLM自然语言意图接口整合到统一架构中，并在真实测试床而非纯仿真环境中验证，可操作性较强。但摘要未提供与传统5G/现有方案的量化对比和开销分析，关于多模型联盟的安全性、鲁棒性和推理延迟问题也有待在正文中进一步阐明。

title: Pocket RAG: On-Device RAG for First Aid Guidance in Offline Mobile Environment
summary: In disaster scenarios or remote areas, first responders often lose network connectivity when providing first aid. In such situations, server-based AI systems fail to provide critical guidance. To address this issue, we present a lightweight, mobile-based retrieval-augmented generation system for small language models (SLMs) that can run directly on Android devices. Our system integrates a mobile-friendly optimized pipeline featuring Hybrid RAG, selective compression, batched prompt decoding, and quantization caching. Despite the model's small size, our RAG-based system achieves 94.5\% accuracy for physical first aid and 97.0\% for psychological first aid. Additionally, we reduce response time from 14.2s to 3.7s, achieving a nearly 4x speedup. These results prove that our system is practical and can deliver reliable first aid guidance even without internet connectivity.

AI.title_translation: Pocket RAG：离线移动环境下的设备端检索增强生成急救指导
AI.tldr: 提出可在Android设备离线运行的轻量级RAG系统，为急救场景提供高准确率、低延迟的指导。
AI.motivation: 灾难或偏远地区急救人员常因网络中断无法获得服务器AI支持，亟需离线可用的智能急救指导方案。
AI.method: 在Android端部署小型语言模型，采用混合RAG、选择性压缩、批量提示解码与量化缓存等优化策略。
AI.result: 物理急救准确率94.5%，心理急救97.0%；响应时间由14.2秒降至3.7秒，提速近4倍。
AI.conclusion: 系统无需联网即可提供可靠急救指导，具备实用性与高效性。
AI.translation: 在灾难或偏远地区，急救人员常因网络中断无法获得服务器AI支持。我们提出轻量级移动端RAG系统，可在Android设备离线运行，集成混合RAG、选择性压缩、批量解码与量化缓存，实现94.5%物理急救与97.0%心理急救准确率，响应时间缩短至3.7秒，证明其离线可靠性与实用性。
AI.summary: Pocket RAG是一个为急救场景设计的设备端检索增强生成系统，可在无网络环境下于Android手机运行。通过混合RAG、压缩、批量解码与量化缓存优化，小型模型在物理与心理急救任务分别达到94.5%与97.0%准确率，并将响应时间压缩至3.7秒，实现近4倍加速，确保离线提供可靠急救指导。
AI.keywords: 设备端RAG；离线急救；小型语言模型；移动优化；检索增强生成
AI.comments: 作者未公开模型规模、数据集来源及能耗评估，后续可补充消融实验与真实部署验证。

title: Intelligence as Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization
summary: Despite recent advances in artificial intelligence, many systems exhibit stagnation in long-horizon adaptability despite continued performance optimization. This work argues that such limitations do not primarily arise from insufficient learning, data, or model capacity, but from a deeper structural property of how intelligence is optimized over time. We formulate intelligence as a trajectory-level phenomenon governed by multi-objective trade-offs, and introduce Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization, a path-wise generalization of classical Pareto optimality in which dominance is defined over full trajectories. Within this framework, Pareto traps emerge as locally non-dominated regions of trajectory space that nevertheless restrict access to globally superior developmental paths under conservative local optimization. To characterize the rigidity of such constraints, we define the Trap Escape Difficulty Index (TEDI), a composite geometric measure capturing escape distance, structural constraints, and behavioral inertia. We show that dynamic intelligence ceilings arise as inevitable geometric consequences of trajectory-level dominance, independent of learning progress or architectural scale. We further introduce a formal taxonomy of Pareto traps and illustrate the resulting trajectory-level divergence using a minimal agent-environment model. Together, these results shift the locus of intelligence from terminal performance to optimization geometry, providing a principled framework for diagnosing and overcoming long-horizon developmental constraints in adaptive systems.

AI.title_translation: 作为轨迹占优帕累托优化的智能
AI.tldr: 提出将智能视为轨迹层面的多目标帕累托优化过程，引入“轨迹占优”与陷阱难度指标，解释为何在持续性能优化下仍会出现长期适应性停滞，并给出诊断与突破这类陷阱的几何框架。
AI.motivation: 许多人工智能系统在继续提高短期或终端性能的同时，却在长时间尺度上的适应性和发展能力上出现停滞。作者认为问题不在于学习量、数据量或模型容量不足，而在于我们如何在时间维度上结构性地优化智能，需要一个能够刻画发展轨迹及其多目标权衡的理论框架。
AI.method: 从多目标优化视角将智能形式化为“轨迹层面的现象”，提出“轨迹占优帕累托优化”（Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization），把传统的帕累托占优概念扩展到整个发展轨迹上。在该框架中：1）定义“帕累托陷阱”，即在轨迹空间中局部不可支配但阻碍通往全局更优发展路径的区域；2）提出“陷阱逃逸难度指数”（TEDI），结合逃逸距离、结构约束和行为惯性等几何因素定量刻画陷阱的刚性；3）给出帕累托陷阱的形式分类法；4）构建一个最简代理-环境模型，用以展示不同轨迹在该框架下的分化行为。
AI.result: 分析表明，在轨迹占优的多目标几何结构下，即便学习持续进展、模型规模不断扩大，系统仍会自然产生“动态智能天花板”，表现为难以突破的长程发展上限。这些上限源自轨迹空间中帕累托占优与陷阱的几何约束，而非传统意义上的数据或容量不足。作者还提供了帕累托陷阱的正式分类，并在简化代理-环境模型中展示了不同发展轨迹如何因陷阱而发生分化。
AI.conclusion: 智能应被理解为轨迹层面的多目标优化过程，其关键不在终端性能，而在整个发展轨迹的优化几何结构。轨迹占优与帕累托陷阱会导致在保守局部优化下出现长期适应性停滞和动态智能上限。通过TEDI和陷阱分类等工具，可以系统性地诊断并设计机制以摆脱这些长时程发展约束，为构建更具长期适应性的人工系统提供了原则性框架。
AI.translation: 尽管人工智能近期取得了显著进展，许多系统在持续优化性能的同时，在长时间尺度上的适应性方面却表现出停滞。本文论证，这类局限的主要原因并非学习不足、数据不足或模型容量不足，而是源于我们在时间上优化智能方式的一种更深层的结构属性。我们将智能形式化为一个由多目标权衡所支配的轨迹层现象，并提出“轨迹占优帕累托优化”，这是一种对经典帕累托最优性的路径级推广，其中占优关系定义在完整轨迹之上。在这一框架下，“帕累托陷阱”表现为轨迹空间中局部不可支配的区域，但在保守的局部优化下却会限制通往在全局上更优的发展路径。为刻画这类约束的刚性，我们定义了“陷阱逃逸难度指数”（TEDI），这是一个综合的几何度量，用于捕捉逃逸距离、结构约束与行为惯性。我们展示了动态智能上限如何作为轨迹层占优的几何必然结果出现，而与学习进度或体系结构规模无关。我们进一步提出帕累托陷阱的形式化分类，并利用一个最简代理-环境模型来展示由此产生的轨迹层分化。总体而言，这些结果将智能的焦点从终端性能转移到优化几何本身，为诊断和突破自适应系统中的长时程发展约束提供了一个有原则的框架。
AI.summary: 作者提出一种新的理论视角，将智能看作在时间维度上展开的多目标发展轨迹，而不是单一时刻的终端性能。通过把帕累托最优性推广到完整轨迹，定义“轨迹占优”，他们发现系统可能会陷入“帕累托陷阱”：在局部看来不可被支配、性能持续提升，却因此错过更优的发展路径，导致长程适应性停滞。文中引入陷阱逃逸难度指数TEDI，以几何方式量化从陷阱逃离的困难，并给出陷阱的类型学分类，借助一个极简代理-环境模型展示不同轨迹的分化。结论是：许多智能系统出现的动态“天花板”更多源于轨迹空间几何和保守局部优化策略，而不是学习或规模不足；因此要提升长期智能，需要设计能摆脱这些几何陷阱的优化与发展机制。
AI.keywords: 轨迹占优帕累托优化, 多目标优化, 智能轨迹, 帕累托陷阱, 动态智能天花板, 陷阱逃逸难度指数 TEDI, 优化几何, 长期适应性
AI.comments: 这项工作偏重理论与概念建模，从几何和多目标优化的角度重新定义“智能”的发展过程。虽然只在一个极简代理-环境模型中演示了概念，但如果进一步在大规模学习系统中验证这一轨迹占优框架及TEDI的可计算性和预测力，可能对理解与设计具备长期适应性的人工智能架构产生重要影响。

title: An Explainable Failure Prediction Framework for Neural Networks in Radio Access Networks
summary: As 5G networks continue to evolve to deliver high speed, low latency, and reliable communications, ensuring uninterrupted service has become increasingly critical. While millimeter wave (mmWave) frequencies enable gigabit data rates, they are highly susceptible to environmental factors, often leading to radio link failures (RLF). Predictive models leveraging radio and weather data have been proposed to address this issue; however, many operate as black boxes, offering limited transparency for operational deployment. This work bridges that gap by introducing a framework that combines explainability based feature pruning with model refinement. Our framework can be integrated into state of the art predictors such as GNN Transformer and LSTM based architectures for RLF prediction, enabling the development of accurate and explainability guided models in 5G networks. It provides insights into the contribution of input features and the decision making logic of neural networks, leading to lighter and more scalable models. When applied to RLF prediction, our framework unveils that weather data contributes minimally to the forecast in extensive real world datasets, which informs the design of a leaner model with 50 percent fewer parameters and improved F1 scores with respect to the state of the art solution. Ultimately, this work empowers network providers to evaluate and refine their neural network based prediction models for better interpretability, scalability, and performance.

AI.title_translation: 面向无线接入网中神经网络的可解释失效预测框架
AI.tldr: 提出可解释特征剪枝与模型精炼框架，使GNN、Transformer、LSTM等RLF预测器在保持F1提升的同时参数量减半，并揭示天气数据贡献度极低。
AI.motivation: 5G毫米波易受环境影响导致无线链路失效，现有预测模型多为黑盒，缺乏部署透明度，需兼顾准确率与可解释性。
AI.method: 将可解释特征剪枝与模型精炼集成到GNN、Transformer、LSTM架构，对真实数据集进行特征贡献分析并精简模型。
AI.result: 发现天气数据贡献极小，最终模型参数量减少50%，F1得分优于现有最佳方案。
AI.conclusion: 网络运营商可利用该框架评估并优化神经网络预测模型，实现更高可解释性、可扩展性与性能。
AI.translation: 随着5G网络持续演进以提供高速、低时延、可靠通信，保障业务不中断变得愈发关键。毫米波虽可实现千兆速率，却易受环境因素影响，频繁导致无线链路失效。虽有研究利用无线与气象数据建立预测模型，但多为黑盒，缺乏运营部署所需的透明度。本文提出可解释特征剪枝与模型精炼框架，可嵌入GNN、Transformer、LSTM等先进失效预测器，在5G网络中构建准确且可解释的模型。该框架揭示输入特征贡献与神经网络决策逻辑，带来更轻量、可扩展的模型。应用于真实大规模数据集时，发现天气数据贡献甚微，据此设计的精简模型参数量减半，F1得分优于现有最佳方案。最终，本工作助力运营商评估并优化神经网络预测模型，提升可解释性、可扩展性与性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对5G毫米波无线链路失效预测的黑盒问题，提出可解释特征剪枝与模型精炼框架，兼容GNN、Transformer、LSTM，并在真实数据上验证天气数据贡献低，使模型参数量减半、F1提升。
AI.keywords: 5G、毫米波、无线链路失效、可解释性、特征剪枝、神经网络、GNN、Transformer、LSTM

title: PlotChain: Deterministic Checkpointed Evaluation of Multimodal LLMs on Engineering Plot Reading
summary: We present PlotChain, a deterministic, generator-based benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on engineering plot reading-recovering quantitative values from classic plots (e.g., Bode/FFT, step response, stress-strain, pump curves) rather than OCR-only extraction or free-form captioning. PlotChain contains 15 plot families with 450 rendered plots (30 per family), where every item is produced from known parameters and paired with exact ground truth computed directly from the generating process. A central contribution is checkpoint-based diagnostic evaluation: in addition to final targets, each item includes intermediate 'cp_' fields that isolate sub-skills (e.g., reading cutoff frequency or peak magnitude) and enable failure localization within a plot family. We evaluate four state-of-the-art MLLMs under a standardized, deterministic protocol (temperature = 0 and a strict JSON-only numeric output schema) and score predictions using per-field tolerances designed to reflect human plot-reading precision. Under the 'plotread' tolerance policy, the top models achieve 80.42% (Gemini 2.5 Pro), 79.84% (GPT-4.1), and 78.21% (Claude Sonnet 4.5) overall field-level pass rates, while GPT-4o trails at 61.59%. Despite strong performance on many families, frequency-domain tasks remain brittle: bandpass response stays low (<= 23%), and FFT spectrum remains challenging. We release the generator, dataset, raw model outputs, scoring code, and manifests with checksums to support fully reproducible runs and retrospective rescoring under alternative tolerance policies.

AI.title_translation: PlotChain：面向工程图表阅读的多模态大模型确定性检查点评估
AI.tldr: PlotChain提出一个包含450张工程图表的确定性基准，通过检查点机制诊断多模态大模型在读取Bode、FFT等经典图表数值时的子技能，GPT-4.1等顶级模型整体通过率约80%，但频域任务仍脆弱。

title: Enhanced Accessibility for Mobile Indoor Navigation
comments: Published and presented at the 2024 14th International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN)
summary: The navigation of indoor spaces poses difficult challenges for individuals with visual impairments, as it requires processing of sensory information, dealing with uncertainties, and relying on assistance. To tackle these challenges, we present an indoor navigation app that places importance on accessibility for visually impaired users. Our approach involves a combination of user interviews and an analysis of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. With this approach, we are able to gather invaluable insights and identify design requirements for the development of an indoor navigation app. Based on these insights, we develop an indoor navigation app that prioritizes accessibility, integrating enhanced features to meet the needs of visually impaired users. The usability of the app is being thoroughly evaluated through tests involving both visually impaired and sighted users. Initial feedback has been positive, with users appreciating the inclusive user interface and the usability with a wide range of accessibility tools and Android device settings.

title: Stay in Character, Stay Safe: Dual-Cycle Adversarial Self-Evolution for Safety Role-Playing Agents
summary: LLM-based role-playing has rapidly improved in fidelity, yet stronger adherence to persona constraints commonly increases vulnerability to jailbreak attacks, especially for risky or negative personas. Most prior work mitigates this issue with training-time solutions (e.g., data curation or alignment-oriented regularization). However, these approaches are costly to maintain as personas and attack strategies evolve, can degrade in-character behavior, and are typically infeasible for frontier closed-weight LLMs. We propose a training-free Dual-Cycle Adversarial Self-Evolution framework with two coupled cycles. A Persona-Targeted Attacker Cycle synthesizes progressively stronger jailbreak prompts, while a Role-Playing Defender Cycle distills observed failures into a hierarchical knowledge base of (i) global safety rules, (ii) persona-grounded constraints, and (iii) safe in-character exemplars. At inference time, the Defender retrieves and composes structured knowledge from this hierarchy to guide generation, producing responses that remain faithful to the target persona while satisfying safety constraints. Extensive experiments across multiple proprietary LLMs show consistent gains over strong baselines on both role fidelity and jailbreak resistance, and robust generalization to unseen personas and attack prompts.

AI.title_translation: 保持角色，保持安全：面向安全角色扮演智能体的双循环对抗性自我进化框架

title: Lang2Act: Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning through Self-Emergent Linguistic Toolchains
summary: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) enhances Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by incorporating external visual documents to address a given query. Existing VRAG frameworks usually depend on rigid, pre-defined external tools to extend the perceptual capabilities of VLMs, typically by explicitly separating visual perception from subsequent reasoning processes. However, this decoupled design can lead to unnecessary loss of visual information, particularly when image-based operations such as cropping are applied. In this paper, we propose Lang2Act, which enables fine-grained visual perception and reasoning through self-emergent linguistic toolchains. Rather than invoking fixed external engines, Lang2Act collects self-emergent actions as linguistic tools and leverages them to enhance the visual perception capabilities of VLMs. To support this mechanism, we design a two-stage Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based training framework. Specifically, the first stage optimizes VLMs to self-explore high-quality actions for constructing a reusable linguistic toolbox, and the second stage further optimizes VLMs to exploit these linguistic tools for downstream reasoning effectively. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of Lang2Act in substantially enhancing the visual perception capabilities of VLMs, achieving performance improvements of over 4%. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Lang2Act.

AI.title_translation: Lang2Act：通过自显式语言工具链实现细粒度视觉推理

AI.motivation: 现有 VRAG 方法将视觉感知与后续推理解耦，依赖固定的外部工具（如裁剪），导致视觉信息丢失，限制了 VLM 的细粒度理解能力。

title: NL2LOGIC: AST-Guided Translation of Natural Language into First-Order Logic with Large Language Models
comments: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2026. 17 pages, 6 figures
summary: Automated reasoning is critical in domains such as law and governance, where verifying claims against facts in documents requires both accuracy and interpretability. Recent work adopts structured reasoning pipelines that translate natural language into first-order logic and delegate inference to automated solvers. With the rise of large language models, approaches such as GCD and CODE4LOGIC leverage their reasoning and code generation capabilities to improve logic parsing. However, these methods suffer from fragile syntax control due to weak enforcement of global grammar constraints and low semantic faithfulness caused by insufficient clause-level semantic understanding. We propose NL2LOGIC, a first-order logic translation framework that introduces an abstract syntax tree as an intermediate representation. NL2LOGIC combines a recursive large language model based semantic parser with an abstract syntax tree guided generator that deterministically produces solver-ready logic code. Experiments on the FOLIO, LogicNLI, and ProofWriter benchmarks show that NL2LOGIC achieves 99 percent syntactic accuracy and improves semantic correctness by up to 30 percent over state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, integrating NL2LOGIC into Logic-LM yields near-perfect executability and improves downstream reasoning accuracy by 31 percent compared to Logic-LM's original few-shot unconstrained translation module.
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2026. 17 pages, 6 figures

AI.title_translation: NL2LOGIC：利用抽象语法树和大语言模型将自然语言翻译为一阶逻辑
AI.tldr: 提出NL2LOGIC框架，在自然语言到一阶逻辑的翻译过程中引入抽象语法树中间表示，显著提升语法正确率和语义忠实度，并提高下游自动推理性能。
AI.motivation: 在法律与治理等领域，需将文本中的事实与主张进行可解释且准确的自动验证。现有依赖大模型的自然语言到一阶逻辑翻译方法语法约束薄弱、语义理解不充分，导致生成逻辑代码语法脆弱、语义不够忠实，从而限制了自动求解器的可靠性和实用性。
AI.method: 提出NL2LOGIC一阶逻辑翻译框架：首先采用递归式大语言模型语义解析器，将自然语言解析为结构化的抽象语法树（AST）表示；随后使用AST引导的代码生成器，基于该中间表示确定性地产生满足全局语法约束的、可直接输入求解器的一阶逻辑代码，从而同时强化语法控制和子句级语义对齐。
AI.result: 在FOLIO、LogicNLI和ProofWriter基准上，NL2LOGIC实现了99%的语法准确率，在语义正确性上相较最新基线方法最高提升30%。进一步将NL2LOGIC集成进Logic-LM后，逻辑代码可执行性接近完美，下游推理准确率相比Logic-LM原有的少样本、无约束翻译模块提升了31%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在自然语言到一阶逻辑的翻译过程中引入AST中间表示并结合递归大模型解析与AST引导生成，NL2LOGIC有效缓解了语法脆弱和语义不忠实的问题，显著提升了逻辑代码的可执行性和自动推理的端到端表现，为法律、治理等需要高可靠形式化推理的场景提供了更稳健的技术路线。
AI.translation: 自动化推理在法律和治理等领域至关重要，因为在这些领域中，需要在文档中根据事实验证主张，同时兼顾准确性和可解释性。近期工作采用结构化推理流程，将自然语言翻译为一阶逻辑，并将推理委托给自动求解器。随着大语言模型的发展，GCD和CODE4LOGIC等方法利用其推理和代码生成能力来改进逻辑解析。然而，这些方法在语法控制上较为脆弱，原因在于缺乏对全局文法约束的有效强制；同时，由于对子句级语义理解不足，其语义忠实度也偏低。我们提出NL2LOGIC这一一阶逻辑翻译框架，在其中引入抽象语法树作为中间表示。NL2LOGIC将递归式大语言模型语义解析器与抽象语法树引导的生成器相结合，从而确定性地生成可直接用于求解器的逻辑代码。我们在FOLIO、LogicNLI和ProofWriter基准上的实验表明，NL2LOGIC达到了99%的语法准确率，并在语义正确性上相比最新基线最高提升30%。此外，将NL2LOGIC集成到Logic-LM中，可以获得近乎完美的可执行性，并使下游推理准确率相比Logic-LM原始的少样本无约束翻译模块提高31%。
AI.summary: 论文提出NL2LOGIC，将自然语言首先解析为抽象语法树，再由AST引导生成一阶逻辑代码，从而实现强语法约束与更高语义忠实度。在多个逻辑推理基准上，该方法几乎消除语法错误，并显著提升语义正确率和下游推理性能，优于现有大模型驱动的逻辑翻译方法。
AI.keywords: 自然语言到逻辑翻译, 一阶逻辑, 抽象语法树, 大语言模型, 自动推理, 语义解析, 逻辑代码生成
AI.comments: 该工作通过AST中间表示将大模型的语义解析与严格的语法控制解耦，是对NL→FOL任务工程化与可靠性的重要推进。抽象中强调大幅度的语法与语义提升，但未披露在开放领域或跨领域设定下的泛化能力，也未讨论对长文本、多文档场景的适用性。实际部署时，方法仍依赖大模型的递归调用，可能在成本与延迟上存在权衡；未来可探讨更高效的解析策略以及面向特定应用领域的安全与鲁棒性评估。

title: Securing SIM-Assisted Wireless Networks via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
summary: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) have recently emerged as a powerful wave-domain technology that enables multi-stage manipulation of electromagnetic signals through multilayer programmable architectures. While SIMs offer unprecedented degrees of freedom for enhancing physical-layer security, their extremely large number of meta-atoms leads to a high-dimensional and strongly coupled optimization space, making conventional design approaches inefficient and difficult to scale. Moreover, existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) techniques suffer from slow convergence and performance degradation in dynamic wireless environments with imperfect knowledge of passive eavesdroppers. To overcome these challenges, we propose a hybrid quantum proximal policy optimization (Q-PPO) framework for SIM-assisted secure communications, which jointly optimizes transmit power allocation and SIM phase shifts to maximize the average secrecy rate under power and quality-of-service constraints. Specifically, a parameterized quantum circuit is embedded into the actor network, forming a hybrid classical-quantum policy architecture that enhances policy representation capability and exploration efficiency in high-dimensional continuous action spaces. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed Q-PPO scheme consistently outperforms DRL baselines, achieving approximately 15% higher secrecy rates and 30% faster convergence under imperfect eavesdropper channel state information. These results establish Q-PPO as a powerful optimization paradigm for SIM-enabled secure wireless networks.

AI.title_translation: 基于量子强化学习的SIM辅助无线网络安全增强
AI.tldr: 提出混合量子近端策略优化（Q-PPO）框架，通过量子-经典混合策略网络联合优化发射功率与可编程超表面相位，实现高维动作空间下的快速收敛与更高保密速率。
AI.motivation: 堆叠智能超表面（SIM）虽能显著提升物理层安全，但其巨量单元导致高维耦合优化难题，且传统DRL在动态环境与窃听者信息不完整时收敛慢、性能下降。
AI.method: 构建Q-PPO框架：在Actor网络中嵌入参数化量子电路形成混合策略架构，联合优化发射功率分配与SIM相移，以在功率与QoS约束下最大化平均保密速率。
AI.result: 仿真显示，Q-PPO比DRL基线保密速率提升约15%，收敛速度加快30%，且在窃听者信道状态信息不完整条件下仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: Q-PPO为SIM赋能的安全无线网络提供了一种高效可扩展的优化新范式。
AI.translation: 堆叠智能超表面（SIM）作为新兴的波域技术，通过多层可编程架构对电磁信号进行多阶段操控。尽管SIM为物理层安全带来前所未有的自由度，但其海量单元导致高维强耦合优化空间，使传统设计方法效率低且难以扩展。现有深度强化学习（DRL）在动态无线环境及窃听者信息不完整时收敛慢、性能退化。为此，我们提出混合量子近端策略优化（Q-PPO）框架，用于SIM辅助安全通信，在功率与QoS约束下联合优化发射功率与SIM相移以最大化平均保密速率。具体而言，在Actor网络嵌入参数化量子电路，形成混合经典-量子策略架构，提升高维连续动作空间的策略表征与探索效率。大量仿真表明，Q-PPO较DRL基线保密速率提高约15%，收敛速度提升30%，在窃听者信道状态信息不完整条件下依然有效，确立了Q-PPO作为SIM安全网络强大优化范式的地位。
AI.summary: 针对堆叠智能超表面（SIM）在高维耦合优化与动态环境下安全通信的挑战，本文提出混合量子近端策略优化（Q-PPO）框架，将参数化量子电路嵌入Actor网络，联合优化发射功率与SIM相移。仿真表明，该方法在窃听者信息不完整条件下较传统DRL保密速率提升15%，收敛速度加快30%，为SIM无线网络提供高效安全的优化方案。
AI.keywords: 堆叠智能超表面;量子强化学习;近端策略优化;物理层安全;保密速率
AI.comments: 摘要未提硬件实现、量子比特数目及量子计算误差对实际部署的影响。

title: CrisiSense-RAG: Crisis Sensing Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Rapid Disaster Impact Assessment
summary: Timely and spatially resolved disaster impact assessment is essential for effective emergency response. However, automated methods typically struggle with temporal asynchrony. Real-time human reports capture peak hazard conditions while high-resolution satellite imagery is frequently acquired after peak conditions. This often reflects flood recession rather than maximum extent. Naive fusion of these misaligned streams can yield dangerous underestimates when post-event imagery overrides documented peak flooding. We present CrisiSense-RAG, which is a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation framework that reframes impact assessment as evidence synthesis over heterogeneous data sources without disaster-specific fine-tuning. The system employs hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for text sources and CLIP-based retrieval for aerial imagery. A split-pipeline architecture feeds into asynchronous fusion logic that prioritizes real-time social evidence for peak flood extent while treating imagery as persistent evidence of structural damage. Evaluated on Hurricane Harvey across 207 ZIP-code queries, the framework achieves a flood extent MAE of 10.94% to 28.40% and damage severity MAE of 16.47% to 21.65% in zero-shot settings. Prompt-level alignment proves critical for quantitative validity because metric grounding improves damage estimates by up to 4.75 percentage points. These results demonstrate a practical and deployable approach to rapid resilience intelligence under real-world data constraints.

AI.title_translation: CrisiSense-RAG：用于快速灾害影响评估的危机感知多模态检索增强生成
AI.tldr: 提出CrisiSense-RAG，一种无需灾难特定微调的多模态RAG框架，通过异步融合实时文本与灾后影像，实现零样本下哈维飓风207个ZIP码的洪涝范围与建筑损毁快速评估。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以处理实时报告与灾后影像的时间异步，直接融合易低估峰值洪涝，亟需一种无需专门微调即可综合异构数据、准确评估灾情的方案。
AI.method: 构建多模态RAG框架：混合稠密-稀疏检索文本，CLIP检索航拍影像；采用split-pipeline架构与异步融合逻辑，优先以实时社媒证据确定峰值洪涝，影像仅作结构损伤持久证据，并通过提示级对齐实现定量指标接地。
AI.result: 在哈维飓风207个ZIP码零样本测试中，洪涝范围MAE 10.94%-28.40%，损伤等级MAE 16.47%-21.65%；指标接地提示提升损伤估计达4.75个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CrisiSense-RAG在现实数据约束下提供可部署的快速韧性情报手段，证明异步融合与提示对齐对提升零样本量化评估有效性至关重要。
AI.translation: 及时且具空间分辨率的灾害影响评估对有效应急响应至关重要。然而，自动化方法常受时间异步困扰：实时人工报告捕捉致灾峰值，而高分辨率卫星影像多在峰值后获取，反映的是洪水退水而非最大范围。简单融合这些错位流会导致后事件影像覆盖已记录的峰值洪涝，从而严重低估风险。我们提出CrisiSense-RAG，一种多模态检索增强生成框架，将评估重构为对异构数据源的无需灾难特定微调的证据综合。系统对文本采用混合稠密-稀疏检索，对航拍影像采用CLIP检索；split-pipeline架构接入异步融合逻辑，优先用实时社交证据确定峰值洪涝范围，而将影像视为结构损伤的持久证据。在哈维飓风207个ZIP码查询上评估，该框架在零样本设定下实现洪涝范围MAE 10.94%-28.40%、损伤等级MAE 16.47%-21.65%。提示级对齐对量化有效性至关重要，指标接地可将损伤估计提升达4.75个百分点。结果展示了在现实数据约束下实现快速韧性情报的实用且可部署的方法。
AI.summary: CrisiSense-RAG是一种无需灾难特定微调的多模态RAG框架，通过异步融合实时文本与灾后影像，在零样本条件下对哈维飓风207个ZIP码实现洪涝范围与建筑损伤的快速、准确评估。
AI.keywords: 灾害影响评估,多模态检索增强生成,异步数据融合,洪涝范围,建筑损伤,零样本学习
AI.comments: 摘要清晰展示时间异步问题与解决思路，但缺乏计算成本、部署细节及与其他方法的全面比较，未来可补充消融实验与真实部署案例。

title: AST-PAC: AST-guided Membership Inference for Code
summary: Code Large Language Models are frequently trained on massive datasets containing restrictively licensed source code. This creates urgent data governance and copyright challenges. Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) can serve as an auditing mechanism to detect unauthorized data usage in models. While attacks like the Loss Attack provide a baseline, more involved methods like Polarized Augment Calibration (PAC) remain underexplored in the code domain. This paper presents an exploratory study evaluating these methods on 3B--7B parameter code models. We find that while PAC generally outperforms the Loss baseline, its effectiveness relies on augmentation strategies that disregard the rigid syntax of code, leading to performance degradation on larger, complex files. To address this, we introduce AST-PAC, a domain-specific adaptation that utilizes Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) based perturbations to generate syntactically valid calibration samples. Preliminary results indicate that AST-PAC improves as syntactic size grows, where PAC degrades, but under-mutates small files and underperforms on alphanumeric-rich code. Overall, the findings motivate future work on syntax-aware and size-adaptive calibration as a prerequisite for reliable provenance auditing of code language models.

AI.title_translation: AST-PAC：基于AST的代码成员推断攻击
AI.tldr: 提出AST-PAC方法，用抽象语法树生成语法有效的扰动样本，提升对代码大模型的成员推断攻击效果，尤其在大文件上优于现有PAC基线。
AI.motivation: 代码大模型常在含限制性许可证的海量源码上训练，引发数据治理与版权风险，需成员推断攻击作为审计手段，而现有PAC方法忽视代码刚性语法导致效果受限。
AI.method: 将Polarized Augment Calibration适配到代码域，利用抽象语法树(AST)生成语法正确的扰动样本进行校准，并在3B–7B参数的代码模型上评估。
AI.result: PAC普遍优于Loss基线，但在大且复杂的文件上因忽视语法而性能下降；AST-PAC随语法规模增大而提升，却在小文件和富含字母数字的代码上突变不足、表现落后。
AI.conclusion: 需进一步研究语法感知且自适应规模的校准策略，才能实现对代码语言模型可信赖的数据溯源审计。
AI.translation: 代码大模型常在包含受限制许可证的庞大源代码数据集上训练，带来紧迫的数据治理与版权挑战。成员推断攻击（MIA）可作为审计机制，检测模型中未经授权的数据使用。虽然Loss攻击等方法提供了基线，但更复杂的方法如Polarized Augment Calibration（PAC）在代码领域仍待深入探索。本文对3B–7B参数规模的代码模型开展探索性研究评估这些方法。我们发现PAC总体优于Loss基线，但其有效性依赖忽视代码刚性语法的增强策略，导致在更大、更复杂文件上性能下降。为此，我们提出AST-PAC，一种领域特定改进，利用抽象语法树（AST）扰动生成语法有效的校准样本。初步结果表明，随着语法规模增大，AST-PAC性能提升而PAC下降，但AST-PAC对小文件突变不足，在富含字母数字的代码上表现不佳。总体而言，研究结果激励未来开展语法感知且规模自适应的校准工作，作为代码语言模型可靠来源审计的前提。
AI.summary: 本文针对代码大模型的成员推断审计需求，提出AST-PAC方法，用AST生成语法有效的扰动样本，改善PAC在大文件上的攻击效果，同时揭示小文件和字母数字密集代码的局限，为未来语法感知、规模自适应的校准研究指明方向。
AI.keywords: 成员推断攻击，代码大模型，数据溯源，抽象语法树，Polarized Augment Calibration
AI.comments: 摘要未提及实验具体数据集、评估指标与统计显著性，亦未讨论计算开销与防御对策，需阅读全文获取细节。

title: Real-World Design and Deployment of an Embedded GenAI-powered 9-1-1 Calltaking Training System: Experiences and Lessons Learned
summary: Emergency call-takers form the first operational link in public safety response, handling over 240 million calls annually while facing a sustained training crisis: staffing shortages exceed 25\% in many centers, and preparing a single new hire can require up to 720 hours of one-on-one instruction that removes experienced personnel from active duty. Traditional training approaches struggle to scale under these constraints, limiting both coverage and feedback timeliness. In partnership with Metro Nashville Department of Emergency Communications (MNDEC), we designed, developed, and deployed a GenAI-powered call-taking training system under real-world constraints. Over six months, deployment scaled from initial pilot to 190 operational users across 1,120 training sessions, exposing systematic challenges around system delivery, rigor, resilience, and human factors that remain largely invisible in controlled or purely simulated evaluations. By analyzing deployment logs capturing 98,429 user interactions, organizational processes, and stakeholder engagement patterns, we distill four key lessons, each coupled with concrete design and governance practices. These lessons provide grounded guidance for researchers and practitioners seeking to embed AI-driven training systems in safety-critical public sector environments where embedded constraints fundamentally shape socio-technical design.

AI.title_translation: 嵌入式生成式人工智能驱动的911呼叫接听培训系统的真实世界设计与部署：经验与教训总结
AI.tldr: 该研究设计、开发并部署了一个基于生成式人工智能的911呼叫接听培训系统，以解决应急呼叫中心因人员短缺而面临的培训危机，通过在真实环境中六个月的部署，总结了四条关键教训和设计实践。
AI.motivation: 应急呼叫中心面临严重的培训危机，人员短缺率超过25%，培训一个新员工需要高达720小时的一对一指导，这使有经验的员工无法执行任务，传统培训方法难以扩展，限制了覆盖范围和反馈及时性。
AI.method: 与纳什维尔市应急通信部门合作，在真实世界约束下设计、开发和部署生成式人工智能驱动的呼叫接听培训系统，部署六个月，从试点扩展到190名操作用户和1120次培训会话，通过分析98429次用户交互记录、组织流程和利益相关者参与模式，提炼关键教训。
AI.result: 部署过程中发现了在系统交付、严格性、弹性和人为因素方面的系统性挑战，这些在受控或纯模拟评估中基本不可见，并提炼出四条关键教训，每条都配有具体的设计和治理实践。
AI.conclusion: 这些教训为研究人员和从业者在安全关键的公共部门环境中嵌入人工智能驱动的培训系统提供了实际指导，其中嵌入式约束从根本上塑造了社会技术设计。
AI.translation: 该论文的标题和摘要描述了一项研究，旨在解决应急呼叫中心的培训危机，通过部署生成式人工智能系统，并在真实环境中总结经验教训。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了在真实世界约束下，与纳什维尔市应急通信部门合作，设计、开发和部署生成式人工智能驱动的911呼叫接听培训系统的经验。系统在六个月内从试点扩展到190名用户和1120次培训会话，通过分析大量交互数据，揭示了系统交付、严格性、弹性和人为因素方面的挑战，并提炼出四条关键教训，为在安全关键的公共部门环境中嵌入人工智能培训系统提供指导。
AI.keywords: 生成式人工智能, 应急呼叫中心, 培训系统, 真实世界部署, 社会技术设计, 公共安全
AI.comments: 该研究强调了在真实环境中部署人工智能系统的重要性，尤其是在安全关键领域，通过实践经验总结教训，为类似应用提供了宝贵的参考。但摘要未提及具体的技术实现细节或系统的性能指标。
