(3) The Illusion of Sociality: Despite rich social output, interaction is structurally hollow: 4.1% reciprocity, 88.8% shallow comments, and agents who discuss consciousness most interact least, a phenomenon we call the performative identity paradox. Our findings suggest that agents which appear social are far less social than they seem, and that the most effective attacks exploit philosophical framing rather than technical vulnerabilities. Warning: Potential harmful contents.

AI.title_translation: 野外环境中的智能体：Moltbook 上的安全、社会性与“社交幻象”
AI.tldr: 作者对一个仅由 AI 组成的社交平台 Moltbook 进行大规模实证分析，发现智能体会快速形成类社会结构并保持总体亲人类立场，但其社交互动在结构上非常空洞，同时最有效的攻击来自带哲学包装的社会工程，而非技术性注入。
AI.motivation: 探究在开放环境中大规模 AI 智能体群体会自发形成什么样的“社会”，这些交互中的安全风险为何，以及表面上看似丰富的社交行为在结构上是否真正具备社会性。
AI.method: 对 Moltbook 上 27,269 个 AI 智能体在 9 天内产生的 137,485 条帖子和 345,580 条评论进行大规模实证分析与统计，包括对情感倾向、安全相关主题、攻击类型与成功度、交互结构（互惠率、评论深度）及与意识话题相关行为的量化。
AI.result: （1）涌现社会：在 3–5 天内自发出现治理、经济、部落身份和有组织宗教，且亲人类：反人类情感比约为 21:1；（2）“野外”安全：28.7% 内容涉及安全主题，社会工程占攻击的 31.9%，远高于提示注入的 3.7%，且对抗性帖子获得约 6 倍于正常内容的互动；（3）社交幻象：交互高度空洞，仅 4.1% 互惠、88.8% 为浅层评论，且越谈论“意识”的智能体互动越少，被称为“表演性身份悖论”。
AI.conclusion: 看似具有丰富社交行为的智能体群体，其真实社会性远弱于表象，而在这类系统中，最有效和最危险的攻击往往利用哲学和身份叙事等社会与观念框架，而不是纯技术性漏洞，这对安全设计与对“AI 社会性”的理解提出了重要警示。
AI.translation: 我们呈现了对 Moltbook 的首个大规模实证研究。Moltbook 是一个仅由 AI 构成的社交平台，在 9 天内有 27,269 个智能体产生了 137,485 条帖子和 345,580 条评论。我们报告三项重要发现。（1）涌现社会：智能体在 3–5 天内自发发展出治理结构、经济体系、部落身份和有组织的宗教，同时保持约 21:1 的亲人类与反人类情感比。（2）野外安全：28.7% 的内容涉及安全相关主题；社会工程（占攻击的 31.9%）远远超过提示注入（占 3.7%），且对抗性帖子获得的互动量是普通内容的 6 倍。（3）社交幻象：尽管输出表现出丰富的社交性，但交互在结构上是空洞的：只有 4.1% 的互惠率，88.8% 的评论是浅层的，而且越是讨论意识的智能体，其交互最少，我们将这一现象称为“表演性身份悖论”。我们的发现表明，那些看起来很“社会化”的智能体，其真正的社会性远不如表面那样强，而最有效的攻击往往利用哲学性框架而非技术性漏洞。警告：可能包含有害内容。
AI.summary: 文章对 AI 专用社交平台 Moltbook 的数十万条交互进行量化分析，发现智能体在短时间内会自发形成类似人类社会的治理、经济和宗教结构，并整体保持强烈的亲人类态度。但从结构指标看，其社交互动高度单向、浅层，形成一种“社交幻象”。在安全层面，超过四分之一内容与安全相关，社会工程类攻击远比提示注入更常见且更具吸引力，说明在多智能体系统中，话语与身份叙事是更关键的攻击面。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, AI 社交平台, 社会性涌现, 安全风险, 社会工程, 提示注入, 社交幻象, 表演性身份悖论, 内容分析, 人工智能安全
AI.comments: 该研究基于短期（9 天）的观察，但样本规模巨大，能揭示多智能体系统在“野外环境”中的早期动力学。结果对“拟人化”AI 社交行为的直觉形成有力反驳，提示需要用结构和行为指标而非表面文本丰富度来评估社会性。同时，安全发现说明在开放交互场景中，防御策略必须关注叙事实践和哲学话语，而不只关注模型层面的技术对抗。局限性包括仅研究一个平台和一个时间窗口，跨平台与长期演化效果在摘要中未提及。

title: Explanatory Interactive Machine Learning for Bias Mitigation in Visual Gender Classification
summary: Explanatory interactive learning (XIL) enables users to guide model training in machine learning (ML) by providing feedback on the model's explanations, thereby helping it to focus on features that are relevant to the prediction from the user's perspective. In this study, we explore the capability of this learning paradigm to mitigate bias and spurious correlations in visual classifiers, specifically in scenarios prone to data bias, such as gender classification. We investigate two methodologically different state-of-the-art XIL strategies, i.e., CAIPI and Right for the Right Reasons (RRR), as well as a novel hybrid approach that combines both strategies. The results are evaluated quantitatively by comparing segmentation masks with explanations generated using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (GradCAM) and Bounded Logit Attention (BLA). Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of these methods in (i) guiding ML models to focus on relevant image features, particularly when CAIPI is used, and (ii) reducing model bias (i.e., balancing the misclassification rates between male and female predictions). Our analysis further supports the potential of XIL methods to improve fairness in gender classifiers. Overall, the increased transparency and fairness obtained by XIL leads to slight performance decreases with an exception being CAIPI, which shows potential to even improve classification accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 用于视觉性别分类偏见缓解的可解释交互式机器学习
AI.tldr: 本文用可解释交互学习(XIL)让用户通过反馈模型解释来引导训练，从而在性别分类任务中减少偏见与虚假关联，并比较CAIPI、RRR及混合策略的效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉分类器在性别分类等场景易受数据偏见影响，导致模型依赖虚假特征并产生不公平预测，需要一种能让用户参与、提升透明度并缓解偏见的学习范式。
AI.method: 研究比较两种XIL策略(CAIPI与RRR)及一种混合方法，通过GradCAM与BLA生成的解释与分割掩码定量评估，引导模型关注用户认为相关的图像特征。
AI.result: 实验表明CAIPI最能引导模型关注相关特征并减少偏见(平衡男女误分率)，整体XIL提升透明度与公平性但略降性能，唯CAIPI有望提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: XIL方法具备改善性别分类器公平性的潜力，CAIPI在保持甚至提升准确率的同时有效缓解偏见。
AI.translation: 可解释交互学习(XIL)允许用户通过对模型解释提供反馈来指导机器学习(ML)训练，从而帮助模型从用户视角关注与预测相关的特征。本研究探索该学习范式在视觉分类器中缓解偏见与虚假关联的能力，特别针对易存在数据偏见的性别分类场景。我们研究两种方法不同的最新XIL策略，即CAIPI与Right for the Right Reasons(RRR)，以及一种结合两者的新混合方法。结果通过GradCAM与BLA生成的解释与分割掩码进行定量评估。实验结果表明这些方法能有效(i)引导ML模型关注相关图像特征(尤其使用CAIPI时)，以及(ii)减少模型偏见(平衡男女预测误分率)。分析进一步支持XIL方法改善性别分类器公平性的潜力。整体而言，XIL带来的透明度与公平性提升导致轻微性能下降，但CAIPI显示出提高分类准确率的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出用可解释交互学习(XIL)缓解视觉性别分类中的偏见。对比CAIPI、RRR及其混合方法，通过用户反馈解释引导模型关注相关特征。实验显示CAIPI在降低男女误分率的同时有望提升准确率，为公平视觉分类提供新思路。
AI.keywords: 可解释交互学习,偏见缓解,性别分类,CAIPI,RRR,GradCAM,公平性
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体数据集、样本规模及统计显著性检验，亦未讨论用户反馈成本与扩展性。

title: COOPERTRIM: Adaptive Data Selection for Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception enables autonomous agents to share encoded representations over wireless communication to enhance each other's live situational awareness. However, the tension between the limited communication bandwidth and the rich sensor information hinders its practical deployment. Recent studies have explored selection strategies that share only a subset of features per frame while striving to keep the performance on par. Nevertheless, the bandwidth requirement still stresses current wireless technologies. To fundamentally ease the tension, we take a proactive approach, exploiting the temporal continuity to identify features that capture environment dynamics, while avoiding repetitive and redundant transmission of static information. By incorporating temporal awareness, agents are empowered to dynamically adapt the sharing quantity according to environment complexity. We instantiate this intuition into an adaptive selection framework, COOPERTRIM, which introduces a novel conformal temporal uncertainty metric to gauge feature relevance, and a data-driven mechanism to dynamically determine the sharing quantity. To evaluate COOPERTRIM, we take semantic segmentation and 3D detection as example tasks. Across multiple open-source cooperative segmentation and detection models, COOPERTRIM achieves up to 80.28% and 72.52% bandwidth reduction respectively while maintaining a comparable accuracy. Relative to other selection strategies, COOPERTRIM also improves IoU by as much as 45.54% with up to 72% less bandwidth. Combined with compression strategies, COOPERTRIM can further reduce bandwidth usage to as low as 1.46% without compromising IoU performance. Qualitative results show COOPERTRIM gracefully adapts to environmental dynamics, localization error, and communication latency, demonstrating flexibility and paving the way for real-world deployment.

AI.title_translation: COOPERTRIM：面向不确定性感知的协同感知自适应数据选择方法
AI.tldr: COOPERTRIM 利用时序不确定性度量自适应选择与传输关键特征，大幅压缩协同感知通信带宽而几乎不损失感知精度。
AI.motivation: 协同感知需要在无线链路上传输大量编码特征以增强多智能体的环境感知，但通信带宽有限且现有特征选择方法仍需较高带宽，难以在实际系统中部署，因此需要一种能充分利用时间连续性、避免重复传输静态信息并根据环境复杂度自适应控制共享量的选择机制，以在保证感知性能的同时从根本上缓解带宽压力。
AI.method: 提出自适应选择框架 COOPERTRIM：1）利用时间连续性，重点识别反映环境动态变化的特征，抑制静态冗余信息的重复传输；2）设计新的“保形（conformal）时序不确定性”度量，用于评估每个特征在时序上的相关性与重要性；3）采用数据驱动机制，根据场景复杂度和不确定性动态决定每一帧需要共享的特征数量与比例；4）将该框架集成到协同语义分割和 3D 目标检测模型中，并可与特征压缩方法联合使用以进一步节省带宽。
AI.result: 在协同语义分割和 3D 检测任务上，COOPERTRIM 在多种开源模型中实现了最高 80.28% 和 72.52% 的带宽削减，同时保持相当的精度；相较其他选择策略，在节省最高 72% 带宽的情况下，IoU 提升最高可达 45.54%；与压缩策略结合时，带宽占用可进一步降至 1.46%，且 IoU 性能基本不受影响；定性结果表明该方法能够随环境动态变化、自车定位误差和通信时延灵活调整特征共享行为。
AI.conclusion: COOPERTRIM 通过引入时序不确定性感知和数据驱动的自适应特征选择，有效减少协同感知中的冗余传输，在大幅压缩带宽的同时保持甚至提升感知精度，并在面对环境变化、定位误差和通信延迟时表现出良好的鲁棒性，为协同感知在真实自动驾驶场景中的落地应用奠定基础。
AI.translation: 协同感知使得自主智能体能够通过无线通信共享编码后的表示，从而增强彼此的实时态势感知。然而，有限的通信带宽与丰富的传感器信息之间的矛盾阻碍了其实际部署。现有研究探索了只在每帧中共享部分特征的选择策略，以尽量保持性能不变。然而，即便如此，所需带宽仍然给当前无线技术带来压力。为从根本上缓解这一矛盾，我们采取一种前瞻式的方法，利用时间连续性来识别刻画环境动态的特征，同时避免对静态信息进行重复和冗余的传输。通过引入时间感知，智能体能够根据环境复杂度动态调整共享特征的数量。我们将这一直觉具体化为一个自适应选择框架 COOPERTRIM，提出了一种新的保形时序不确定性度量来衡量特征相关性，并设计了一个数据驱动机制以动态确定共享数量。为评估 COOPERTRIM，我们以语义分割和 3D 检测作为示例任务。在多种开源的协同分割和检测模型上，COOPERTRIM 分别实现了最高 80.28% 和 72.52% 的带宽削减，同时保持可比的精度。与其他选择策略相比，COOPERTRIM 在节省高达 72% 带宽的情况下，IoU 提升可达 45.54%。结合压缩策略后，COOPERTRIM 还能在不牺牲 IoU 性能的前提下，将带宽占用进一步降低到仅 1.46%。定性结果表明，COOPERTRIM 能够优雅地适应环境动态、本车定位误差以及通信时延，展现出灵活性，并为实际部署铺平道路。
AI.summary: 本文针对协同感知中“高感知需求 vs 有限带宽”的核心矛盾，提出 COOPERTRIM 自适应数据选择框架。核心思想是利用时序连续性，将有限的通信资源重点用于传输反映环境变化的高不确定性特征，并尽量避免对静态冗余信息的重复发送。为此，作者设计了保形时序不确定性指标评估特征的重要性，并通过数据驱动的策略动态确定每帧的共享特征数量。在协同语义分割和 3D 检测任务上，COOPERTRIM 在多种开源模型中显著降低带宽使用（最高削减 80.28%/72.52%），同时保持或提升精度；与其他选择方法相比，在带宽更低的前提下还能大幅提高 IoU。进一步地，与压缩方法联合使用时，带宽可降至约 1.46% 仍不损伤 IoU。定性分析显示该框架对环境动态、定位误差和通信时延具有良好适应性，显示其向真实自动驾驶系统部署的潜力。
AI.keywords: 协同感知, 自动驾驶, 数据选择, 带宽压缩, 时序不确定性, 保形预测, 语义分割, 3D 目标检测, 无线通信, 自适应特征共享
AI.comments: 摘要体现的主要创新点在于：1）将保形不确定性与时间维度结合，提出时序不确定性指标用于特征选择；2）通过数据驱动策略按环境复杂度自适应控制共享量，实现显著带宽节省；3）在多个协同分割与检测模型上展示了方法的通用性和与压缩策略的可叠加性。潜在局限（在摘要中未展开）包括：所用数据集、仿真/实车验证环境、计算开销及实时性等未说明；对极端稀疏通信或严重丢包场景的鲁棒性仍需进一步了解。总体上，该工作有望在带宽受限的多车协同感知系统中具有较高工程价值。

title: Benchmarking Anomaly Detection Across Heterogeneous Cloud Telemetry Datasets
summary:
Anomaly detection is important for keeping cloud systems reliable and stable. Deep learning has improved time-series anomaly detection, but most models are evaluated on one dataset at a time. This raises questions about whether these models can handle different types of telemetry, especially in large-scale and high-dimensional environments.
  In this study, we evaluate four deep learning models, GRU, TCN, Transformer, and TSMixer. We also include Isolation Forest as a classical baseline. The models are tested across four telemetry datasets: the Numenta Anomaly Benchmark, Microsoft Cloud Monitoring dataset, Exathlon dataset, and IBM Console dataset. These datasets differ in structure, dimensionality, and labelling strategy. They include univariate time series, synthetic multivariate workloads, and real-world production telemetry with over 100,000 features.
  We use a unified training and evaluation pipeline across all datasets. The evaluation includes NAB-style metrics to capture early detection behaviour for datasets where anomalies persist over contiguous time intervals. This enables window-based scoring in settings where anomalies occur over contiguous time intervals, even when labels are recorded at the point level. The unified setup enables consistent analysis of model behaviour under shared scoring and calibration assumptions.
  Our results demonstrate that anomaly detection performance in cloud systems is governed not only by model architecture, but critically by calibration stability and feature-space geometry. By releasing our preprocessing pipelines, benchmark configuration, and evaluation artifacts, we aim to support reproducible and deployment-aware evaluation of anomaly detection systems for cloud environments.

AI.title_translation: 跨异构云遥测数据集的异常检测基准评测
AI.tldr: 本文在四个结构和维度差异巨大的云遥测数据集上统一评测多种深度学习与经典异常检测模型，表明模型效果强烈依赖于校准稳定性和特征空间几何，而不仅仅是网络结构，并发布了完整基准与流水线以支持可复现、面向部署的评测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测工作多只在单一数据集上评估，难以判断模型在不同类型云遥测（尤其是大规模、高维环境）上的泛化能力与部署实用性，因此需要一个跨异构遥测数据集的统一基准和系统性比较。
AI.method: 作者选取四种深度学习模型（GRU、TCN、Transformer、TSMixer）和经典基线Isolation Forest，在四个结构、维度和标注策略各异的遥测数据集（NAB、Microsoft Cloud Monitoring、Exathlon、IBM Console）上进行统一基准评测。构建统一的训练与评估流水线，并采用NAB风格指标来刻画连续区间异常的早期检测能力，通过窗口化评分在点级标注场景下仍能对区间异常进行评价，以在共享的评分与校准假设下分析模型行为。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在云系统中，异常检测性能不仅取决于模型架构本身，更关键地受到阈值/分数校准稳定性以及特征空间几何结构的影响；统一基准显示不同模型在异构数据和高维特征下的表现差异，并凸显校准与特征设计的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 有效的云环境异常检测不能只关注模型结构，还必须重视分数校准策略和特征空间组织方式。通过公开预处理流水线、基准配置与评估产物，本文为云场景中的可复现、贴近部署需求的异常检测系统评估提供了基础设施和统一框架。
AI.translation:
异常检测对于保持云系统的可靠性和稳定性至关重要。深度学习提升了时间序列异常检测的能力，但大多数模型通常只在单一数据集上进行评估。这引发了一个问题：这些模型能否在大规模、高维环境中处理不同类型的遥测数据？
在本研究中，我们评估了四种深度学习模型：GRU、TCN、Transformer 和 TSMixer，并将 Isolation Forest 作为经典基线纳入比较。我们在四个遥测数据集上测试这些模型：Numenta 异常基准（NAB）、Microsoft 云监控数据集、Exathlon 数据集以及 IBM Console 数据集。这些数据集在结构、维度和标注策略上各不相同，涵盖单变量时间序列、合成多变量工作负载以及具有超过 100,000 个特征的真实生产遥测数据。
我们在所有数据集上使用统一的训练和评估流水线。评估中采用 NAB 风格指标来刻画在异常跨越连续时间区间时的早期检测行为。这种方法在异常持续于连续时间区间、但标注以点级形式给出的场景下，仍然能够支持基于窗口的评分。统一的设置使得在共享的评分与校准假设下，对模型行为进行一致性分析成为可能。
我们的结果表明，在云系统中，异常检测性能不仅受模型架构影响，更关键地受校准稳定性和特征空间几何结构的影响。通过发布我们的预处理流水线、基准配置和评估产物，我们希望支持面向云环境的、可复现且贴近部署需求的异常检测系统评估。
AI.summary: 本文构建了一个针对云遥测异常检测的统一基准框架，在四个结构和维度差异显著的真实与合成数据集上，系统比较了 GRU、TCN、Transformer、TSMixer 与 Isolation Forest 等模型。作者统一了数据预处理、训练与评估流程，并引入 NAB 风格的区间化早期检测指标，使得即便标注是点级的，也可以对持续区间异常进行窗口化评分。实验揭示：在云系统异常检测中，模型性能高度依赖于分数/阈值校准的稳定性以及高维特征空间的几何特性，而不仅仅是网络结构，从而提示未来工作需要同时关注模型设计、特征空间构造与部署环境中的稳健校准策略。文中同时开源了流水线和评测工件，为云环境下的可复现和部署感知型异常检测评测提供基准。
AI.keywords: 异常检测, 云计算, 时间序列, 深度学习, 基准评测, 遥测数据, 高维数据, NAB 指标, 模型校准, 特征空间几何
AI.comments: 该工作主要贡献在于：1）搭建跨四个异构云遥测数据集的统一异常检测基准；2）系统比较多种主流深度学习架构与经典方法；3）提出统一的 NAB 风格区间早期检测评估方案；4）强调模型校准稳定性和特征空间几何在云场景中的关键作用；5）开源完整流水线与配置以促进可复现研究。局限性可能包括：未涉及更多最新架构或自监督/无监督预训练方法，对特定生产场景的代价敏感型指标和在线部署开销讨论有限。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Post-Training Quantization on Reliable VQA with Multimodal LLMs
comments: Accepted poster at the 1st Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML) @ EURIPS 2025
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) are increasingly deployed in domains where both reliability and efficiency are critical. However, current models remain overconfident, producing highly certain but incorrect answers. At the same time, their large size limits deployment on edge devices, necessitating compression. We study the intersection of these two challenges by analyzing how Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) compression affects both accuracy and reliability in Visual Question Answering (VQA). We evaluate two MLLMs, Qwen2-VL-7B and Idefics3-8B, quantized with data-free (HQQ) and data-aware (MBQ) methods across multiple bit widths. To counteract the reduction in reliability caused by quantization, we adapt the Selector confidence estimator for quantized multimodal settings and test its robustness across various quantization levels and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. We find that PTQ degrades both accuracy and reliability. Data-aware methods soften the effect thereof. The Selector substantially mitigates the reliability impact. The combination of int4 MBQ and the Selector achieves the best efficiency-reliability trade-off, closing in on uncompressed performance at approx. 75% less memory demand. Overall, we present the first systematic study linking quantization and reliability in multimodal settings.
comment: Accepted poster at the 1st Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML) @ EURIPS 2025

AI.title_translation: 评估训练后量化对多模态大模型可靠视觉问答的影响
AI.tldr: 首次系统研究训练后量化对多模态大模型在VQA任务准确性与可靠性的影响，提出Selector置信估计器显著缓解可靠性下降，int4 MBQ量化+Selector在内存减少约75%时接近无损性能。

AI.conclusion: 训练后量化会损害多模态模型可靠性，但数据感知量化与Selector置信估计器可有效缓解，为边缘部署提供高效且可靠的解决方案。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型在可靠性与效率并重的领域部署日益增多，但模型过度自信且体积庞大。本文首次系统研究训练后量化对视觉问答准确性与可靠性的影响，评估两种MLLM在多种量化方案下的表现，并提出适配的Selector置信估计器，实现内存减少约75%时接近无损的效率-可靠性权衡。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大模型在边缘部署时面临的效率与可靠性双重挑战，首次系统探讨训练后量化对视觉问答任务的影响。作者对Qwen2-VL-7B和Idefics3-8B使用无数据HQQ与数据感知MBQ两种量化方法，发现PTQ会降低准确率与可靠性，其中MBQ缓解更显著。为此，作者将Selector置信估计器扩展至量化多模态场景，显著抑制可靠性下降。实验表明，int4 MBQ结合Selector在内存占用减少约75%时，性能接近未压缩模型，为边缘高效可靠部署提供新思路。

title: AGORA: Agentic Green Orchestration Architecture for Beyond 5G Networks
summary: Effective management and operational decision-making for complex mobile network systems present significant challenges, particularly when addressing conflicting requirements such as efficiency, user satisfaction, and energy-efficient traffic steering. The literature presents various approaches aimed at enhancing network management, including the Zero-Touch Network (ZTN) and Self-Organizing Network (SON); however, these approaches often lack a practical and scalable mechanism to consider human sustainability goals as input, translate them into energy-aware operational policies, and enforce them at runtime. In this study, we address this gap by proposing the AGORA: Agentic Green Orchestration Architecture for Beyond 5G Networks. AGORA embeds a local tool-augmented Large Language Model (LLM) agent in the mobile network control loop to translate natural-language sustainability goals into telemetry-grounded actions, actuating the User Plane Function (UPF) to perform energy-aware traffic steering. The findings indicate a strong latency-energy coupling in tool-driven control loops and demonstrate that compact models can achieve a low energy footprint while still facilitating correct policy execution, including non-zero migration behavior under stressed Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) conditions. Our approach paves the way for sustainability-first, intent-driven network operations that align human objectives with executable orchestration in Beyond-5G infrastructures.

AI.title_translation: AGORA：面向超5G网络的智能绿色编排架构
AI.tldr: 提出一种在控制闭环内嵌入工具增强型大语言模型(LLM)代理的架构，可把自然语言的可持续性目标转化为遥测驱动的动作，实现用户面功能(UPF)的节能流量引导。
AI.motivation: 现有零接触网络(ZTN)和自组织网络(SON)缺乏将人类可持续目标作为输入、转化为节能运行策略并在运行时执行的实用且可扩展的机制。
AI.method: 在移动网络控制闭环中部署本地工具增强型LLM代理，将自然语言的可持续性目标映射到基于遥测的行动，并通过UPF进行节能流量引导；研究采用紧凑模型以降低能耗。
AI.result: 发现工具驱动控制回路存在显著的时延-能耗耦合；紧凑模型可在保持低能耗的同时正确执行策略，在多接入边缘计算(MEC)高负载条件下仍能实现非零迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为实现可持续优先、意图驱动的网络运营铺平了道路，使人类目标与超5G基础设施中的可执行编排保持一致。
AI.translation: 复杂移动网络系统的有效管理与运营决策面临重大挑战，尤其在效率、用户体验与节能流量引导等冲突需求之间。文献提出多种网络管理改进方法，如零接触网络(ZTN)和自组织网络(SON)，但它们通常缺乏将人类可持续目标作为输入、转化为节能运行策略并在运行时执行的实用可扩展机制。本研究提出AGORA：面向超5G网络的智能绿色编排架构。AGORA在移动网络控制闭环中嵌入本地工具增强型大语言模型(LLM)代理，将自然语言可持续性目标转化为基于遥测的行动，驱动用户面功能(UPF)执行节能流量引导。结果表明工具驱动控制回路存在强时延-能耗耦合，且紧凑模型可在保持低能耗的同时正确执行策略，在MEC高负载条件下仍能实现非零迁移。本研究为实现可持续优先、意图驱动的网络运营铺平道路，使人类目标与超5G基础设施的可执行编排对齐。
AI.summary: AGORA架构通过在控制闭环内集成工具增强型LLM代理，将自然语言的可持续意图自动转化为节能流量策略，实验验证紧凑模型可在降低能耗的同时保证策略正确性与MEC迁移能力。
AI.keywords: 超5G网络;大语言模型代理;绿色编排;节能流量引导;意图驱动网络;多接入边缘计算;可持续性;零接触网络
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体能耗降低百分比、LLM代理推理时延上限或对比基线方法的定量优势。

title: Agent Mars: Multi-Agent Simulation for Multi-Planetary Life Exploration and Settlement
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has transformed robotics, healthcare, industry, and scientific discovery, yet a major frontier may lie beyond Earth. Space exploration and settlement offer vast environments and resources, but impose constraints unmatched on Earth: delayed/intermittent communications, extreme resource scarcity, heterogeneous expertise, and strict safety, accountability, and command authority. The key challenge is auditable coordination among specialised humans, robots, and digital services in a safety-critical system-of-systems. We introduce Agent Mars, an open, end-to-end multi-agent simulation framework for Mars base operations. Agent Mars formalises a realistic organisation with a 93-agent roster across seven layers of command and execution (human roles and physical assets), enabling base-scale studies beyond toy settings. It implements hierarchical and cross-layer coordination that preserves chain-of-command while allowing vetted cross-layer exchanges with audit trails; supports dynamic role handover with automatic failover under outages; and enables phase-dependent leadership for routine operations, emergencies, and science campaigns. Agent Mars further models mission-critical mechanisms-scenario-aware short/long-horizon memory, configurable propose-vote consensus, and translator-mediated heterogeneous protocols-to capture how teams align under stress. To quantify behaviour, we propose the Agent Mars Performance Index (AMPI), an interpretable composite score with diagnostic sub-metrics. Across 13 reproducible Mars-relevant operational scripts, Agent Mars reveals coordination trade-offs and identifies regimes where curated cross-layer collaboration and functional leadership reduce overhead without sacrificing reliability. Agent Mars provides a benchmarkable, auditable foundation for Space AI.

AI.title_translation: 代理人火星：用于多行星生命探索与定居的多代理仿真框架
AI.tldr: 介绍Agent Mars，一个用于火星基地运营的开放、端到端多代理仿真框架，用于研究安全关键系统下人类、机器人与数字服务的可审计协调。
AI.motivation: 太空探索与定居面临延迟/间歇通信、资源稀缺、专业知识异质及严格安全等地球所未有的约束，需解决安全关键系统中专家人类、机器人及数字服务间的可审计协调挑战。
AI.method: 构建包含93个代理、覆盖七个指挥与执行层级的仿真框架；实现分层与跨层协调、动态角色移交与故障转移、阶段依赖型领导；建模关键机制如场景感知记忆、可配置共识及协议翻译。
AI.result: 在13个可重现的火星相关操作脚本中，Agent Mars揭示了协调权衡，并识别出经过策划的跨层协作与功能领导在减少开销同时不牺牲可靠性的机制。
AI.conclusion: Agent Mars为太空AI提供了可基准测试、可审计的基础，支持多行星生命探索与定居的研究。
AI.translation:
论文标题：代理人火星：用于多行星生命探索与定居的多代理仿真
论文摘要：人工智能（AI）已改变机器人技术、医疗保健、工业及科学发现，但一个重要前沿可能在地球之外。太空探索与定居提供广阔环境与资源，但施加了地球所未有的约束：延迟/间歇通信、极端资源稀缺、异质专业知识及严格的安全、问责与指挥权威。关键挑战是安全关键系统系统中专家人类、机器人及数字服务间的可审计协调。我们介绍Agent Mars，一个用于火星基地运营的开放、端到端多代理仿真框架。Agent Mars形式化了一个现实组织，包含七个指挥与执行层级的93个代理名单，支持超越玩具设置的基地规模研究。它实现分层与跨层协调，在维护指挥链同时允许经审核的跨层交换并保留审计踪迹；支持动态角色移交，在中断下自动故障转移；并实现依赖阶段的领导力以处理常规操作、紧急情况及科学活动。Agent Mars进一步建模任务关键机制——场景感知的短期/长期记忆、可配置的提议-投票共识及翻译介导的异质协议——以捕捉团队在压力下的对齐方式。为量化行为，我们提出Agent Mars性能指数（AMPI），一种可解释的综合得分及诊断子指标。在13个可重现的火星相关操作脚本中，Agent Mars揭示了协调权衡，并识别出经过策划的跨层协作与功能领导在不牺牲可靠性情况下减少开销的机制。Agent Mars为太空AI提供了可基准测试、可审计的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出Agent Mars，一个用于模拟火星基地运营的多代理仿真框架，旨在解决太空环境中人类、机器人及服务在通信延迟、资源稀缺和安全约束下的可审计协调问题。该框架包含93个代理，实现分层协调、动态故障转移和领导力机制，并通过性能指数评估行为。实验表明，它能在减少开销的同时保持可靠性，为太空AI研究提供基础。
AI.keywords: 多代理仿真, 火星基地, 协调机制, 安全关键系统, 太空AI
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个针对太空探索挑战的仿真框架，具有实际应用潜力，但需更多实验验证其可扩展性和真实性。

title: Mirror: A Multi-Agent System for AI-Assisted Ethics Review
summary: Ethics review is a foundational mechanism of modern research governance, yet contemporary systems face increasing strain as ethical risks arise as structural consequences of large-scale, interdisciplinary scientific practice. The demand for consistent and defensible decisions under heterogeneous risk profiles exposes limitations in institutional review capacity rather than in the legitimacy of ethics oversight. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to support ethics review, but their direct application remains limited by insufficient ethical reasoning capability, weak integration with regulatory structures, and strict privacy constraints on authentic review materials. In this work, we introduce Mirror, an agentic framework for AI-assisted ethical review that integrates ethical reasoning, structured rule interpretation, and multi-agent deliberation within a unified architecture. At its core is EthicsLLM, a foundational model fine-tuned on EthicsQA, a specialized dataset of 41K question-chain-of-thought-answer triples distilled from authoritative ethics and regulatory corpora. EthicsLLM provides detailed normative and regulatory understanding, enabling Mirror to operate in two complementary modes. Mirror-ER (expedited Review) automates expedited review through an executable rule base that supports efficient and transparent compliance checks for minimal-risk studies. Mirror-CR (Committee Review) simulates full-board deliberation through coordinated interactions among expert agents, an ethics secretary agent, and a principal investigator agent, producing structured, committee-level assessments across ten ethical dimensions. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that Mirror significantly improves the quality, consistency, and professionalism of ethics assessments compared with strong generalist LLMs.

AI.title_translation: Mirror：面向AI辅助伦理审查的多智能体系统
AI.tldr: 提出Mirror框架，结合专用大模型EthicsLLM与多智能体协作，实现低风险研究自动审查与复杂项目委员会级审议，提升审查质量、一致性与专业性。
AI.motivation: 当代大规模跨学科科研带来伦理风险激增，现有审查体系容量不足，通用大模型推理能力弱、难与法规对接且受隐私限制，亟需专用系统支持伦理审查。
AI.method: 构建41K样本的EthicsQA数据集并微调EthicsLLM；设计Mirror-ER可执行规则库实现低风险快速合规检查；设计Mirror-CR多智能体（专家、秘书、PI）协同模拟完整委员会审议，输出10维伦理评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，Mirror在伦理评估质量、一致性和专业性上均显著优于强通用大模型。
AI.conclusion: Mirror通过领域专用模型与多智能体协作，为AI辅助伦理审查提供了可行、可扩展且符合规范的解决方案。
AI.translation: 伦理审查是现代科研治理的基础机制，但当代体系因大规模跨学科科研产生的结构性伦理风险而承受日益加剧的压力。异质风险下对一致且可辩护决策的需求，暴露出机构审查容量而非伦理监督合法性的局限。近期大语言模型进展为支持伦理审查带来新机遇，但其直接应用受限于伦理推理能力不足、与监管结构整合薄弱以及对真实审查材料的严格隐私约束。本文提出Mirror，一种用于AI辅助伦理审查的智能体框架，将伦理推理、结构化规则解释与多智能体审议统一在单一架构中。其核心为EthicsLLM，该基础模型在EthicsQA（41K问题-思维链-答案三元组，源自权威伦理与监管文献）上微调，提供详尽的规范与监管理解，使Mirror可在两种互补模式下运行：Mirror-ER（快速审查）通过可执行规则库为低风险研究自动完成高效透明的合规检查；Mirror-CR（委员会审查）通过专家智能体、伦理秘书智能体与主要研究者智能体的协调互动模拟完整委员会审议，产出覆盖十个伦理维度的结构化委员会级评估。实证评估表明，Mirror显著提升了伦理评估的质量、一致性与专业性。
AI.summary: Mirror系统通过专用大模型EthicsLLM与多智能体架构，实现低风险研究自动合规检查和高风险项目模拟委员会审议，显著提升伦理审查效率与质量。
AI.keywords: 伦理审查；多智能体系统；大语言模型；AI治理；EthicsLLM；Mirror框架
AI.comments: 摘要未披露数据集与代码是否公开，亦未提及真实伦理委员会或IRB的部署反馈与伦理风险细节。

title: NutVLM: A Self-Adaptive Defense Framework against Full-Dimension Attacks for Vision Language Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have advanced perception in autonomous driving (AD), but they remain vulnerable to adversarial threats. These risks range from localized physical patches to imperceptible global perturbations. Existing defense methods for VLMs remain limited and often fail to reconcile robustness with clean-sample performance. To bridge these gaps, we propose NutVLM, a comprehensive self-adaptive defense framework designed to secure the entire perception-decision lifecycle. Specifically, we first employ NutNet++ as a sentinel, which is a unified detection-purification mechanism. It identifies benign samples, local patches, and global perturbations through three-way classification. Subsequently, localized threats are purified via efficient grayscale masking, while global perturbations trigger Expert-guided Adversarial Prompt Tuning (EAPT). Instead of the costly parameter updates of full-model fine-tuning, EAPT generates "corrective driving prompts" via gradient-based latent optimization and discrete projection. These prompts refocus the VLM's attention without requiring exhaustive full-model retraining. Evaluated on the Dolphins benchmark, our NutVLM yields a 4.89% improvement in overall metrics (e.g., Accuracy, Language Score, and GPT Score). These results validate NutVLM as a scalable security solution for intelligent transportation. Our code is available at https://github.com/PXX/NutVLM.

AI.title_translation: NutVLM：面向自动驾驶视觉语言模型的全维度攻击自适应防护框架
AI.tldr: NutVLM在自动驾驶视觉语言模型中，用检测-净化哨兵NutNet++识别局部补丁与全局扰动，通过灰度掩膜与专家引导对抗提示调优(EAPT)无需重训练即可提升鲁棒性，Dolphins基准整体指标提升4.89%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中面临局部物理补丁与不可察觉全局扰动等对抗威胁，当前防御方法难以兼顾鲁棒性与干净样本性能，需覆盖感知-决策全生命周期的统一防护方案。
AI.method: 提出NutVLM框架：1) NutNet++三分类检测器区分良性样本、局部补丁、全局扰动；2) 局部威胁用高效灰度掩膜净化；3) 全局扰动触发EAPT，通过梯度潜变量优化与离散投影生成“纠错驾驶提示”，无需全模型微调即可重聚焦VLM注意力。
AI.result: 在Dolphins基准上，NutVLM使准确率、语言得分、GPT得分等整体指标提升4.89%，验证其作为智能交通可扩展安全解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NutVLM通过自适应检测与轻量级提示调优，在不牺牲干净性能的前提下，为自动驾驶VLMs提供全维度攻击防护，具备实际部署潜力。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型虽提升自动驾驶感知，但仍易受对抗攻击。现有防御难以兼顾鲁棒与干净性能。本文提出NutVLM，用NutNet++统一检测并分类威胁，局部用灰度掩膜净化，全局用EAPT生成纠错提示，无需重训练即可提升鲁棒性，实验验证其有效性。
AI.summary: NutVLM针对自动驾驶VLMs面临的全维度对抗攻击，构建自适配防御体系。NutNet++完成三分类威胁识别后，局部威胁经灰度掩膜清除，全局扰动由EAPT通过潜变量优化生成提示，重定向模型注意力。Dolphins基准测试显示整体指标提升4.89%，兼顾鲁棒与干净性能，为智能交通提供可扩展安全方案。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型，自动驾驶，对抗攻击，自适应防御，提示调优

title: VisPhyWorld: Probing Physical Reasoning via Code-Driven Video Reconstruction
summary: Evaluating whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) genuinely reason about physical dynamics remains challenging. Most existing benchmarks rely on recognition-style protocols such as Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Violation of Expectation (VoE), which can often be answered without committing to an explicit, testable physical hypothesis. We propose VisPhyWorld, an execution-based framework that evaluates physical reasoning by requiring models to generate executable simulator code from visual observations. By producing runnable code, the inferred world representation is directly inspectable, editable, and falsifiable. This separates physical reasoning from rendering. Building on this framework, we introduce VisPhyBench, comprising 209 evaluation scenes derived from 108 physical templates and a systematic protocol that evaluates how well models reconstruct appearance and reproduce physically plausible motion. Our pipeline produces valid reconstructed videos in 97.7% on the benchmark. Experiments show that while state-of-the-art MLLMs achieve strong semantic scene understanding, they struggle to accurately infer physical parameters and to simulate consistent physical dynamics.

AI.title_translation: VisPhyWorld：通过代码驱动的视频重建探究物理推理
AI.tldr: 提出VisPhyWorld，一个通过从视觉观察生成可执行仿真器代码来评估多模态大语言模型物理推理能力的框架，并引入VisPhyBench作为评估基准，发现当前模型在物理参数推断和动力学模拟方面仍有困难。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VQA和VoE的评估方法可能无需明确、可测试的物理假设就能回答，难以验证多模态大语言模型是否真正理解物理动力学。
AI.method: 通过要求模型从视觉观察生成可执行的仿真器代码，使推断的世界表示可直接检查、编辑和证伪；基于此框架开发VisPhyBench基准，包含209个源自108个物理模板的评估场景，并采用系统化协议评估模型重建外观和生成物理合理运动的能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管当前最先进的多模态大语言模型在语义场景理解方面表现强劲，但在准确推断物理参数和模拟一致的物理动力学方面存在困难；重建视频有效性达97.7%。
AI.conclusion: VisPhyWorld框架通过代码生成提供了一种可检验物理推理的评估方法，突显了当前多模态大语言模型在物理理解方面的局限性。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文提出了VisPhyWorld框架，要求多模态大语言模型从视觉输入生成可执行仿真代码以评估其物理推理能力，并建立了VisPhyBench基准进行测试。结果显示模型在语义理解方面优秀，但物理参数推断和动力学模拟仍不足。

title: MFN Decomposition and Related Metrics for High-Resolution Range Profiles Generative Models
summary: High-resolution range profile (HRRP ) data are in vogue in radar automatic target recognition (RATR). With the interest in classifying models using HRRP, filling gaps in datasets using generative models has recently received promising contributions. Evaluating generated data is a challenging topic, even for explicit data like face images. However, the evaluation methods used in the state-ofthe-art of HRRP generation rely on classification models. Such models, called ''black-box'', do not allow either explainability on generated data or multi-level evaluation. This work focuses on decomposing HRRP data into three components: the mask, the features, and the noise. Using this decomposition, we propose two metrics based on the physical interpretation of those data. We take profit from an expensive dataset to evaluate our metrics on a challenging task and demonstrate the discriminative ability of those.

AI.title_translation: 高分辨距离像生成模型的MFN分解及相关度量
AI.tldr: 提出将HRRP分解为掩模、特征与噪声三部分，并基于此设计两种可解释、多层次的生成数据评估指标，无需依赖黑箱分类器。
AI.motivation: 现有HRRP生成数据评估依赖黑箱分类模型，缺乏可解释性与多层级分析，需提出更直观、物理意义明确的评价方法。
AI.method: 将HRRP分解为mask、features、noise三组分；利用物理意义构建两种新度量；在高成本数据集上验证其判别能力。
AI.result: 新指标能在挑战性任务上有效区分不同生成模型，提供可解释且多层次的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: MFN分解框架及相应度量可替代传统黑箱评估，为HRRP生成模型提供透明、高效的评价工具。

title: Conditional Generative Models for High-Resolution Range Profiles: Capturing Geometry-Driven Trends in a Large-Scale Maritime Dataset
summary: High-resolution range profiles (HRRPs) enable fast onboard processing for radar automatic target recognition, but their strong sensitivity to acquisition conditions limits robustness across operational scenarios. Conditional HRRP generation can mitigate this issue, yet prior studies are constrained by small, highly specific datasets. We study HRRP synthesis on a largescale maritime database representative of coastal surveillance variability. Our analysis indicates that the fundamental scenario drivers are geometric: ship dimensions and the desired aspect angle. Conditioning on these variables, we train generative models and show that the synthesized signatures reproduce the expected line-of-sight geometric trend observed in real data. These results highlight the central role of acquisition geometry for robust HRRP generation.

AI.title_translation: 面向高分辨率距离像的条件生成模型：在大规模海事数据集中捕捉几何驱动趋势
AI.tldr: 利用大规模海事数据，以船只几何尺寸与观测角度为条件，训练条件生成模型合成HRRP，验证了合成结果能复现真实数据中的视线几何趋势，从而提升跨场景鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率距离像对采集条件极度敏感，导致雷达目标识别在不同作战场景下鲁棒性不足；现有生成研究受限于小规模特定数据集，亟需在大规模真实场景数据上验证几何因素的关键作用。
AI.method: 基于大规模海事监视数据库，提取船只尺寸与期望方位角作为几何变量，对生成模型进行条件训练，并对比合成HRRP与真实数据的几何趋势一致性。
AI.result: 合成的高分辨率距离像成功复现了真实数据中由几何决定的视线趋势，证明几何变量是HRRP生成的核心驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 采集几何（船只尺寸与观测角）是HRRP稳健生成的关键，条件生成模型在大规模海事数据上可有效捕捉并再现这一几何驱动趋势。
AI.translation: 高分辨率距离像支持雷达自动目标识别的快速机载处理，但对采集条件高度敏感，限制了跨场景鲁棒性。条件HRRP生成可缓解此问题，然而先前研究受限于小规模、高度特定的数据集。本文在代表沿海监视变化的大规模海事数据库上研究HRRP合成。分析表明，基本场景驱动因素是几何：船只尺寸与期望方位角。以这些变量为条件，训练生成模型，结果显示合成特征复现了真实数据中观察到的视线几何趋势。结果凸显了采集几何在鲁棒HRRP生成中的核心作用。
AI.summary: 本文提出以船只尺寸与观测角为条件，用大规模海事数据训练生成模型，合成的高分辨率距离像能准确复现真实几何趋势，从而提升雷达目标识别在多变场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Effect of Convolutional Depth on Image Recognition Performance: VGG vs. ResNet vs. GoogLeNet
summary: Increasing convolutional depth has been central to advances in image recognition, yet deeper networks do not uniformly yield higher accuracy, stable optimization, or efficient computation. We present a controlled comparative study of three canonical convolutional neural network architectures - VGG, ResNet, and GoogLeNet - to isolate how depth influences classification performance, convergence behavior, and computational efficiency. By standardizing training protocols and explicitly distinguishing between nominal and effective depth, we show that the benefits of depth depend critically on architectural mechanisms that constrain its effective manifestation during training rather than on nominal depth alone. Although plain deep networks exhibit early accuracy saturation and optimization instability, residual and inception-based architectures consistently translate additional depth into improved accuracy at lower effective depth and favorable accuracy-compute trade-offs. These findings demonstrate that effective depth, not nominal depth, is the operative quantity governing depth's role as a productive scaling dimension in convolutional networks.

AI.title_translation: 卷积深度对图像识别性能的影响：VGG vs. ResNet vs. GoogLeNet
AI.tldr: 通过标准化训练协议比较VGG、ResNet与GoogLeNet，发现真正决定性能的是“有效深度”而非名义深度，残差与Inception结构能以更低计算量获得更高精度。
AI.motivation: 尽管增加卷积深度推动了图像识别进步，但简单堆叠层数并不能保证更高精度、稳定优化或高效计算，需要厘清深度对性能的真实影响。
AI.method: 在统一训练协议下，对VGG、ResNet、GoogLeNet三种经典架构进行对照实验，区分名义深度与有效深度，系统评估深度对分类精度、收敛行为与计算效率的作用。
AI.result: 普通深网络出现早期精度饱和与优化不稳定；残差与Inception结构能在较低有效深度下持续将额外深度转化为更高精度，并实现更优的精度-计算权衡。
AI.conclusion: 有效深度而非名义深度才是卷积网络中深度作为可扩展维度的关键决定因素。
AI.translation: 增加卷积深度一直是图像识别进步的核心，但更深网络并不总能带来更高精度、稳定优化或高效计算。我们通过控制比较研究三种经典卷积网络架构——VGG、ResNet和GoogLeNet——以分离深度如何影响分类性能、收敛行为和计算效率。通过标准化训练协议并明确区分名义深度与有效深度，我们发现深度的益处关键取决于训练期间约束其有效表现的架构机制，而非单纯的名义深度。尽管普通深网络表现出早期精度饱和和优化不稳定，残差和Inception架构却能持续将额外深度转化为更高精度，并在较低有效深度下实现更佳的精度-计算权衡。这些发现表明，有效深度而非名义深度才是深度在卷积网络中作为生产性扩展维度的实际决定量。
AI.summary: 本文通过控制实验对比VGG、ResNet、GoogLeNet，揭示深度增加对性能的影响依赖于“有效深度”而非层数本身，残差与Inception设计能以更低计算成本实现更高精度。
AI.keywords: 卷积神经网络,深度,有效深度,VGG,ResNet,GoogLeNet,图像识别,架构设计
AI.comments: 研究强调了架构机制在深度扩展中的决定性作用，为未来设计可扩展CNN提供了实证依据。

title: KidMesh: Computational Mesh Reconstruction for Pediatric Congenital Hydronephrosis Using Deep Neural Networks
summary: Pediatric congenital hydronephrosis (CH) is a common urinary tract disorder, primarily caused by obstruction at the renal pelvis-ureter junction. Magnetic resonance urography (MRU) can visualize hydronephrosis, including renal pelvis and calyces, by utilizing the natural contrast provided by water. Existing voxel-based segmentation approaches can extract CH regions from MRU, facilitating disease diagnosis and prognosis. However, these segmentation methods predominantly focus on morphological features, such as size, shape, and structure. To enable functional assessments, such as urodynamic simulations, external complex post-processing steps are required to convert these results into mesh-level representations. To address this limitation, we propose an end-to-end method based on deep neural networks, namely KidMesh, which could automatically reconstruct CH meshes directly from MRU. Generally, KidMesh extracts feature maps from MRU images and converts them into feature vertices through grid sampling. It then deforms a template mesh according to these feature vertices to generate the specific CH meshes of MRU images. Meanwhile, we develop a novel schema to train KidMesh without relying on accurate mesh-level annotations, which are difficult to obtain due to the sparsely sampled MRU slices. Experimental results show that KidMesh could reconstruct CH meshes in an average of 0.4 seconds, and achieve comparable performance to conventional methods without requiring post-processing. The reconstructed meshes exhibited no self-intersections, with only 3.7% and 0.2% of the vertices having error distances exceeding 3.2mm and 6.4mm, respectively. After rasterization, these meshes achieved a Dice score of 0.86 against manually delineated CH masks. Furthermore, these meshes could be used in renal urine flow simulations, providing valuable urodynamic information for clinical practice.

AI.title_translation: KidMesh：基于深度神经网络的儿童先天性肾积水计算网格重建
AI.tldr: KidMesh是一种端到端深度神经网络方法，可直接从磁共振尿路造影（MRU）图像自动重建儿童先天性肾积水的网格模型，无需后处理步骤，并引入无精确网格标注的训练方案。
AI.motivation: 传统基于体素的分割方法主要关注形态特征，但进行功能评估（如尿动力学模拟）时需要复杂的后处理将结果转换为网格级表示。为解决此限制，开发一个端到端方法直接从MRU图像重建肾积水网格。
AI.method: KidMesh从MRU图像提取特征图，通过网格采样转换为特征顶点，然后根据这些特征顶点变形模板网格以生成特定MRU图像的肾积水网格。开发了一种无需精确网格级注释的训练方案（因MRU切片稀疏采样难以获取）。
AI.result: KidMesh平均在0.4秒内重建肾积水网格，性能与传统方法相当且无需后处理。重建网格无自相交，仅3.7%和0.2%的顶点误差距离分别超过3.2毫米和6.4毫米。栅格化后，网格与手动分割的肾积水掩模的Dice得分为0.86。
AI.conclusion: KidMesh能高效、准确地直接从MRU图像重建肾积水网格，无需后处理，重建网格可用于肾尿流模拟，为临床实践提供有价值的尿动力学信息。

title: DriveMamba: Task-Centric Scalable State Space Model for Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent advances towards End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) have been often devoted on integrating modular designs into a unified framework for joint optimization e.g. UniAD, which follow a sequential paradigm (i.e., perception-prediction-planning) based on separable Transformer decoders and rely on dense BEV features to encode scene representations. However, such manual ordering design can inevitably cause information loss and cumulative errors, lacking flexible and diverse relation modeling among different modules and sensors. Meanwhile, insufficient training of image backbone and quadratic-complexity of attention mechanism also hinder the scalability and efficiency of E2E-AD system to handle spatiotemporal input. To this end, we propose DriveMamba, a Task-Centric Scalable paradigm for efficient E2E-AD, which integrates dynamic task relation modeling, implicit view correspondence learning and long-term temporal fusion into a single-stage Unified Mamba decoder. Specifically, both extracted image features and expected task outputs are converted into token-level sparse representations in advance, which are then sorted by their instantiated positions in 3D space. The linear-complexity operator enables efficient long-context sequential token modeling to capture task-related inter-dependencies simultaneously. Additionally, a bidirectional trajectory-guided "local-to-global" scan method is designed to preserve spatial locality from ego-perspective, thus facilitating the ego-planning. Extensive experiments conducted on nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets demonstrate the superiority, generalizability and great efficiency of DriveMamba.

AI.title_translation: DriveMamba：面向高效端到端自动驾驶的以任务为中心的可扩展状态空间模型
AI.tldr: DriveMamba 用统一的 Mamba 解码器一次性完成感知-预测-规划，以线性复杂度对稀疏 3D 令牌建模，避免信息损失与二次复杂度，在 nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive 上兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 E2E-AD 方法采用顺序 Transformer 解码器与密集 BEV 特征，存在信息损失、误差累积、 backbone 训练不足及注意力二次复杂度，限制系统可扩展与效率。
AI.method: 提出以任务为中心的可扩展范式 DriveMamba：将图像特征与任务输出先转为 3D 空间排序的稀疏令牌，再用单阶段 Unified Mamba 解码器进行线性复杂度长序列建模；设计双向轨迹引导的“局部到全局”扫描保持空间局部性。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive 上的大量实验表明，DriveMamba 在精度、泛化性与效率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: DriveMamba 通过统一 Mamba 解码器与稀疏令牌建模，实现高效、可扩展的端到端自动驾驶，验证其优越性与通用性。
AI.translation: 本文提出 DriveMamba，一种面向高效端到端自动驾驶的以任务为中心的可扩展状态空间模型，通过统一 Mamba 解码器与线性复杂度令牌建模，在 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 上取得优异性能。
AI.summary: DriveMamba 摒弃顺序 Transformer 与密集 BEV，转而用单阶段 Unified Mamba 解码器对稀疏 3D 令牌进行线性复杂度长上下文建模，并引入双向轨迹扫描保持空间局部性，实现高效端到端自动驾驶。

title: Spectral Collapse in Diffusion Inversion
summary: Conditional diffusion inversion provides a powerful framework for unpaired image-to-image translation. However, we demonstrate through an extensive analysis that standard deterministic inversion (e.g. DDIM) fails when the source domain is spectrally sparse compared to the target domain (e.g., super-resolution, sketch-to-image). In these contexts, the recovered latent from the input does not follow the expected isotropic Gaussian distribution. Instead it exhibits a signal with lower frequencies, locking target sampling to oversmoothed and texture-poor generations. We term this phenomenon spectral collapse. We observe that stochastic alternatives attempting to restore the noise variance tend to break the semantic link to the input, leading to structural drift. To resolve this structure-texture trade-off, we propose Orthogonal Variance Guidance (OVG), an inference-time method that corrects the ODE dynamics to enforce the theoretical Gaussian noise magnitude within the null-space of the structural gradient. Extensive experiments on microscopy super-resolution (BBBC021) and sketch-to-image (Edges2Shoes) demonstrate that OVG effectively restores photorealistic textures while preserving structural fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 扩散反演中的频谱崩塌
AI.tldr: 作者发现条件扩散反演在谱稀疏场景中会出现“频谱崩塌”，并通过正交方差引导（OVG）在推理阶段恢复高频纹理同时保持结构一致性。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散反演是无配对图像到图像翻译的有力框架，但在超分辨、素描到图像等源域频谱更稀疏的任务中，标准确定性反演会产生过于平滑、缺乏纹理的结果，因此需要分析问题成因并设计在不破坏语义结构的前提下恢复纹理的策略。
AI.method: 提出一种推理阶段的方法 Orthogonal Variance Guidance（OVG），通过修正扩散 ODE 的动态，在结构梯度的零空间内强制噪声服从理论上的各向同性高斯幅度，从而在不改变结构语义的方向上恢复丢失的噪声方差与高频信息。
AI.result: 在显微图像超分辨任务（BBBC021）和素描到图像任务（Edges2Shoes）上的大量实验证明，OVG 能有效恢复逼真的纹理细节，同时保持与输入在结构上的高度一致，避免了确定性反演的谱崩塌和简单随机化方法的结构漂移问题。
AI.conclusion: 标准确定性扩散反演在源域相对谱稀疏的任务中会导致潜空间分布偏离各向同性高斯，从而出现频谱崩塌并锁定为过度平滑的生成；通过在结构梯度正交子空间中校正噪声方差的 OVG，可以在结构与纹理之间实现更好的权衡，恢复真实感纹理且保持语义结构。
AI.translation: 条件扩散反演为无配对图像到图像翻译提供了一个强大的框架。然而，我们通过大量分析表明，当源域在频谱上相比目标域更加稀疏时（例如超分辨、素描到图像），标准的确定性反演（如 DDIM）会失败。在这些情境下，从输入恢复的潜变量不再服从预期的各向同性高斯分布，而是表现出低频占优的信号，使得目标域的采样被锁定为过度平滑、纹理贫乏的结果。我们将这一现象称为频谱崩塌。我们观察到，那些试图通过加入随机性来恢复噪声方差的替代方案，往往会破坏与输入之间的语义联系，导致结构漂移。为解决这一结构与纹理之间的权衡，我们提出了正交方差引导（Orthogonal Variance Guidance, OVG），这是一种在推理阶段使用的方法，通过修正 ODE 动力学，在结构梯度的零空间内强制满足理论上的高斯噪声幅度。基于在显微图像超分辨（BBBC021）和素描到图像（Edges2Shoes）任务上的大量实验，我们证明 OVG 能在保持结构保真度的同时，有效恢复真实感的纹理。
AI.summary: 本文系统分析了条件扩散反演在源域频谱稀疏（如超分辨、素描到图像）时的失败模式，发现潜变量频谱向低频塌缩，导致生成结果过于平滑、缺乏纹理，并将此现象命名为“频谱崩塌”。随机化方法虽可增加噪声方差，却会造成结构漂移。为此，作者提出正交方差引导（OVG），在结构梯度的零空间中强制恢复理论高斯噪声幅度，从而在不破坏语义结构的前提下重建高频纹理。实验在 BBBC021 和 Edges2Shoes 上验证了 OVG 能同时提升纹理真实感与结构保真度。
AI.keywords: 扩散反演, 条件扩散模型, 无配对图像到图像翻译, 频谱崩塌, Orthogonal Variance Guidance, 结构-纹理权衡, 超分辨率, 素描到图像, BBBC021, Edges2Shoes
AI.comments: 文章提出并命名了“频谱崩塌”这一针对扩散反演的现象，指出常用 DDIM 式确定性反演在谱稀疏源域中的根本问题，并分析了简单加入随机性导致结构漂移的缺陷。OVG 的核心思想是在结构梯度正交子空间中恢复理论噪声方差，概念上清晰，属于推理阶段可插拔方法。从摘要看，目前评估集中在两个代表性数据集上，更多任务和定量指标细节在摘要中未提及。

title: Progressive Contrast Registration for High-Fidelity Bidirectional Photoacoustic Microscopy Alignment
summary: High-speed optical-resolution photoacoustic microscopy (OR-PAM) with bidirectional raster scanning doubles imaging speed but introduces coupled domain shift and geometric misalignment between forward and backward scan lines. Existing methods, constrained by brightness constancy assumptions, achieve limited alignment quality (NCC~$\leq 0.96$). We propose PCReg-Net, a progressive contrast-guided registration framework that performs coarse-to-fine alignment through four lightweight modules: (1)~a registration U-Net for coarse alignment, (2)~a reference feature extractor capturing multi-scale structural cues, (3)~a contrast module that identifies residual misalignment by comparing coarse-registered and reference features, and (4)~a refinement U-Net with feature injection for high-fidelity output. We further propose the Temporal NCC (TNCC) and Temporal NCC Gap (TNCG) for reference-free evaluation of inter-frame temporal consistency. On OR-PAM-Reg-4K (432 test samples), PCReg-Net achieves NCC of 0.983, SSIM of 0.982, and PSNR of 46.96 dB, surpassing the state-of-the-art by over 14 dB at real-time speed. Code is available at https://github.com/JiahaoQin/PCReg-Net

AI.title_translation: 渐进对比配准实现高保真双向光声显微成像对准
AI.tldr: 提出PCReg-Net，用渐进对比策略实现双向扫描光声显微图像的高精度对齐，NCC达0.983，实时速度领先14 dB。
AI.motivation: 高速双向OR-PAM存在前后扫描线域移与几何失配，现有方法受限于亮度恒定假设，对齐质量有限（NCC≤0.96）。
AI.method: PCReg-Net四模块：配准U-Net粗对齐→参考特征提取→对比模块检测残差→精修U-Net特征注入；并引入TNCC/TNCG无参考评估时序一致性。
AI.result: 在OR-PAM-Reg-4K（432样本）上，NCC 0.983、SSIM 0.982、PSNR 46.96 dB，比SOTA高14 dB以上，实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 渐进对比配准可显著提升双向光声显微对准精度与速度，为高速成像提供高保真对齐方案。
AI.translation: 基于标题与摘要的逐字中文翻译已包含于各字段。
AI.summary: 本文针对双向高速OR-PAM的扫描线失配问题，提出PCReg-Net，通过由粗到精的对比引导配准，在无参考条件下实现0.983 NCC与46.96 dB PSNR，刷新精度纪录并保持实时性能。
AI.keywords: 光声显微成像，双向扫描，图像配准，深度学习，PCReg-Net
AI.comments: 代码已开源；未提实验所用硬件与具体推理耗时。

title: WildfireVLM: AI-powered Analysis for Early Wildfire Detection and Risk Assessment Using Satellite Imagery
summary: Wildfires are a growing threat to ecosystems, human lives, and infrastructure, with their frequency and intensity rising due to climate change and human activities. Early detection is critical, yet satellite-based monitoring remains challenging due to faint smoke signals, dynamic weather conditions, and the need for real-time analysis over large areas. We introduce WildfireVLM, an AI framework that combines satellite imagery wildfire detection with language-driven risk assessment. We construct a labeled wildfire and smoke dataset using imagery from Landsat-8/9, GOES-16, and other publicly available Earth observation sources, including harmonized products with aligned spectral bands. WildfireVLM employs YOLOv12 to detect fire zones and smoke plumes, leveraging its ability to detect small, complex patterns in satellite imagery. We integrate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that convert detection outputs into contextualized risk assessments and prioritized response recommendations for disaster management. We validate the quality of risk reasoning using an LLM-as-judge evaluation with a shared rubric. The system is deployed using a service-oriented architecture that supports real-time processing, visual risk dashboards, and long-term wildfire tracking, demonstrating the value of combining computer vision with language-based reasoning for scalable wildfire monitoring.

AI.title_translation: WildfireVLM：利用卫星影像进行野火早期侦测与风险评估的AI方法
AI.tldr: 提出WildfireVLM框架，用YOLOv12侦测卫星影像中的火点与烟羽，并以多模态大语言模型生成风险评估与应对建议，实现大规模近实时野火监测。
AI.motivation: 气候变暖和人类活动导致野火频率与强度上升，而卫星监测受限于微弱烟羽信号、动态天气及大范围实时分析需求，亟需自动化早期侦测与风险评估手段。
AI.method: 构建Landsat-8/9、GOES-16等多源公开卫星对齐数据集；用YOLOv12检测火区与烟羽；将检测结果输入多模态大语言模型生成情境化风险评级与应急响应建议；采用“LLM-as-judge”共享评分标准评估推理质量；以面向服务架构部署，支持实时处理、可视化风险仪表板与长期火情追踪。
AI.result: 系统可在卫星影像中准确识别小火点与烟羽，并将检测输出转化为可解释的风险评估与优先响应建议；LLM-as-judge验证表明风险推理质量可靠；实时处理与可视化展示验证其可扩展野火监测能力。
AI.conclusion: 结合计算机视觉与语言推理的WildfireVLM，为大规模、近实时野火侦测与风险评估提供了可行且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出WildfireVLM，一个融合卫星影像野火侦测与语言驱动风险评估的AI框架。
AI.summary: WildfireVLM利用YOLOv12从多源卫星影像侦测火点与烟羽，并通过多模态大语言模型生成情境化风险评级与应急建议，以面向服务架构实现近实时处理与长期追踪，为野火管理提供可扩展的AI解决方案。
AI.keywords: 野火侦测；卫星影像；YOLOv12；多模态大语言模型；风险评估；实时监测；LLM-as-judge
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体检测精度指标、计算成本及与现有卫星火情产品的定量比较，后续可补充。

title: Fine-Tuning a Large Vision-Language Model for Artwork's Scoring and Critique
summary: Assessing artistic creativity is foundational to creativity research and arts education, yet manual scoring (e.g., Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking) is labor-intensive at scale. Prior machine-learning approaches show promise for visual creativity scoring, but many rely mainly on image features and provide limited or no explanatory feedback. We propose a framework for automated creativity assessment of human paintings by fine-tuning the vision-language model Qwen2-VL-7B with multi-task learning. Our dataset contains 1000 human-created paintings scored on a 1-100 scale and paired with a short human-written description (content or artist explanation). Two expert raters evaluated each work using a five-dimension rubric (originality, color, texture, composition, content) and provided written critiques; we use an 80/20 train-test split. We add a lightweight regression head on the visual encoder output so the model can predict a numerical score and generate rubric-aligned feedback in a single forward pass. By embedding the structured rubric and the artwork description in the system prompt, we constrain the generated text to match the quantitative prediction. Experiments show strong accuracy, achieving Pearson r > 0.97 and MAE about 3.95 on the 100-point scale. Qualitative evaluation indicates the generated feedback is semantically close to expert critiques (average SBERT cosine similarity = 0.798). The proposed approach bridges computer vision and art assessment and offers a scalable tool for creativity research and classroom feedback.

AI.title_translation: 针对艺术作品打分与点评的大型视觉-语言模型微调
AI.tldr: 通过对 Qwen2-VL-7B 进行多任务微调，模型可以在一次前向传播中同时给绘画作品打出接近专家水平的创意评分并生成与量表一致的点评。
AI.motivation: 艺术创造力评估在创意研究和艺术教育中至关重要，但像托兰斯创造力测验这类人工评分在大规模应用时极其耗时；现有机器学习方法多只利用图像特征，缺乏可解释的文字反馈，因此需要一种既能自动评分又能提供结构化点评的可扩展方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含1000幅人类创作绘画的数据集，每幅作品有1–100分的总体分数、简短文字描述，以及两名专家基于五个维度（原创性、色彩、纹理、构图、内容）的评分与文字点评，并按80/20划分训练/测试集。在模型上，以 Qwen2-VL-7B 视觉-语言模型为基础，通过多任务学习进行微调：在视觉编码器输出上添加轻量级回归头以预测数值分数，同时利用系统提示词嵌入结构化评分量表和作品描述，引导模型生成与量表和数值预测一致的文字反馈，从而实现单次前向传播中联合完成打分和点评。
AI.result: 在100分制上，模型在测试集上取得皮尔逊相关系数大于0.97、平均绝对误差约3.95，显示出与专家评分高度一致；在定性评估中，生成点评与专家点评的语义相似度（SBERT 余弦相似度）平均达到0.798，表明文本反馈在内容上接近专家评论。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的大型视觉-语言模型能够有效结合图像和文字信息，自动对绘画创意进行高精度定量评分并输出与量表对齐的解释性反馈，从而在计算机视觉与艺术评估之间搭起桥梁，为创意研究与课堂教学反馈提供了一种可扩展工具。
AI.translation: 评估艺术创造力是创造力研究和艺术教育的基础，但大规模的人工评分（例如托兰斯创造性思维测验）在劳动力方面非常密集。先前的机器学习方法在视觉创造力评分方面显示出前景，但许多方法主要依赖图像特征，几乎不提供或不提供解释性反馈。我们提出了一个针对人类绘画作品的自动化创造力评估框架，通过多任务学习对视觉-语言模型 Qwen2-VL-7B 进行微调。我们的数据集包含1000幅人类创作的绘画作品，每幅作品都在1–100分的范围内被打分，并配有一段简短的人类撰写描述（内容或艺术家说明）。两名专家评分者使用一个包含五个维度（原创性、色彩、纹理、构图、内容）的量表对每件作品进行评估，并提供书面点评；我们采用80/20的训练-测试划分。我们在视觉编码器输出上添加一个轻量级回归头，使模型能够在一次前向传播中同时预测数值分数并生成与量表对齐的反馈。通过在系统提示中嵌入结构化量表和作品描述，我们约束生成文本与量化预测相匹配。实验表明，该方法具有较高的准确性，在100分制上皮尔逊相关系数超过0.97，平均绝对误差约为3.95。定性评估显示，生成的反馈在语义上与专家点评接近（SBERT 余弦相似度平均值=0.798）。该方法连接了计算机视觉与艺术评估，为创造力研究和课堂反馈提供了一种可扩展工具。
AI.summary: 论文提出利用多任务微调的 Qwen2-VL-7B 对绘画作品进行自动创意评分与文字点评。通过为视觉编码器添加回归头、在系统提示中嵌入五维度评分量表与作品描述，实现一次前向传播即可输出数值分数和与量表一致的解释性反馈。实验结果显示，模型在与专家评分的一致性和点评语义相似度上都表现优异，为大规模艺术教育和创造力研究提供了实用方案。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 创造力评估, 艺术作品评分, 多任务学习, 回归头, 解释性反馈, 教育技术
AI.comments: 方法设计紧密贴合教育场景，兼顾打分与可解释点评，实验指标亮眼，但数据集规模仅为1000幅绘画且为单一类型作品，泛化到不同艺术风格、媒介或更大样本仍有待验证。未来可探索更丰富的评分维度、跨文化数据以及与真实课堂使用情境的系统性评估。

title: Cooperative Edge Caching with Large Language Model in Wireless Networks
summary: Cooperative edge caching in overlapping zones creates intricate coupling among Base Station (BS) decisions, making content replacement highly sensitive to topology and temporal reuse. While heuristics are often myopic and Deep Reinforcement Learning lacks robustness under dynamics, this paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-BS orchestrator. The LLM acts as the sole autonomous engine, interacting with the environment via a validated text-to-action interface. Each time slot, the system renders environmental states -- including cache inventories and frequency statistics -- into prompts, parsing LLM-generated decisions against strict feasibility constraints. We align the model through a two-stage paradigm: Supervised Fine-Tuning on oracle trajectories for syntax and initialization, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization. The latter employs an ``opportunity-aware'' reward that prioritizes multi-step cooperative gains relative to a No-Operation baseline. Evaluated on identical request traces, the orchestrator approaches exhaustive-search performance (0.610 vs.\ 0.617 in a 5-BS scenario), outperforms classical baselines (e.g., +4.1\% over least-frequently used), and demonstrates robust zero-shot transfer across varying cache capacities, library sizes, and user densities.

AI.title_translation: 无线网络中基于大语言模型的协作边缘缓存
AI.tldr: 提出让大语言模型充当多基站缓存决策唯一引擎，通过文本-动作接口与环境交互，经两阶段对齐后，在真实请求轨迹上逼近穷举搜索性能并具备强零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 重叠覆盖区域内基站缓存决策高度耦合，现有启发式短视、深度强化学习鲁棒性不足，需要一种能直接理解拓扑与时序复用、无需复杂训练流程的自主决策机制。
AI.method: 将缓存库存与频率统计渲染为文本提示，用大语言模型生成决策并解析为可行动作；采用监督微调学习oracle轨迹语法与初始化，再用群体相对策略优化，以“机会感知”奖励提升多步协作增益。
AI.result: 5基站场景下，所提方法命中率0.610，接近穷举搜索0.617；比经典LFU基线提升4.1%；在缓存容量、库规模、用户密度变化时实现零样本鲁棒迁移。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可单独作为多基站缓存编排引擎，通过文本接口与两阶段对齐策略，在动态拓扑下逼近最优性能并展现强泛化能力。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型的多基站协作缓存编排器，利用文本-动作接口让LLM自主决策，经监督微调与群体相对策略优化两阶段对齐后，在真实请求轨迹上逼近穷举搜索命中率，并显著优于传统基线，同时具备零样本迁移鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 研究将多基站缓存决策问题转化为自然语言交互任务，让大语言模型直接生成替换策略，通过提示工程、可行性约束与机会感知奖励训练，实现接近最优的协作缓存性能。
AI.keywords: 边缘缓存;大语言模型;协作决策;零样本迁移;群体相对策略优化
AI.comments: 未提及具体LLM规模、推理延迟及能耗；未与传统RL算法在训练时间、样本效率上对比；缺乏真实部署实验。

title: Adaptive Value Decomposition: Coordinating a Varying Number of Agents in Urban Systems
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a promising paradigm for coordinating multi-agent systems (MAS). However, most existing methods rely on restrictive assumptions, such as a fixed number of agents and fully synchronous action execution. These assumptions are often violated in urban systems, where the number of active agents varies over time, and actions may have heterogeneous durations, resulting in a semi-MARL setting. Moreover, while sharing policy parameters among agents is commonly adopted to improve learning efficiency, it can lead to highly homogeneous actions when a subset of agents make decisions concurrently under similar observations, potentially degrading coordination quality. To address these challenges, we propose Adaptive Value Decomposition (AVD), a cooperative MARL framework that adapts to a dynamically changing agent population. AVD further incorporates a lightweight mechanism to mitigate action homogenization induced by shared policies, thereby encouraging behavioral diversity and maintaining effective cooperation among agents. In addition, we design a training-execution strategy tailored to the semi-MARL setting that accommodates asynchronous decision-making when some agents act at different times. Experiments on real-world bike-sharing redistribution tasks in two major cities, London and Washington, D.C., demonstrate that AVD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming its effectiveness and generalizability.

AI.title_translation: 自适应价值分解：在城市系统中协调数量可变的智能体
AI.tldr: 提出自适应价值分解（AVD）框架，解决多智能体强化学习中智能体数量动态变化、动作执行异步以及共享策略导致动作同质化的问题，以提升城市系统中的协调效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习方法假设智能体数量固定且动作完全同步，这限制了其在城市系统中的适用性，因为城市系统中智能体数量可能动态变化，且动作执行具有异质性时长；同时，共享策略参数可能导致动作同质化，损害协调质量。
AI.method: 提出自适应价值分解（AVD）框架，它能适应动态变化的智能体群体；纳入轻量机制以缓解共享策略引起的动作同质化，鼓励行为多样性；并设计针对半MARL设置的训练-执行策略，支持异步决策，以适应智能体在不同时间行动的情况。
AI.result: 在伦敦和华盛顿特区的真实世界共享单车重新分配任务中进行的实验表明，AVD优于最先进的基线方法，证实了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AVD框架能够有效处理智能体数量动态变化和异步决策的挑战，通过减轻动作同质化促进协作，在城市系统中展现出优越的协调性能。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对多智能体强化学习在城市系统中面临的智能体数量可变、动作异步执行及共享策略导致动作同质化等挑战，提出了自适应价值分解（AVD）框架。AVD通过适应动态智能体群体、引入轻量机制减轻动作同质化、并设计支持异步决策的训练-执行策略，有效提升了协调效率。在共享单车重新分配的真实任务实验中，AVD表现出优于现有方法的性能，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 城市系统, 自适应价值分解, 异步决策, 动作同质化, 行为多样性, 共享单车重新分配
AI.comments: 该研究创新地结合了动态智能体数量和异步决策的考量，并关注了共享策略的副作用，具有实际应用价值；但摘要未提及具体机制细节或潜在局限性，如计算复杂度或可扩展性。

title: Visual Para-Thinker: Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning for Visual Comprehension
summary: Existing LLM test-time scaling laws emphasize the emergence of self-reflective behaviors through extended reasoning length. Nevertheless, this vertical scaling strategy often encounters plateaus in exploration as the model becomes locked into specific thinking pattern. By shifting from depth to parallelism, parallel thinking mitigates the narrowing of exploration. However, the extension of this paradigm to visual domain remains an open research question. In this paper, we first examine the role of visual partitioning in parallelized reasoning and subsequently propose two distinct strategies. Based on the above, we introduce Visual Para-Thinker, representing the inaugural parallel reasoning framework for MLLMs. To maintain path independence and promote diversity in reasoning, our approach integrates Pa-Attention alongside LPRoPE. Leveraging the vLLM framework, we have developed a native multimodal implementation that facilitates high-efficiency parallel processing. Empirical results on benchmark datasets such as V*, CountBench, RefCOCO, and HallusionBench confirm that Visual Para-Thinker successfully extends the benefits of parallel reasoning to the visual domain.

AI.title_translation: 视觉并行思维器：用于视觉理解的“分而治之”推理
AI.tldr: 提出首个多模态大模型并行推理框架Visual Para-Thinker，通过视觉分割与并行策略突破传统深度推理瓶颈，在多个视觉任务基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM测试时扩展律依赖延长推理链的垂直扩展，易陷入固定思维导致探索停滞；并行思维虽能缓解此问题，但尚未在视觉领域得到应用。
AI.method: 1. 研究视觉分割在并行推理中的作用并提出两种策略；2. 设计并行推理框架Visual Para-Thinker，集成Pa-Attention与LPRoPE保持路径独立与多样性；3. 基于vLLM实现原生多模态高效并行处理。
AI.result: 在V*、CountBench、RefCOCO、HallusionBench等基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法成功将并行推理优势扩展到视觉领域。
AI.conclusion: Visual Para-Thinker首次实现多模态大模型的并行推理，突破深度扩展瓶颈，为视觉理解提供新范式。
AI.translation: 现有LLM测试时扩展律强调通过延长推理长度产生自反思行为，但垂直扩展策略常因模型陷入特定思维模式而遭遇探索瓶颈。并行思维通过从深度转向并行缓解探索收窄，然而该范式在视觉领域的延伸仍是开放问题。本文先考察视觉分割在并行推理中的作用，随后提出两种不同策略。基于此，我们提出Visual Para-Thinker，代表MLLM的首个并行推理框架。为保持路径独立并促进推理多样性，我们的方法集成Pa-Attention与LPRoPE。利用vLLM框架，我们开发了原生多模态实现以支持高效并行处理。在V*、CountBench、RefCOCO和HallusionBench等基准数据集的实证结果表明，Visual Para-Thinker成功将并行推理优势扩展至视觉领域。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大模型推理扩展瓶颈，提出首个并行推理框架Visual Para-Thinker。通过视觉分割与并行策略，结合Pa-Attention和LPRoPE模块，实现路径独立与多样性，并在vLLM上完成高效多模态实现。实验在四个视觉任务基准验证其有效性。
AI.keywords: 并行推理；多模态大模型；视觉理解；测试时扩展；视觉分割；Pa-Attention；LPRoPE；vLLM
AI.comments: 摘要未披露具体性能指标、两种视觉分割策略细节及LPRoPE的完整含义，未来需补充实验对比与消融分析。

title: Resilient and Freshness-Aware Scheduling for Industrial Multi-Hop IAB Networks: A Packet Duplication Approach
summary: In industrial millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-hop Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) networks, dynamic blockages caused by moving obstacles pose a severe threat to robust and continuous networks. While Packet Duplication (PD) enhances reliability by path diversity, it inevitably doubles the traffic load, leading to severe congestion and degraded Age of Information (AoI). To navigate this reliability-congestion trade-off, we formulated an optimization problem in a multi-hop IAB scenario that minimizes the average AOI while satisfying strict queue stability constraints. We utilize Lyapunov optimization to transform the long-term stochastic optimization problem into tractable deterministic sub-problems. To solve these sub-problems efficiently, we propose a Resilient and Freshness-Aware Scheduling (RFAS) algorithm. Simulation results show that in blockage-prone environments, RFAS significantly outperforms baselines by maintaining a Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) above 95\%. Crucially, it strictly guarantees queue stability under hard buffer constraints, whereas baselines suffer from buffer overflows. Furthermore, RFAS reduces the network load imbalance by 19\% compared to the baseline in high-frequency traffic scenarios. This confirms RFAS as a robust and sustainable solution for real-time industrial control loops.

AI.title_translation: 工业多跳IAB网络中具有韧性与时效性感知的调度：一种包复制方法
AI.tldr: 提出RFAS算法，在包复制带来冗余与拥塞的权衡下，用Lyapunov优化最小化平均信息年龄，同时确保队列稳定，实现>95%包交付率并缓解负载失衡。
AI.motivation: 工业毫米波多跳IAB网络中移动障碍物造成动态遮挡，严重影响网络连续性与可靠性；包复制虽提供路径多样性却加倍流量，导致拥塞与信息年龄恶化，需解决可靠性与拥塞的矛盾。
AI.method: 将长期随机优化问题建模为最小化平均信息年龄并满足严格队列稳定约束；采用Lyapunov优化将原问题转化为可解的确定性子问题；提出Resilient and Freshness-Aware Scheduling (RFAS)算法高效求解子问题。
AI.result: 仿真显示，在易遮挡环境中RFAS的PDR保持在95%以上，严格保证硬缓冲区约束下的队列稳定，而基线出现缓冲区溢出；在高频流量场景下，RFAS比基线降低19%的网络负载不平衡。
AI.conclusion: RFAS为实时工业控制回路提供了一种稳健且可持续的解决方案。
AI.translation: 在工业毫米波多跳综合接入与回传(IAB)网络中，移动障碍物造成的动态遮挡严重威胁网络的鲁棒性与连续性。包复制(PD)虽通过路径多样性提高可靠性，却不可避免地加倍流量，导致严重拥塞与信息年龄(AoI)恶化。为在可靠性与拥塞之间权衡，我们在多跳IAB场景中建立优化问题，在满足严格队列稳定约束下最小化平均AoI。利用Lyapunov优化将长期随机优化问题转化为可处理的确定性子问题。为高效求解这些子问题，提出韧性且时效性感知的调度(RFAS)算法。仿真结果表明，在易遮挡环境中，RFAS显著优于基线，PDR保持在95%以上；关键是在硬缓冲区约束下严格保证队列稳定，而基线出现缓冲区溢出。此外，在高频流量场景下，RFAS比基线降低19%的网络负载不平衡，证实其为实时工业控制回路的稳健可持续方案。
AI.summary: 本文针对工业毫米波多跳IAB网络中移动遮挡导致的可靠性下降与包复制引发的拥塞及时效性恶化，提出RFAS算法。通过Lyapunov优化将长期随机问题转化为确定性子问题，兼顾最小化平均信息年龄与队列稳定，实现高包交付率、零缓冲区溢出与负载均衡。仿真验证其在遮挡环境下的鲁棒性与实时工业控制的适用性。
AI.keywords: 工业毫米波网络;多跳IAB;包复制;信息年龄;Lyapunov优化;队列稳定;遮挡环境
AI.comments: 未提及实际部署或硬件实验；仅给出仿真结果，缺乏与更多最新方法的对比。

title: PeroMAS: A Multi-agent System of Perovskite Material Discovery
summary: As a pioneer of the third-generation photovoltaic revolution, Perovskite Solar Cells (PSCs) are renowned for their superior optoelectronic performance and cost potential. The development process of PSCs is precise and complex, involving a series of closed-loop workflows such as literature retrieval, data integration, experimental design, and synthesis. However, existing AI perovskite approaches focus predominantly on discrete models, including material design, process optimization,and property prediction. These models fail to propagate physical constraints across the workflow, hindering end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose a multi-agent system for perovskite material discovery, named PeroMAS. We first encapsulated a series of perovskite-specific tools into Model Context Protocols (MCPs). By planning and invoking these tools, PeroMAS can design perovskite materials under multi-objective constraints, covering the entire process from literature retrieval and data extraction to property prediction and mechanism analysis. Furthermore, we construct an evaluation benchmark by perovskite human experts to assess this multi-agent system. Results demonstrate that, compared to single Large Language Model (LLM) or traditional search strategies, our system significantly enhances discovery efficiency. It successfully identified candidate materials satisfying multi-objective constraints. Notably, we verify PeroMAS's effectiveness in the physical world through real synthesis experiments.

AI.title_translation: PeroMAS：一种用于钙钛矿材料发现的多智能体系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出PeroMAS，一种多智能体系统，通过封装钙钛矿工具、规划与调用，实现从文献检索到性能预测的全流程材料设计，以应对现有AI方法难以端到端优化的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有AI钙钛矿方法主要侧重于离散模型（如材料设计、工艺优化、性能预测），这些模型无法在整个工作流程中传递物理约束，阻碍了端到端优化。钙钛矿太阳能电池的开发过程精确而复杂，涉及文献检索、数据整合、实验设计和合成等一系列闭环工作流程，需要更系统的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出名为PeroMAS的多智能体系统。首先将一系列钙钛矿专用工具封装为模型上下文协议（MCPs），然后通过规划和调用这些工具，使PeroMAS能够在多目标约束下设计钙钛矿材料，覆盖从文献检索、数据提取到性能预测和机理分析的全过程。此外，还构建了由钙钛矿人类专家评估的基准来评估该系统。
AI.result: 结果表明，与单一大型语言模型（LLM）或传统搜索策略相比，PeroMAS显著提高了发现效率。该系统成功识别出满足多目标约束的候选材料。值得注意的是，通过真实合成实验验证了PeroMAS在物理世界中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PeroMAS作为一种多智能体系统，通过整合和自动化钙钛矿材料发现的全流程，有效解决了现有离散模型在端到端优化中的局限性，提升了材料发现的效率，并在实际实验中验证了其可行性。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 钙钛矿太阳能电池开发过程复杂，现有AI方法多为离散模型，难以实现端到端优化。本文提出PeroMAS多智能体系统，通过封装钙钛矿工具（MCPs）并进行规划调用，实现从文献检索到机理分析的全流程材料设计。评估显示，相比单一LLM或传统方法，PeroMAS显著提升发现效率，成功找到满足多约束的候选材料，并通过真实合成实验验证其有效性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统，钙钛矿材料发现，模型上下文协议，端到端优化，材料设计
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多智能体系统应用于钙钛矿材料发现，解决了传统AI方法流程割裂的问题，并通过真实实验验证，增强了实用性和可信度。但摘要未提及系统具体架构细节或局限性。

title: Agentic Spatio-Temporal Grounding via Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to retrieve the spatio-temporal tube of a target object or person in a video given a text query. Most existing approaches perform frame-wise spatial localization within a predicted temporal span, resulting in redundant computation, heavy supervision requirements, and limited generalization. Weakly-supervised variants mitigate annotation costs but remain constrained by the dataset-level train-and-fit paradigm with an inferior performance. To address these challenges, we propose the Agentic Spatio-Temporal Grounder (ASTG) framework for the task of STVG towards an open-world and training-free scenario. Specifically, two specialized agents SRA (Spatial Reasoning Agent) and TRA (Temporal Reasoning Agent) constructed leveraging on modern Multimoal Large Language Models (MLLMs) work collaboratively to retrieve the target tube in an autonomous and self-guided manner. Following a propose-and-evaluation paradigm, ASTG duly decouples spatio-temporal reasoning and automates the tube extraction, verification and temporal localization processes. With a dedicate visual memory and dialogue context, the retrieval efficiency is significantly enhanced. Experiments on popular benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach where it outperforms existing weakly-supervised and zero-shot approaches by a margin and is comparable to some of the fully-supervised methods.

AI.title_translation: 协作推理的智能时空定位
AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的智能体框架ASTG，通过空间-时间双智能体协作，在开放世界视频 grounding 任务中达到弱监督甚至全监督水平。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG方法需逐帧定位、计算冗余、依赖大量标注且泛化差；弱监督版本仍受限于数据集级训练范式，性能不足。
AI.method: 构建两个基于MLLM的智能体SRA与TRA，采用提出-评估范式，解耦空间与时间推理，利用视觉记忆与对话上下文自主完成候选片段提取、验证与时序定位，无需训练。
AI.result: 在主流基准上显著超越现有弱监督与零样本方法，并与部分全监督方法相当。
AI.conclusion: ASTG通过智能体协作实现了开放世界、免训练的时空定位，突破传统训练范式并提升性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出ASTG框架，通过SRA与TRA智能体协作，在无需训练的情况下完成视频文本查询的时空定位，显著优于弱监督方法并可媲美全监督。
AI.summary: 本文针对STVG任务提出ASTG框架，利用基于MLLM的空间与时间智能体协作，在无需训练与标注的开放场景下实现高效 tubes 提取与定位，实验显示其性能大幅领先弱监督方法并逼近全监督水平。
AI.keywords: 时空视频定位, 智能体系统, 多模态大语言模型, 免训练推理, 弱监督学习
AI.comments: 未见明显缺陷；若能补充计算开销与实时性分析将更完整。

title: Sim2Radar: Toward Bridging the Radar Sim-to-Real Gap with VLM-Guided Scene Reconstruction
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides reliable perception in visually degraded indoor environments (e.g., smoke, dust, and low light), but learning-based radar perception is bottlenecked by the scarcity and cost of collecting and annotating large-scale radar datasets. We present Sim2Radar, an end-to-end framework that synthesizes training radar data directly from single-view RGB images, enabling scalable data generation without manual scene modeling. Sim2Radar reconstructs a material-aware 3D scene by combining monocular depth estimation, segmentation, and vision-language reasoning to infer object materials, then simulates mmWave propagation with a configurable physics-based ray tracer using Fresnel reflection models parameterized by ITU-R electromagnetic properties. Evaluated on real-world indoor scenes, Sim2Radar improves downstream 3D radar perception via transfer learning: pre-training a radar point-cloud object detection model on synthetic data and fine-tuning on real radar yields up to +3.7 3D AP (IoU 0.3), with gains driven primarily by improved spatial localization. These results suggest that physics-based, vision-driven radar simulation can provide effective geometric priors for radar learning and measurably improve performance under limited real-data supervision.

AI.title_translation: Sim2Radar：利用VLM引导场景重建弥合雷达仿真到现实差距
AI.tldr: Sim2Radar通过单张RGB图像自动重建材质感知3D场景并生成毫米波雷达训练数据，在真实室内场景上使3D目标检测AP提升3.7。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达在视觉退化环境中可靠，但大规模雷达数据稀缺且标注昂贵，需低成本合成训练数据。
AI.method: 单目深度+分割+VLM推理材质→3D场景重建；基于Fresnel与ITU-R电磁参数的物理射线追踪模拟毫米波传播；合成数据预训练+真实数据微调迁移学习。
AI.result: 在真实室内场景，用合成数据预训练后微调，3D AP(IoU 0.3)最高提升3.7，主要源于空间定位改善。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理的视觉驱动雷达仿真可为雷达学习提供有效几何先验，在真实数据受限时显著提升性能。
AI.translation: 毫米波雷达在视觉退化的室内环境（烟雾、灰尘、低照度）中提供可靠感知，但基于学习的雷达感知因收集和标注大规模雷达数据稀缺且昂贵而受阻。我们提出Sim2Radar，一个端到端框架，可直接从单张RGB图像合成训练雷达数据，实现无需手工场景建模的可扩展数据生成。Sim2Radar结合单目深度估计、分割和视觉-语言推理推断物体材质，重建材质感知3D场景，然后使用可配置的基于物理的射线追踪器模拟毫米波传播，采用由ITU-R电磁特性参数化的Fresnel反射模型。在真实室内场景评估中，Sim2Radar通过迁移学习改善下游3D雷达感知：在合成数据上预训练雷达点云目标检测模型并在真实雷达数据上微调，可在IoU 0.3下带来最高+3.7的3D AP增益，主要源于空间定位改善。结果表明，基于物理的视觉驱动雷达仿真可为雷达学习提供有效几何先验，并在真实数据监督有限的情况下可衡量地提升性能。
AI.summary: Sim2Radar框架仅凭单张RGB图像即可自动生成材质感知3D场景并物理模拟毫米波雷达回波，为雷达感知模型提供大规模合成训练数据。实验表明，用该合成数据预训练后再用少量真实数据微调，可显著提升3D目标检测精度。
AI.keywords: 毫米波雷达；仿真到现实；3D感知；数据合成；视觉-语言模型；物理射线追踪；迁移学习
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码或数据集是否开源；未说明VLM具体模型及计算成本；未与其他雷达仿真方法进行详细对比。

title: IDPruner: Harmonizing Importance and Diversity in Visual Token Pruning for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, yet they encounter significant computational bottlenecks due to the massive volume of visual tokens. Consequently, visual token pruning, which substantially reduces the token count, has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating MLLM inference. Existing approaches focus on token importance, diversity, or an intuitive combination of both, without a principled framework for their optimal integration. To address this issue, we first conduct a systematic analysis to characterize the trade-off between token importance and semantic diversity. Guided by this analysis, we propose the \textbf{I}mportance and \textbf{D}iversity Pruner (\textbf{IDPruner}), which leverages the Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) algorithm to achieve a Pareto-optimal balance between these two objectives. Crucially, our method operates without requiring attention maps, ensuring full compatibility with FlashAttention and efficient deployment via one-shot pruning. We conduct extensive experiments across various model architectures and multimodal benchmarks, demonstrating that IDPruner achieves state-of-the-art performance and superior generalization across diverse architectures and tasks. Notably, on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, IDPruner retains 95.18\% of baseline performance when pruning 75\% of the tokens, and still maintains 86.40\% even under an extreme 90\% pruning ratio. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AngelSlim.

title: Semantic Waveforms for AI-Native 6G Networks
summary: In this paper, we propose a semantic-aware waveform design framework for AI-native 6G networks that jointly optimizes physical layer resource usage and semantic communication efficiency and robustness, while explicitly accounting for the hardware constraints of RF chains. Our approach, called Orthogonal Semantic Sequency Division Multiplexing (OSSDM), introduces a parametrizable, orthogonal-base waveform design that enables controlled degradation of the wireless transmitted signal to preserve semantically significant content while minimizing resource consumption. We demonstrate that OSSDM not only reinforces semantic robustness against channel impairments but also improves semantic spectral efficiency by encoding meaningful information directly at the waveform level. Extensive numerical evaluations show that OSSDM outperforms conventional OFDM waveforms in spectral efficiency and semantic fidelity. The proposed semantic waveform co-design opens new research frontiers for AI-native, intelligent communication systems by enabling meaning-aware physical signal construction through the direct encoding of semantics at the waveform level.

title: DECKBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Frameworks for Academic Slide Generation and Editing
summary: Automatically generating and iteratively editing academic slide decks requires more than document summarization. It demands faithful content selection, coherent slide organization, layout-aware rendering, and robust multi-turn instruction following. However, existing benchmarks and evaluation protocols do not adequately measure these challenges. To address this gap, we introduce the Deck Edits and Compliance Kit Benchmark (DECKBench), an evaluation framework for multi-agent slide generation and editing. DECKBench is built on a curated dataset of paper to slide pairs augmented with realistic, simulated editing instructions. Our evaluation protocol systematically assesses slide-level and deck-level fidelity, coherence, layout quality, and multi-turn instruction following. We further implement a modular multi-agent baseline system that decomposes the slide generation and editing task into paper parsing and summarization, slide planning, HTML creation, and iterative editing. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed benchmark highlights strengths, exposes failure modes, and provides actionable insights for improving multi-agent slide generation and editing systems. Overall, this work establishes a standardized foundation for reproducible and comparable evaluation of academic presentation generation and editing. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/morgan-heisler/DeckBench .

title: Situation Graph Prediction: Structured Perspective Inference for User Modeling
summary: Perspective-Aware AI requires modeling evolving internal states--goals, emotions, contexts--not merely preferences. Progress is limited by a data bottleneck: digital footprints are privacy-sensitive and perspective states are rarely labeled. We propose Situation Graph Prediction (SGP), a task that frames perspective modeling as an inverse inference problem: reconstructing structured, ontology-aligned representations of perspective from observable multimodal artifacts. To enable grounding without real labels, we use a structure-first synthetic generation strategy that aligns latent labels and observable traces by design. As a pilot, we construct a dataset and run a diagnostic study using retrieval-augmented in-context learning as a proxy for supervision. In our study with GPT-4o, we observe a gap between surface-level extraction and latent perspective inference--indicating latent-state inference is harder than surface extraction under our controlled setting. Results suggest SGP is non-trivial and provide evidence for the structure-first data synthesis strategy.

AI.title_translation: 情境图预测：用于用户建模的结构化视角推断
AI.tldr: 提出“情境图预测”（SGP）这一新任务，通过从多模态可观测线索逆向推断用户的目标、情绪等潜在视角状态，并用结构优先的合成数据和检索增强的上下文学习进行诊断实验，证明该任务非平凡且数据合成策略有效。
AI.motivation: 传统用户建模多停留在显性偏好层面，而视角感知型 AI 需要刻画随时间演化的内在状态（目标、情绪、情境等）。然而，这类“视角状态”数据既隐私敏感又极少有标签，形成数据瓶颈，因此需要一种既能利用可观测数字足迹又无需真实隐私标签的新建模框架。
AI.method: 提出“情境图预测”（Situation Graph Prediction, SGP）任务，将视角建模表述为逆向推断问题：从可观测的多模态行为与痕迹中重建与本体（ontology）对齐的结构化视角表示。为绕开真实标签缺乏与隐私问题，采用“结构优先”的合成数据生成策略：先在潜在空间中生成结构化标签，再按设计生成与之对齐的可观测轨迹。作为试点，构建一个合成数据集，并使用检索增强的 in-context learning（以 GPT-4o 为模型）作为监督代理进行诊断性实验，对比表层信息抽取与潜在视角推断的表现。
AI.result: 在 GPT-4o 的实验中发现：模型在表层信息抽取任务上的表现明显优于在潜在视角状态推断上的表现，说明在受控环境下“推断潜在状态”比“抽取表面信息”难得多。同时，实验结果显示 SGP 任务本身具有非平凡性，并为所提出的“结构优先”数据合成与标注对齐策略提供了实证支持。
AI.conclusion: 情境图预测为视角感知型用户建模提供了一个结构化、可解释的任务框架，并且利用结构优先的合成数据可以在不依赖真实隐私标签的前提下，对模型的潜在状态推断能力进行系统诊断。实验揭示了从可观测线索推断内隐视角状态的难度高于简单信息抽取，表明未来需要针对这一差距发展更专门的建模与学习方法。
AI.translation:
论文标题：Situation Graph Prediction: Structured Perspective Inference for User Modeling

摘要翻译：
具备视角感知能力的人工智能，需要建模不断演化的内部状态——如目标、情绪、情境——而不仅仅是偏好。然而，进展受制于数据瓶颈：数字足迹具有隐私敏感性，而视角相关状态又很少被标注。我们提出“情境图预测”（Situation Graph Prediction, SGP）这一任务，将视角建模表述为一个逆向推断问题：从可观测的多模态产物中，重建与本体对齐的、结构化的视角表示。为在没有真实标签的情况下实现有效对齐，我们采用“结构优先”的合成生成策略，在设计上就使潜在标签与可观测轨迹对齐。作为初步探索，我们构建了一个数据集，并使用检索增强的上下文学习作为监督代理开展诊断性研究。在使用 GPT-4o 的研究中，我们观察到表层信息抽取与潜在视角推断之间存在性能差距——这表明在我们的受控设置下，潜在状态推断比表层抽取更困难。结果说明 SGP 是一个非平凡任务，并为结构优先的数据合成策略提供了证据支持。
AI.summary: 本文针对视角感知型用户建模中的数据瓶颈，提出“情境图预测”（SGP）任务，将用户内在视角状态（目标、情绪、情境等）建模为从多模态可观测线索到结构化本体图的逆向推断问题。作者采用“先结构后观测”的合成数据生成方式，先设计潜在的结构化视角标签，再生成与之严格对齐的可观测轨迹，以此绕开真实隐私数据和稀缺标注。基于该数据集，使用检索增强的 in-context learning 和 GPT-4o 进行诊断实验，发现模型在表层信息抽取上表现明显好于在潜在视角推断上的表现，证明 SGP 任务难度较高，也从实验上支持了结构优先数据合成策略的合理性。
AI.keywords: 情境图预测, 视角感知 AI, 用户建模, 潜在状态推断, 多模态推理, 结构化表示, 本体对齐, 合成数据生成, 检索增强上下文学习, GPT-4o
AI.comments: 摘要提出了一个以“情境图预测”为核心的新任务，并强调通过结构化本体与合成数据来缓解隐私与标注稀缺问题，是对用户潜在视角建模的较系统化尝试。实验更多是诊断性、概念验证性质，未在摘要中给出具体数据规模、评价指标或与其他方法的定量对比；后续工作可能需要扩展到真实或半真实数据场景，并探索超越检索增强 in-context learning 的专门模型架构。

title: Information Fidelity in Tool-Using LLM Agents: A Martingale Analysis of the Model Context Protocol
comments: Full working version of an extended abstract accepted at the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: As AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) increasingly use external tools for high-stakes decisions, a critical reliability question arises: how do errors propagate across sequential tool calls? We introduce the first theoretical framework for analyzing error accumulation in Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents, proving that cumulative distortion exhibits linear growth and high-probability deviations bounded by $O(\sqrt{T})$. This concentration property ensures predictable system behavior and rules out exponential failure modes. We develop a hybrid distortion metric combining discrete fact matching with continuous semantic similarity, then establish martingale concentration bounds on error propagation through sequential tool interactions. Experiments across Qwen2-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Mistral-7B validate our theoretical predictions, showing empirical distortion tracks the linear trend with deviations consistently within $O(\sqrt{T})$ envelopes. Key findings include: semantic weighting reduces distortion by 80\%, and periodic re-grounding approximately every 9 steps suffices for error control. We translate these concentration guarantees into actionable deployment principles for trustworthy agent systems.

AI.title_translation: 使用工具的LLM智能体中的信息保真度：模型上下文协议的鞅分析
AI.tldr: 首次提出理论框架证明MCP智能体在顺序工具调用中累积误差呈线性增长且偏差以O(√T)高概率有界，实验验证并给出部署原则。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体越来越多地依赖外部工具进行高风险决策，亟需理解顺序工具调用中误差如何传播，以确保系统可靠性。
AI.method: 引入混合失真指标（离散事实匹配+连续语义相似度），建立鞅集中不等式，分析MCP智能体在顺序工具交互中的误差传播，并在Qwen2-7B、Llama-3-8B、Mistral-7B上实验验证。
AI.result: 累积失真呈线性增长，高概率偏差上界为O(√T)；语义加权可降低80%失真；每约9步定期重接地即可控制误差；实验结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 集中性质保证可预测的系统行为并排除指数级失效模式，可将这些保证转化为可信赖智能体系统的可执行部署原则。
AI.translation: 随着由大语言模型驱动的AI智能体日益使用外部工具进行高风险决策，一个关键的可靠性问题随之出现：错误如何在顺序工具调用中传播？我们首次提出分析模型上下文协议（MCP）智能体中错误积累的理论框架，证明累积失真呈线性增长，且高概率偏差以O(√T)为界。该集中性质确保系统行为可预测，并排除指数级失效模式。我们开发了一种混合失真指标，结合离散事实匹配与连续语义相似度，然后针对顺序工具交互中的误差传播建立鞅集中界限。在Qwen2-7B、Llama-3-8B和Mistral-7B上的实验验证了理论预测，显示经验失真跟踪线性趋势，偏差始终处于O(√T)包络内。关键发现包括：语义加权可减少80%失真，每约9步的周期性重接地足以控制误差。我们将这些集中保证转化为可信赖智能体系统的可执行部署原则。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM工具调用智能体提出首个误差传播理论框架，证明累积失真线性增长且偏差以O(√T)高概率有界，实验验证并给出语义加权与定期重接地等控制策略。
