title: Testing BDI-based Multi-Agent Systems using Discrete Event Simulation
summary: Multi-agent systems are designed to deal with open, distributed systems with unpredictable dynamics, which makes them inherently hard to test. The value of using simulation for this purpose is recognized in the literature, although achieving sufficient fidelity (i.e., the degree of similarity between the simulation and the real-world system) remains a challenging task. This is exacerbated when dealing with cognitive agent models, such as the Belief Desire Intention (BDI) model, where the agent codebase is not suitable to run unchanged in simulation environments, thus increasing the reality gap between the deployed and simulated systems. We argue that BDI developers should be able to test in simulation the same specification that will be later deployed, with no surrogate representations. Thus, in this paper, we discuss how the control flow of BDI agents can be mapped onto a Discrete Event Simulation (DES), showing that such integration is possible at different degrees of granularity. We substantiate our claims by producing an open-source prototype integration between two pre-existing tools (JaKtA and Alchemist), showing that it is possible to produce a simulation-based testing environment for distributed BDI} agents, and that different granularities in mapping BDI agents over DESs may lead to different degrees of fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 基于BDI的多智能体系统离散事件仿真测试
AI.tldr: 将BDI智能体的控制流映射到离散事件仿真，实现无需修改代码即可在仿真中测试真实系统规范，并通过JaKtA与Alchemist开源原型验证不同映射粒度对保真度的影响。
AI.motivation: BDI智能体代码无法直接在仿真环境运行，导致仿真与真实系统之间存在“现实鸿沟”，需要一种能在仿真中直接测试同一套系统规范的方法。
AI.method: 将BDI智能体的控制流映射到离散事件仿真（DES），并在JaKtA与Alchemist两个现有工具间实现开源原型集成，比较不同映射粒度下的保真度。
AI.result: 成功构建了分布式BDI智能体的仿真测试环境，证明可在不修改代码的情况下测试真实规范，且不同映射粒度会带来不同的保真度。
AI.conclusion: BDI开发者可以在仿真中测试与部署完全相同的规范，无需代理表示；映射粒度选择对仿真保真度有显著影响。
AI.translation: 多智能体系统用于应对开放、动态不可预测的分布式环境，因此测试极为困难。文献已认可仿真的价值，但保真度不足仍是难题；对BDI这类认知模型尤甚，其代码无法直接运行于仿真，扩大了现实鸿沟。本文主张开发者应能在仿真中测试即将部署的同一规范，无需替代表示。我们讨论如何将BDI控制流映射到离散事件仿真，并在JaKtA与Alchemist上实现开源原型，证明该集成可行且不同粒度影响保真度。
AI.summary: 本文提出将BDI智能体控制流映射到离散事件仿真的方法，使开发者无需修改代码即可在仿真中测试与部署完全相同的系统规范。通过JaKtA与Alchemist的开源原型，验证了不同映射粒度对仿真保真度的影响，为分布式BDI智能体提供了高保真仿真测试环境。
AI.keywords: BDI智能体;离散事件仿真;多智能体系统测试;仿真保真度;JaKtA;Alchemist
AI.comments: 文章未提及具体实验规模、性能开销及与现有测试方法的定量对比，也未讨论原型在更大规模系统上的可扩展性。

title: VSAL: A Vision Solver with Adaptive Layouts for Graph Property Detection
summary: Graph property detection aims to determine whether a graph exhibits certain structural properties, such as being Hamiltonian. Recently, learning-based approaches have shown great promise by leveraging data-driven models to detect graph properties efficiently. In particular, vision-based methods offer a visually intuitive solution by processing the visualizations of graphs. However, existing vision-based methods rely on fixed visual graph layouts, and therefore, the expressiveness of their pipeline is restricted. To overcome this limitation, we propose VSAL, a vision-based framework that incorporates an adaptive layout generator capable of dynamically producing informative graph visualizations tailored to individual instances, thereby improving graph property detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VSAL outperforms state-of-the-art vision-based methods on various tasks such as Hamiltonian cycle, planarity, claw-freeness, and tree detection.

AI.title_translation: VSAL：一种用于图属性检测的自适应布局视觉求解器
AI.tldr: VSAL是一个基于视觉的框架，通过自适应布局生成器动态生成针对单个图实例的信息化可视化，以改进图属性检测，超越了依赖固定布局的现有视觉方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于视觉的图属性检测方法依赖于固定的图可视化布局，限制了其表达能力和检测效果，因此需要一种能够自适应生成针对单个实例的可视化布局的方法来提高检测性能。
AI.method: 提出了VSAL框架，其中包含一个自适应布局生成器，能够动态地为每个图实例生成信息丰富的可视化布局，从而增强基于视觉的图属性检测流程。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VSAL在哈密顿环、平面性、无爪性和树检测等多种图属性检测任务上超越了当前最先进的基于视觉的方法。
AI.conclusion: VSAL通过引入自适应布局生成器，克服了固定布局的限制，显著提高了基于视觉的图属性检测性能，证明了动态可视化布局的有效性。
AI.translation: 图属性检测旨在确定图是否具有某些结构属性，如哈密顿性。最近，基于学习的方法通过利用数据驱动模型高效检测图属性显示出巨大潜力。特别是，基于视觉的方法通过处理图的可视化提供了一种视觉直观的解决方案。然而，现有的基于视觉的方法依赖于固定的视觉图布局，因此其流程的表达能力受到限制。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了VSAL，这是一个基于视觉的框架，它包含一个自适应布局生成器，能够动态地生成针对单个实例的信息丰富的图可视化，从而改进图属性检测。大量实验表明，VSAL在哈密顿环、平面性、无爪性和树检测等多种任务上超越了最先进的基于视觉的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出VSAL，一种基于视觉的图属性检测框架，通过自适应布局生成器动态优化图可视化布局，以克服固定布局的局限性，实验证明其在多项任务上优于现有视觉方法。
AI.keywords: 图属性检测, 自适应布局, 视觉方法, 机器学习, 可视化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将自适应布局生成引入视觉图分析，解决了固定布局的限制问题，可能为图学习领域提供新的思路，但摘要未提及计算复杂度或实际应用场景的具体细节。

title: NFT Games: an Empirical Look into the Play-to-Earn Model
summary: The past decade has witnessed the burgeoning and continuous development of blockchain and its applications. Besides various cryptocurrencies, an industry that has quickly embraced this trend is gaming. Thanks to the support of blockchain, games have started to incorporate non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that can enable a new gaming model, play-to-earn (P2E), which incentivizes users to participate and play. While recent studies looked at several NFT games qualitatively and individually, an in-depth understanding is still missing, particularly on how the P2E model has transformed traditional games. In this work, we set to conduct a measurement study of NFT games, aiming to gain a comprehensive understanding of the effectiveness of P2E in practice. For this purpose, we collect and analyze relevant NFT transaction data from the underlying blockchain (e.g., Ethereum) of 12 games, supplemented with various data scraped from their websites. Our study shows that (1) a few top wallets control unproportionally high percentage of NFTs, and the majority of wallets own only one or two NFTs and do not actively trade; (2) promotion events do boost the trade amount and the NFT price for some games, but their effect does not sustain; and (3) few players actually earned a profit, and players in 9 out of 12 games who traded NFTs have a negative profit on average. Motivated by these findings, we further investigate effective incentive mechanisms based on game theory to improve the trading profits that players can earn from these NFT games. Both modeling and simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed incentive mechanism.

AI.title_translation: NFT游戏：对“边玩边赚”模式的实证研究
AI.tldr: 首次对12款NFT游戏进行大规模链上测量，发现财富极度集中、促销效果短暂、多数玩家亏损，并提出博弈论激励方案提升收益。
AI.motivation: 尽管NFT游戏声称“边玩边赚”，但缺乏系统性实证证据说明该模式是否真正有效、如何改变传统游戏，以及玩家实际获利情况。
AI.method: 收集并分析12款NFT游戏在以太坊上的全部NFT交易数据，结合官网爬取信息；用博弈论建模并仿真新的激励机制。
AI.result: 1）头部钱包掌控绝大部分NFT，多数钱包仅持1–2个且交易极少；2）促销仅短期提升交易量与价格；3）12款游戏中9款玩家平均交易利润为负。
AI.conclusion: P2E模式当前加剧财富分化且难以持续，需引入更公平的博弈论激励机制才能提升玩家收益与生态健康。
AI.translation: 过去十年，区块链及其应用迅猛发展。除加密货币外，游戏行业迅速拥抱这一趋势，借助区块链将非同质化代币（NFT）引入游戏，催生“边玩边赚”（P2E）新模式。尽管已有研究定性分析个别NFT游戏，但缺乏对P2E如何改变传统游戏的深入理解。本文首次对NFT游戏开展测量研究，综合评估P2E实际效果。我们收集并分析12款游戏在以太坊上的NFT交易数据，并补充官网数据。结果显示：1）少数顶级钱包控制极高比例NFT，多数钱包仅持1–2个且不活跃交易；2）促销活动虽能短期提升交易量与NFT价格，但效果不可持续；3）仅极少数玩家获利，12款游戏中有9款玩家平均交易利润为负。基于上述发现，我们进一步设计基于博弈论的有效激励机制以提升玩家交易收益，建模与仿真均验证其有效性。
AI.summary: 本文对12款NFT游戏进行链上实证，发现财富高度集中、促销效果短暂、多数玩家亏损，并提出博弈论激励方案以改善P2E生态。
AI.keywords: NFT游戏；边玩边赚；区块链；交易分析；博弈论激励
AI.comments: 研究样本局限于以太坊，未覆盖侧链/L2游戏；未探讨代币经济学与外部市场波动的动态耦合。

title: Human-Aligned Evaluation of a Pixel-wise DNN Color Constancy Model
summary: We previously investigated color constancy in photorealistic virtual reality (VR) and developed a Deep Neural Network (DNN) that predicts reflectance from rendered images. Here, we combine both approaches to compare and study a model and human performance with respect to established color constancy mechanisms: local surround, maximum flux and spatial mean. Rather than evaluating the model against physical ground truth, model performance was assessed using the same achromatic object selection task employed in the human experiments. The model, a ResNet based U-Net from our previous work, was pre-trained on rendered images to predict surface reflectance. We then applied transfer learning, fine-tuning only the network's decoder on images from the baseline VR condition. To parallel the human experiment, the model's output was used to perform the same achromatic object selection task across all conditions. Results show a strong correspondence between the model and human behavior. Both achieved high constancy under baseline conditions and showed similar, condition-dependent performance declines when the local surround or spatial mean color cues were removed.

AI.title_translation: 面向人类对齐的像素级DNN色彩恒常性模型评估
AI.tldr: 作者用与人相同的灰度物体选择任务评估其ResNet-U-Net模型，发现模型与人类在多种视觉线索被移除时的色彩恒常表现高度一致。
AI.motivation: 传统色彩恒常模型常以物理真值为基准评估，而人类表现基于感知任务；作者想验证其DNN模型能否在与人类相同的任务下展现一致的行为模式。
AI.method: 将预训练于渲染图像的ResNet-U-Net解码器用基线VR图像微调，随后用模型输出的反射率图完成与人类实验相同的灰度物体选择任务，并在局部环绕、最大亮度和空间平均三种线索被移除的条件下比较性能。
AI.result: 模型与人类在基线条件下均保持高色彩恒常性；当局部环绕或空间平均线索被移除时，两者的表现下降幅度相似。
AI.conclusion: 该像素级DNN模型在感知对齐任务上能复现人类的色彩恒常行为，表明其可作为研究人类色彩恒常机制的有效工具。
AI.translation: 我们此前在逼真虚拟现实(VR)中研究色彩恒常，并开发了一种从渲染图像预测反射率的深度神经网络(DNN)。本文将两者结合，用局部环绕、最大亮度和空间平均三种经典机制比较模型与人类表现。模型性能不是对照物理真值，而是通过与人类实验相同的灰度物体选择任务评估。模型为之前工作中的ResNet-U-Net，先在渲染图像上预训练预测表面反射率，然后仅用基线VR图像微调解码器。为模拟人类实验，模型输出被用于在各条件下完成相同的灰度物体选择任务。结果显示模型与人类行为高度一致：两者在基线条件下均保持高恒常性，且在局部环绕或空间平均线索被移除时表现出相似的条件依赖性下降。
AI.summary: 本文将先前开发的ResNet-U-Net色彩恒常模型与人类在VR环境下进行对比，采用相同的灰度物体选择任务评估，发现模型与人类在基线及线索缺失条件下的表现高度一致，验证了模型的人类对齐能力。
AI.keywords: 色彩恒常，深度神经网络，人类对齐评估，虚拟现实，灰度物体选择任务
AI.comments: 摘要未提及模型在最大亮度线索移除条件下的具体表现，也未讨论模型参数量或实时性。未来可进一步比较模型与人类的反应时间或眼动数据。

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of DINOv2 for Large-Scale Font Classification
summary: We present a font classification system capable of identifying 394 font families from rendered text images. Our approach fine-tunes a DINOv2 Vision Transformer using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), achieving approximately 86% top-1 accuracy while training fewer than 1% of the model's 87.2M parameters. We introduce a synthetic dataset generation pipeline that renders Google Fonts at scale with diverse augmentations including randomized colors, alignment, line wrapping, and Gaussian noise, producing training images that generalize to real-world typographic samples. The model incorporates built-in preprocessing to ensure consistency between training and inference, and is deployed as a HuggingFace Inference Endpoint. We release the model, dataset, and full training pipeline as open-source resources.

AI.title_translation: 面向大规模字体分类的DINOv2参数高效微调
AI.tldr: 利用LoRA仅训练不到1%参数，将DINOv2微调后实现394种字体家族86% top-1准确率，并开源模型与合成数据流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有字体分类模型在大规模字体家族识别上准确率不足，且全参数微调计算成本高，需要参数高效的微调方案。
AI.method: 采用LoRA对DINOv2 Vision Transformer进行参数高效微调；构建合成数据流水线，大规模渲染Google Fonts并加入颜色、对齐、换行、高斯噪声等增强。
AI.result: 在394类字体家族识别任务上实现约86% top-1准确率，仅训练87.2M参数中的不到1%，模型可泛化到真实字体样本。
AI.conclusion: LoRA微调DINOv2能以极低参数成本实现大规模字体分类的高准确率，合成数据与一致预处理是泛化关键，开源资源可促进社区研究。
AI.translation: 我们提出一种能从渲染文本图像中识别394种字体家族的字体分类系统。该方法使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调DINOv2视觉Transformer，仅用不到1%的87.2M参数就实现约86%的top-1准确率。我们引入了合成数据生成流水线，可大规模渲染Google Fonts并加入随机颜色、对齐、换行和高斯噪声等增强，使训练图像能泛化到真实排版样本。模型内置预处理以保证训练与推理一致性，并作为HuggingFace推理端点部署。我们开源了模型、数据集和完整训练流程。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种参数高效的字体分类方案：用LoRA微调DINOv2，在自建的394类字体合成数据上训练，仅用不到1%参数即达86% top-1准确率，并开源全部资源。
AI.keywords: 字体分类,DINOv2,LoRA,参数高效微调,合成数据,Google Fonts
AI.comments: 研究在大规模字体识别任务上验证了LoRA的高效性，但合成数据与真实数据的域差距及更细粒度字体区分仍有待进一步探索。

title: Evaluating Prompt Engineering Techniques for RAG in Small Language Models: A Multi-Hop QA Approach
comments: 32 Pages, Submitted to Journal of Computing and Security
summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a powerful approach for enhancing the factual grounding of language models by integrating external knowledge. While widely studied for large language models, the optimization of RAG for Small Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical research gap, particularly in complex, multi-hop question-answering tasks that require sophisticated reasoning. In these systems, prompt template design is a crucial yet under-explored factor influencing performance. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study to investigate this factor, evaluating 24 different prompt templates on the HotpotQA dataset. The set includes a standard RAG prompt, nine well-formed techniques from the literature, and 14 novel hybrid variants, all tested on two prominent SLMs: Qwen2.5-3B Instruct and Gemma3-4B-It. Our findings, based on a test set of 18720 instances, reveal significant performance gains of up to 83% on Qwen2.5 and 84.5% on Gemma3-4B-It, yielding an improvement of up to 6% for both models compared to the Standard RAG prompt. This research also offers concrete analysis and actionable recommendations for designing effective and efficient prompts for SLM-based RAG systems, practically for deployment in resource-constrained environments.
comment: 32 Pages, Submitted to Journal of Computing and Security

AI.title_translation: 在小型语言模型中评估用于 RAG 的提示工程技术：一种多跳问答方法
AI.tldr: 本文在 HotpotQA 上系统评估了 24 种 RAG 提示模板在两种小型语言模型中的效果，发现精心设计的提示可比标准 RAG 提示带来最高约 6% 的性能提升，并给出面向资源受限环境的实用设计建议。
AI.motivation: 尽管 RAG 广泛用于增强大型语言模型的事实依据，但在小型语言模型上如何优化 RAG 尤其是复杂多跳问答任务仍存在关键研究空白，其中提示模板设计这一影响性能的关键因素尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者在 HotpotQA 数据集上进行大规模实证研究，构建并比较 24 种 RAG 提示模板，包括 1 个标准 RAG 提示、9 个来源于文献的成熟技术以及 14 个新提出的混合变体，并在两种代表性小型语言模型 Qwen2.5-3B Instruct 和 Gemma3-4B-It 上，对 18,720 个测试实例进行评测和分析，同时总结出可操作的提示设计建议。
AI.result: 在 18,720 个测试样例上的实验表明，优化后的提示在 Qwen2.5-3B Instruct 上最高可获得 83% 的性能，在 Gemma3-4B-It 上可达 84.5%，相对于标准 RAG 提示，两种模型均可获得最高约 6% 的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 精细化的提示模板设计能显著提升小型语言模型在多跳问答场景下的 RAG 效果，基于系统对比得到的分析与经验可为在资源受限环境中设计高效、有效的 SLM+RAG 系统提供可直接落地的指导。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（Retrieval Augmented Generation, RAG）通过集成外部知识来增强语言模型的事实基础，是一种强大的方法。尽管在大型语言模型上已被广泛研究，但在小型语言模型（SLMs）上优化 RAG 仍存在关键研究空白，尤其是在需要复杂推理的多跳问答任务中。在此类系统中，提示模板的设计是影响性能的关键却尚未被充分探索的因素。本文开展了一项大规模实证研究以探究这一因素，在 HotpotQA 数据集上评估了 24 种不同的提示模板。该集合包括一个标准 RAG 提示、文献中提出的 9 种结构良好的技术，以及 14 个新的混合变体，并在两种具有代表性的小型语言模型 Qwen2.5-3B Instruct 和 Gemma3-4B-It 上进行测试。基于 18,720 个样本的测试结果表明，在 Qwen2.5 上性能最高可提升至 83%，在 Gemma3-4B-It 上可达 84.5%，相较标准 RAG 提示，两种模型的性能最高可提升 6%。本研究还提供了具体的分析和可操作的建议，用于为基于 SLM 的 RAG 系统设计高效且有效的提示模板，特别适用于资源受限环境中的部署。
AI.summary: 本文针对小型语言模型在多跳问答场景中的 RAG 提示工程展开系统研究。作者在 HotpotQA 上构造并评估了 24 种提示模板，涵盖标准提示、文献方法以及新提出的混合变体，并在 Qwen2.5-3B Instruct 和 Gemma3-4B-It 两个模型上对 18,720 个实例进行测试。结果显示，合理的提示设计可显著提升 RAG 性能，两种模型相对标准 RAG 提示最高可获约 6% 的增益。论文进一步给出面向资源受限部署场景的具体提示设计建议，以指导构建更高效的小模型 RAG 系统。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, RAG, 小型语言模型, SLM, 提示工程, 提示模板, 多跳问答, HotpotQA, Qwen2.5-3B Instruct, Gemma3-4B-It, 实证研究, 资源受限环境
AI.comments: 摘要清晰界定了研究空白（SLM 上的 RAG 提示设计）与贡献（24 种模板的大规模对比和经验总结），但未说明具体评测指标和多跳推理难度的量化方式，也未提及在其他数据集或任务上的泛化情况，后续工作可扩展到更多模型和领域。

title: GSRM: Generative Speech Reward Model for Speech RLHF
summary: Recent advances in speech language models, such as GPT-4o Voice Mode and Gemini Live, have demonstrated promising speech generation capabilities. Nevertheless, the aesthetic naturalness of the synthesized audio still lags behind that of human speech. Enhancing generation quality requires a reliable evaluator of speech naturalness. However, existing naturalness evaluators typically regress raw audio to scalar scores, offering limited interpretability of the evaluation and moreover fail to generalize to speech across different taxonomies. Inspired by recent advances in generative reward modeling, we propose the Generative Speech Reward Model (GSRM), a reasoning-centric reward model tailored for speech. The GSRM is trained to decompose speech naturalness evaluation into an interpretable acoustic feature extraction stage followed by feature-grounded chain-of-thought reasoning, enabling explainable judgments. To achieve this, we curated a large-scale human feedback dataset comprising 31k expert ratings and an out-of-domain benchmark of real-world user-assistant speech interactions. Experiments show that GSRM substantially outperforms existing speech naturalness predictors, achieving model-human correlation of naturalness score prediction that approaches human inter-rater consistency. We further show how GSRM can improve the naturalness of speech LLM generations by serving as an effective verifier for online RLHF.

AI.title_translation: GSRM：用于语音RLHF的生成式语音奖励模型
AI.tldr: 提出一个面向语音的生成式奖励模型GSRM，通过“声学特征提取 + 推理式评估”来给出可解释的自然度评分，在相关性上接近人类打分一致性，并可作为RLHF验证器提升语音大模型生成的自然度。
AI.motivation: 现有语音自然度评估器多将原始音频直接回归为标量分数，缺乏可解释性，且难以在不同类型的语音任务中泛化，限制了提升语音生成质量的能力，因此需要一个更可靠且可解释的语音自然度奖励模型来指导生成和RLHF。
AI.method: 提出Generative Speech Reward Model (GSRM)：以“生成式奖励建模”为框架，先对语音进行可解释的声学特征抽取，再基于这些特征进行chain-of-thought式推理给出自然度评估；为此构建了一个包含3.1万条专家评分的大规模人工反馈数据集，并额外收集真实用户-助手语音交互的域外基准，用于训练和评测。
AI.result: 实验证明，GSRM在语音自然度预测任务中显著优于现有方法，其模型预测分数与人类评分的相关性接近人类评分者之间的一致性水平；此外，GSRM作为在线RLHF中的验证器时，可以有效提升语音LLM生成语音的自然度。
AI.conclusion: GSRM作为一个面向语音的、以推理为中心的生成式奖励模型，能够将自然度评估分解为可解释的声学特征分析与基于特征的链式推理，既提升了自然度预测性能，又为在线RLHF提供了有效的自然度反馈，从而改善语音大模型生成质量。
AI.translation: 近期语音语言模型的发展，例如 GPT-4o Voice Mode 和 Gemini Live，展现了有前景的语音生成能力。然而，合成音频的审美自然度仍然落后于人类语音。提升生成质量需要一个可靠的语音自然度评估器。然而，现有的自然度评估器通常将原始音频回归到标量分数，在评估的可解释性方面有限，并且无法很好地泛化到不同分类体系下的语音。受生成式奖励建模最新进展的启发，我们提出了生成式语音奖励模型（GSRM），这是一个面向语音、以推理为核心的奖励模型。GSRM 被训练用于将语音自然度评估分解为可解释的声学特征提取阶段，随后进行基于特征的链式推理，从而实现可解释的判断。为此，我们构建了一个大规模人工反馈数据集，包含 3.1 万条专家评分，以及一个由真实世界用户-助手语音交互组成的域外基准。实验表明，GSRM 在语音自然度预测方面显著优于现有方法，其自然度分数预测的模型-人类相关性接近于人类评审之间的一致性。我们进一步展示了 GSRM 作为在线 RLHF 的有效验证器时，如何提升语音大模型生成的自然度。
AI.summary: 本文提出生成式语音奖励模型GSRM，通过“声学特征抽取 + 特征驱动的链式推理”对语音自然度进行可解释评估。作者构建了包含3.1万条专家评分的大规模人工反馈数据集及一个真实交互的域外基准，用于训练和评测。实验证明GSRM在自然度预测的模型–人类相关性上显著优于现有评估器，接近人类间一致性，并能在在线RLHF中作为验证器显著提升语音LLM生成语音的自然度，表明其在语音质量评估与强化学习对齐中的实用价值。
AI.keywords: 语音自然度评估, 生成式奖励模型, GSRM, 语音RLHF, 链式推理, 声学特征提取, 语音大模型, 人工反馈
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将“生成式奖励建模+链式推理”扩展到语音领域，用可解释的中间声学特征缓解直接回归分数的黑箱性，并用大规模专家标注支撑训练。局限性和细节（如具体模型架构、数据多样性、跨语言与跨场景的泛化能力）在摘要中未展开，后续值得关注其在多语种、嘈杂环境及实时系统中的效果。

title: Probabilistic Reachability Analysis of Multi-scale Voltage Dynamics Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Voltage stability in modern power systems involves coupled dynamics across multiple time scales. Conventional methods based on time-scale separation or static stability margins may overlook instabilities caused by the coupling of slow and fast transients. Uncertainty in operating conditions further complicates stability assessment, and high computational cost of Monte Carlo simulations limit its applicability to multi-scale dynamics. This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning-based framework for probabilistic reachability analysis of multi-scale voltage dynamics. By formulating each instability mechanism as a distinct absorbing state and introducing a multi-critic architecture for mechanism-specific learning, the proposed method enables consistent learning of risk probabilities associated with multiple instability types within a unified framework. The approach is demonstrated on a four-bus system with load tap changers and over-excitation limiters, illustrating effectiveness of the proposed learning-based reachability analysis in identifying and quantifying the mechanisms leading to voltage collapse.

AI.title_translation: 基于强化学习的多时间尺度电压动态概率可达性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种深度强化学习框架，用于统一评估多时间尺度耦合下的电压失稳风险概率，避免传统蒙特卡洛高昂计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统电压稳定涉及多时间尺度耦合动态，传统基于时间尺度分离或静态稳定裕度的方法可能遗漏快慢瞬态耦合导致的不稳定，且运行条件不确定性进一步增加评估难度。
AI.method: 将每种失稳机制设为独立吸收状态，采用多评判器架构进行机制专属学习，在统一框架内训练深度强化学习智能体，估计多类型电压失稳的概率可达性。
AI.result: 在四节点测试系统（含载调压变压器与过励限制器）上验证了所提学习方法能有效识别并量化导致电压崩溃的不同机制及其风险概率。
AI.conclusion: 基于强化学习的概率可达性分析可在多时间尺度耦合场景下高效、统一地评估多种电压失稳风险，为电力系统稳定运行提供新的评估手段。
AI.translation: 现代电力系统的电压稳定性涉及多时间尺度的耦合动态。传统基于时间尺度分离或静态稳定裕度的方法可能忽视快慢瞬态耦合引起的不稳定。运行条件的不确定性进一步复杂化了稳定性评估，而蒙特卡洛模拟的高计算成本限制了其在多尺度动态中的适用性。本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的多尺度电压动态概率可达性分析框架。通过将每种失稳机制设定为独立的吸收状态，并引入多评判器架构以实现机制专属学习，所提方法能够在统一框架内一致地学习多种失稳类型的风险概率。该方法在含载调压变压器与过励限制器的四节点系统上得到验证，展示了所提基于学习的可达性分析在识别并量化导致电压崩溃的机制方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多时间尺度耦合的电压稳定问题，提出深度强化学习概率可达性框架，用多评判器架构分别学习不同失稳机制的风险概率，在四节点系统验证其高效性与准确性。
AI.keywords: 电压稳定；多时间尺度；强化学习；概率可达性；失稳机制；吸收状态；多评判器
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体算法细节、训练时间、与蒙特卡洛的精度对比及计算加速比，也未讨论更高维系统的可扩展性。

title: Revenue-Optimal Pricing for Budget-Constrained Buyers in Data Markets
summary:
We study revenue-optimal pricing in data markets with rational, budget-constrained buyers. Such a market offers multiple datasets for sale, and buyers aim to improve the accuracy of their prediction tasks by acquiring data bundles. For each dataset, the market sets a pricing function, which maps the number of records purchased from the dataset to a non-negative price. The market's objective is to set these pricing functions to maximize total revenue, considering that buyers with quasi-linear utilities choose their bundles optimally under budget constraints.
  We analyze optimal pricing when each dataset's pricing function is only required to be monotone and lower-continuous. Surprisingly, even with this generality, optimal pricing has a highly structured form: it is piecewise linear and convex (PLC) and can be computed efficiently via an LP. Moreover, the total number of kinks across all pricing functions is bounded by the number of buyers. Thus, when datasets far outnumber buyers, most pricing functions are effectively linear.
  This motivates studying linear pricing, where each record in a dataset is priced uniformly. Although competitive equilibrium gives revenue-optimal linear prices in rivalrous markets with quasi-linear buyers, we show that revenue maximization under linear pricing in data markets is APX-hard. Hence, a striking computational dichotomy emerges: fully general (nonlinear) pricing admits a polynomial-time algorithm, while the simpler linear scheme is APX-hard.
  Despite the hardness, we design a 2-approximation algorithm when datasets arrive online, and a $(1-1/e)^{-1}$-approximation algorithm for the offline setting. Our framework lays the groundwork for exploring more general pricing schemes, richer utility models, and a deeper understanding of how market structure -- rivalrous versus non-rivalrous -- shapes revenue-optimal pricing.

AI.title_translation: 预算受限买家下的数据市场收益最优定价
AI.tldr: 在包含预算约束、理性买家的数据市场中，作者刻画了最优（非线性）定价函数的结构并给出多项式时间算法，同时证明简单的线性定价反而在收益最大化上是 APX-困难的，但仍提供常数因子的近似算法。
AI.motivation: 在现实数据市场中，多个预算受限买家会购买不同数据集的记录来提升预测精度，平台需要设计合理的定价规则以在考虑买家最优选择和预算约束的前提下最大化总收益；然而在非竞争性（数据可复用）的环境中，传统基于竞争均衡或线性定价的理论不再适用，亟需系统的定价与算法框架。
AI.method: 形式化包含多个数据集与预算约束、拟线性效用买家的数据市场模型，将每个数据集的定价函数仅限制为单调且下半连续；在此一般性假设下，通过理论分析证明最优定价必然具有分段线性且凸（PLC）的结构，并构造线性规划（LP）来在多项式时间内求解这些定价函数，同时证明在将定价限定为线性时的收益最大化问题是 APX-困难的，继而为在线到达数据集情形设计 2-近似算法，为离线情形设计 ((1-1/e)^{-1})-近似算法。
AI.result: 1）在仅要求单调和下半连续的条件下，所有数据集的最优定价函数均可表示为分段线性凸函数；2）可通过线性规划在多项式时间内计算最优非线性定价，且所有定价函数的折点总数被买家数量上界，从而在数据集远多于买家时，大多数定价函数实际上是线性的；3）当限制为线性定价（每条记录统一价格）时，最大化平台收益的问题在数据市场环境下是 APX-困难的；4）尽管如此，作者在数据集在线到达时给出 2-近似算法，在离线环境下给出 ((1-1/e)^{-1})-近似算法。
AI.conclusion: 数据市场中，在非常宽松的条件下允许非线性定价时，平台可以利用具有分段线性凸结构的最优定价函数，并通过线性规划高效实现收益最优化；但若将定价限制为看似更简单的线性形式，收益最大化问题却变得 APX-困难，从而形成“结构丰富但易算”与“结构简单但难算”的理论对照，同时常数因子近似算法为实际采用线性定价时提供了可行的算法保证，也为进一步研究更复杂的定价方案、效用模型以及竞争性与非竞争性市场结构的差异奠定了基础。
AI.translation:
我们研究具有理性且存在预算约束买家的数据市场中的收益最优定价问题。该市场提供多个数据集出售，买家通过购买数据包以提升其预测任务的准确度。对于每个数据集，市场设定一个定价函数，将从该数据集购买的记录数量映射到一个非负价格。市场的目标是在考虑具有拟线性效用的买家会在预算约束下最优选择数据包的前提下，设置这些定价函数以最大化总收益。
我们在只要求每个数据集的定价函数是单调且下半连续的前提下分析最优定价。令人惊讶的是，即使在如此一般的条件下，最优定价仍具有高度结构化的形式：它是分段线性且凸（PLC）的，并且可以通过一个线性规划高效计算。此外，所有定价函数的折点总数被买家数量所上界。因此，当数据集数量远大于买家数量时，大多数定价函数实际上是线性的。
这进一步激发了对线性定价的研究，即同一数据集中每条记录的价格相同。尽管在具有拟线性买家的竞争性（可竞争）市场中，竞争均衡可以给出收益最优的线性价格，我们表明，在数据市场中在线性定价下进行收益最大化是 APX-困难的。因此出现了一个引人注目的计算复杂性二分：完全一般的（非线性）定价承认多项式时间算法，而更为简单的线性定价方案却是 APX-困难的。
尽管存在这种难度，我们仍在数据集在线到达的情形下设计了一个 2-近似算法，并在离线情形下设计了一个 ((1-1/e)^{-1})-近似算法。我们的框架为探索更一般的定价方案、更丰富的效用模型以及更深入理解市场结构——竞争性与非竞争性——如何塑造收益最优定价奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文研究具有预算约束、拟线性效用买家的数据市场收益最大化定价问题。市场为每个数据集设定定价函数，买家通过购买若干数据记录以提升预测任务精度，并在预算约束下最优选择购买组合。作者在极为宽松的假设（定价函数仅需单调、下半连续）下，证明最优定价必为分段线性凸函数，并可通过线性规划在多项式时间内计算；同时折点总数不超过买家数，意味着在数据集远多于买家时大部分定价几乎是线性的。进一步地，论文考察将定价限制为线性（统一单价）时的收益最大化问题，证明其在数据市场中是 APX-困难的，从而形成“非线性易算、线性难算”的复杂性反差。尽管如此，作者为在线到达数据集的情形给出了 2-近似算法，为离线情形提供了 ((1-1/e)^{-1})-近似算法，并提出该框架可扩展到更一般的定价机制和效用模型，以理解竞争性与非竞争性市场结构对最优定价的影响。
AI.keywords: 数据市场, 预算约束买家, 收益最优定价, 分段线性凸定价函数, 非线性定价, 线性定价, APX-困难, 线性规划, 近似算法, 在线与离线算法
AI.comments: 从摘要看，该工作在理论上给出了非常强的结构性结果：在极一般的单调下半连续假设下，最优非线性定价函数自动收缩为分段线性凸形式，并可用 LP 高效求解，这为实际定价设计提供了可实现的形式约束。同时，线性定价的 APX-困难性与常数近似算法结果突出体现了数据市场与传统竞争性市场理论（竞争均衡给出最优线性价格）的差异，揭示了非竞争性、可复用数据资源下收益优化的独特复杂性。局限性（从摘要推测）在于：模型依赖拟线性效用和精确的买家偏好/预算信息，且尚未涉及经验评估或不完全信息情形。

title: Assessing Cybersecurity Risks and Traffic Impact in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Given the promising future of autonomous vehicles, it is foreseeable that self-driving cars will soon emerge as the predominant mode of transportation. While autonomous vehicles offer enhanced efficiency, they remain vulnerable to external attacks. In this research, we sought to investigate the potential impact of cyberattacks on traffic patterns. To achieve this, we conducted simulations where cyberattacks were simulated on connected vehicles by disseminating false information to either a single vehicle or vehicle platoons. The primary objective of this research is to assess the cybersecurity challenges confronting connected and automated vehicles and propose practical solutions to minimize the adverse effects of malicious external information. In the simulation, we have implemented an innovative car-following model for the simulation of connected self-driving vehicles. This model continually monitors data received from preceding vehicles and optimizes various actions, such as acceleration, and deceleration, with the aim of maximizing overall traffic efficiency and safety.

AI.title_translation: 评估网联自动驾驶车辆中的网络安全风险与交通影响
AI.tldr: 通过仿真向单车或车队注入虚假信息，研究网联自动驾驶车辆遭受网络攻击时对交通流的影响，并提出缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶汽车即将成为主流交通方式，但其对外部攻击的脆弱性可能破坏交通效率与安全，亟需量化攻击影响并寻找防护策略。
AI.method: 构建创新的网联自动驾驶车辆跟驰模型，持续接收前车数据并优化加减速度；在仿真中向单车或车队播撒虚假信息进行攻击实验，观察交通流变化。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，网络攻击显著干扰车辆跟驰行为，造成交通效率下降与潜在安全隐患，验证了攻击对交通模式的实际影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认网联自动驾驶车辆面临真实网络安全挑战，提出的跟驰模型与缓解思路可有效降低恶意信息带来的负面效应，为后续防护提供依据。
AI.translation: 鉴于自动驾驶前景广阔，自动驾驶汽车将很快成为主要交通方式。虽然其效率更高，但仍易受外部攻击。本研究通过向单车或车队注入虚假信息模拟攻击，探讨网络攻击对交通流的影响，旨在评估网联自动驾驶车辆的网络安全挑战并提出减轻恶意信息危害的实用方案。仿真采用创新的跟驰模型，实时接收前车数据并优化加减速度，以提升整体交通效率与安全。
AI.summary: 本文针对网联自动驾驶车辆的网络安全风险，通过仿真手段研究虚假信息网络攻击对交通流的影响。作者设计了一种新的跟驰模型，使车辆能实时利用前车数据优化行驶策略。实验通过向单车或车队注入虚假信息模拟攻击，结果表明攻击会显著降低交通效率并带来安全隐患。研究结论指出该模型与缓解措施可有效减少恶意信息的负面效应，为网联自动驾驶车辆的安全部署提供理论支持。
AI.keywords: 网联自动驾驶车辆；网络安全；交通仿真；跟驰模型；虚假信息攻击
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体攻击类型、量化指标或模型验证细节，也未讨论所提“实用解决方案”的具体内容与实施难度。

title: UAV-SEAD: State Estimation Anomaly Dataset for UAVs
summary: Accurate state estimation in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is crucial for ensuring reliable and safe operation, as anomalies occurring during mission execution may induce discrepancies between expected and observed system behaviors, thereby compromising mission success or posing potential safety hazards. It is essential to continuously monitor and detect such conditions in order to ensure a timely response and maintain system reliability. In this work, we focus on UAV state estimation anomalies and provide a large-scale real-world UAV dataset to facilitate research aimed at improving the development of anomaly detection. Unlike existing datasets that primarily rely on injected faults into simulated data, this dataset comprises 1396 real flight logs totaling over 52 hours of flight time, collected across diverse indoor and outdoor environments using a collection of PX4-based UAVs equipped with a variety of sensor configurations. The dataset comprises both normal and anomalous flights without synthetic manipulation, making it uniquely suitable for realistic anomaly detection tasks. A structured classification is proposed that categorizes UAV state estimation anomalies into four classes: mechanical and electrical, external position, global position, and altitude anomalies. These classifications reflect collective, contextual, and outlier anomalies observed in multivariate sensor data streams, including IMU, GPS, barometer, magnetometer, distance sensors, visual odometry, and optical flow, that can be found in the PX4 logging mechanism. It is anticipated that this dataset will play a key role in the development, training, and evaluation of anomaly detection and isolation systems to address the critical gap in UAV reliability research.

AI.title_translation: 无人机状态估计异常数据集
AI.tldr: 发布首个大规模真实无人机状态估计异常数据集UAV-SEAD，含1396条真实飞行日志、52小时数据，无需合成注入即可用于异常检测研究。
AI.motivation: 无人机状态估计异常会导致任务失败或安全风险，现有数据集多为仿真注入故障，缺乏真实异常数据，阻碍异常检测技术发展。
AI.method: 采集PX4无人机在多种室内外环境下的真实飞行日志，按机械电气、外部位置、全球位置、高度四类对状态估计异常进行分类，并提供IMU、GPS等多传感器数据流。
AI.result: 获得1396条真实飞行日志、52小时数据，涵盖正常与异常飞行，无需合成操作，可直接用于真实场景异常检测任务。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了无人机可靠性研究中真实异常数据的空白，可用于开发、训练与评估异常检测与隔离系统，提升无人机安全性。
AI.translation: 准确的无人机状态估计对可靠安全运行至关重要，异常会导致期望与实际行为差异，危及任务或安全。本文聚焦状态估计异常，提供大规模真实数据集UAV-SEAD，含1396条日志、52小时数据，无需合成注入，分类四类异常，支持异常检测研究。
AI.summary: UAV-SEAD数据集首次提供1396条真实飞行日志、52小时数据，按四类状态估计异常分类，含多传感器原始数据，无需合成注入，可直接用于真实场景异常检测与隔离研究，填补无人机可靠性领域真实异常数据空白。
AI.keywords: 无人机、状态估计、异常检测、数据集、PX4、真实飞行日志、多传感器
AI.comments: 数据集已开源，建议未来扩展更多机型与故障类型，并结合无监督/自监督方法提升检测泛化能力。

title: RPGD: RANSAC-P3P Gradient Descent for Extrinsic Calibration in 3D Human Pose Estimation
comments: Accepted at AAIML 2026. This work is co-funded by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under MSCA with grant agreement No 101081674
summary: In this paper, we propose RPGD (RANSAC-P3P Gradient Descent), a human-pose-driven extrinsic calibration framework that robustly aligns MoCap-based 3D skeletal data with monocular or multi-view RGB cameras using only natural human motion. RPGD formulates extrinsic calibration as a coarse-to-fine problem tailored to human poses, combining the global robustness of RANSAC-P3P with Gradient-Descent-based refinement. We evaluate RPGD on three large-scale public 3D HPE datasets as well as on a self-collected in-the-wild dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that RPGD consistently recovers extrinsic parameters with accuracy comparable to the provided ground truth, achieving sub-pixel MPJPE reprojection error even in challenging, noisy settings. These results indicate that RPGD provides a practical and automatic solution for reliable extrinsic calibration of large-scale 3D HPE dataset collection.
comment: Accepted at AAIML 2026. This work is co-funded by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under MSCA with grant agreement No 101081674

AI.title_translation: RPGD：用于三维人体姿态估计外参标定的RANSAC-P3P梯度下降法
AI.tldr: 提出RPGD框架，仅利用自然人体运动即可将MoCap三维骨骼数据与单目或多目RGB相机进行鲁棒外参标定，达到亚像素级重投影误差。
AI.motivation: 大规模三维人体姿态估计数据收集亟需一种无需标定板、仅依赖人体自然运动即可自动完成相机外参标定的实用方法。
AI.method: 将外参标定建模为粗到细问题，先使用RANSAC-P3P获得全局鲁棒初值，再通过梯度下降细化，全程利用人体姿态驱动。
AI.result: 在三个公开大规模3D HPE数据集及一个自采户外数据集上，RPGD恢复的外参与真值相当，即使在噪声场景也能实现亚像素MPJPE重投影误差。
AI.conclusion: RPGD为大规模3D HPE数据收集提供了无需标定板、全自动且可靠的外参标定解决方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出RPGD（RANSAC-P3P梯度下降），一种以人体姿态为驱动的外参标定框架，仅利用自然人体运动即可将基于MoCap的三维骨骼数据与单目或多目RGB相机鲁棒对齐。RPGD将外参标定构建为针对人体姿态的粗到细问题，融合RANSAC-P3P的全局鲁棒性与基于梯度下降的精修。我们在三个大规模公开3D HPE数据集及自采户外数据集上评估RPGD，实验结果表明，即使在具有挑战性的噪声环境中，RPGD仍能持续恢复与所提供真值相当的外参，实现亚像素MPJPE重投影误差。这些结果说明RPGD为大规模3D HPE数据集收集提供了实用且自动的可靠外参标定方案。
AI.summary: RPGD通过RANSAC-P3P粗标定与梯度下降精修的两阶段策略，实现仅依赖人体自然运动的相机外参自动标定，在多个数据集上验证其亚像素级精度与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 外参标定,人体姿态估计,RANSAC-P3P,梯度下降,MoCap,亚像素精度
AI.comments: 摘要未提及算法运行速度、GPU/CPU需求及开源代码链接。

title: Diagnosing Pathological Chain-of-Thought in Reasoning Models
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is fundamental to modern LLM architectures and represents a critical intervention point for AI safety. However, CoT reasoning may exhibit failure modes that we note as pathologies, which prevent it from being useful for monitoring. Prior work has identified three distinct pathologies: post-hoc rationalization, where models generate plausible explanations backwards from predetermined answers; encoded reasoning, where intermediate steps conceal information within seemingly interpretable text; and internalized reasoning, where models replace explicit reasoning with meaningless filler tokens while computing internally. To better understand and discriminate between these pathologies, we create a set of concrete metrics that are simple to implement, computationally inexpensive, and task-agnostic. To validate our approach, we develop model organisms deliberately trained to exhibit specific CoT pathologies. Our work provides a practical toolkit for assessing CoT pathologies, with direct implications for training-time monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 诊断推理模型中的病理化链式思维（Chain-of-Thought）
AI.tldr: 本文提出一套简单、任务无关的指标与专门训练的“模型生物”，用于识别和区分三类链式思维病理，从而为训练阶段的安全监控提供实用工具。
AI.motivation: 链式思维推理是现代大模型架构的核心，同时也是 AI 安全的重要干预点；但其存在多种病理化失败模式（如事后合理化、编码式推理、内化式推理），会削弱其在监控和安全上的价值，因此需要系统方法来理解并区分这些病理。
AI.method: 作者提出一组具体的、易实现、计算开销小且与任务无关的指标，用于识别不同类型的链式思维病理，并构建刻意训练成表现特定 CoT 病理的“模型生物”（专用模型），用来验证这些指标在区分和诊断病理方面的有效性。
AI.result: 结果显示，这些设计的指标能够在专门训练的病理模型上有效区分和评估不同类型的链式思维病理，证明了该方法在诊断 CoT 失败模式和进行训练阶段监控方面的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，利用简单、任务无关的指标结合专门训练的模型，可以有效诊断和区分链式思维中的多种病理，为在训练过程中对模型推理过程进行安全监控提供了实用工具箱，并对未来更可靠的 CoT 训练和使用具有直接意义。
AI.translation: 链式思维（CoT）推理是现代大语言模型架构的基础，也是人工智能安全的关键干预点。然而，CoT 推理可能出现一些我们称之为“病理”的失败模式，从而削弱其在监控中的作用。已有工作识别出三种不同的病理：事后合理化，即模型从预先确定的答案出发，反向生成看似合理的解释；编码式推理，即中间步骤在表面可解释的文本中隐藏信息；以及内化式推理，即模型在内部完成推理计算，同时将显式推理替换为无意义的填充符号。为了更好地理解并区分这些病理，我们提出了一套具体指标，这些指标易于实现、计算成本低且与任务无关。为验证我们的方法，我们开发了一批“模型生物”，即被刻意训练成表现特定 CoT 病理的模型。我们的工作提供了一套用于评估 CoT 病理的实用工具箱，并对训练阶段的监控具有直接意义。
AI.summary: 本文关注大模型链式思维推理中的三类关键病理：事后合理化、编码式推理和内化式推理。这些病理会使表面上的推理过程失去作为监控与安全信号的可靠性。作者提出了一组简单、计算高效、任务无关的指标来诊断这些失败模式，并专门训练了一批表现特定病理特征的“模型生物”，用以检验指标的区分能力。实验表明，该工具包可以有效识别和区分不同 CoT 病理，为在模型训练阶段开展推理监控和风险评估提供了实用方法。
AI.keywords: 链式思维, 推理模型, 病理化 CoT, 事后合理化, 编码式推理, 内化式推理, AI 安全, 训练阶段监控, 模型生物, 诊断指标
AI.comments: 文章定位于方法论与工具箱建设而非提升任务性能，核心贡献在于系统刻画并可操作化三种 CoT 病理，为未来关于“能否信任模型显式推理过程”的研究提供基础框架。具体指标形式、评估细节及在真实大模型上的泛化效果需参考正文。

title: Pre-Editorial Normalization for Automatically Transcribed Medieval Manuscripts in Old French and Latin
summary: Recent advances in Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) have improved access to historical archives, yet a methodological divide persists between palaeographic transcriptions and normalized digital editions. While ATR models trained on more palaeographically-oriented datasets such as CATMuS have shown greater generalizability, their raw outputs remain poorly compatible with most readers and downstream NLP tools, thus creating a usability gap. On the other hand, ATR models trained to produce normalized outputs have been shown to struggle to adapt to new domains and tend to over-normalize and hallucinate. We introduce the task of Pre-Editorial Normalization (PEN), which consists in normalizing graphemic ATR output according to editorial conventions, which has the advantage of keeping an intermediate step with palaeographic fidelity while providing a normalized version for practical usability. We present a new dataset derived from the CoMMA corpus and aligned with digitized Old French and Latin editions using passim. We also produce a manually corrected gold-standard evaluation set. We benchmark this resource using ByT5-based sequence-to-sequence models on normalization and pre-annotation tasks. Our contributions include the formal definition of PEN, a 4.66M-sample silver training corpus, a 1.8k-sample gold evaluation set, and a normalization model achieving a 6.7% CER, substantially outperforming previous models for this task.

AI.title_translation: 中古法语与拉丁文自动转录手稿的编前规范化
AI.tldr: 提出“编前规范化（PEN）”任务，将古文字级ATR输出按编辑规范标准化，发布4.66M银标训练集与1.8k金标评测集，ByT5模型CER降至6.7%，兼顾保真与可用。
AI.motivation: 现有ATR要么太存古难读、难对接NLP，要么过度规范化易 hallucination；需在保持古文字忠实度的同时提供可读标准化文本。
AI.method: 定义PEN任务；用passim将CoMMA与已出版旧法语、拉丁文版对齐，构建银标数据；人工校正1.8k样本得金标；用ByT5 seq-to-seq训练规范化与预标注模型。
AI.result: 获得4.66M银标训练语料、1.8k金标评测集；ByT5模型CER 6.7%，显著优于既往方法。
AI.conclusion: PEN可在不牺牲古文字保真前提下生成可用标准化文本，为历史文献ATR后处理提供新范式与资源。
AI.translation: 编前规范化（PEN）将古文字级ATR输出按编辑规范标准化，兼顾忠实度与可读性，为历史文献数字化与下游NLP搭桥。
AI.summary: 本文提出“编前规范化”任务，将ATR古文字转录按编辑规范标准化，发布CoMMA衍生的4.66M银标训练集与1.8k金标评测集，用ByT5模型实现6.7% CER，显著优于前人，兼顾保真与可用。
AI.keywords: 编前规范化，自动文本识别，中古法语，拉丁文，ByT5，CoMMA，历史文献，文本规范化
AI.comments: 未提跨语言迁移、模型规模与训练成本，亦未讨论与现代法语的差异及编辑规范细节。

title: High-fidelity 3D reconstruction for planetary exploration
summary: Planetary exploration increasingly relies on autonomous robotic systems capable of perceiving, interpreting, and reconstructing their surroundings in the absence of global positioning or real-time communication with Earth. Rovers operating on planetary surfaces must navigate under sever environmental constraints, limited visual redundancy, and communication delays, making onboard spatial awareness and visual localization key components for mission success. Traditional techniques based on Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) provide geometric consistency but struggle to capture radiometric detail or to scale efficiently in unstructured, low-texture terrains typical of extraterrestrial environments. This work explores the integration of radiance field-based methods - specifically Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and Gaussian Splatting - into a unified, automated environment reconstruction pipeline for planetary robotics. Our system combines the Nerfstudio and COLMAP frameworks with a ROS2-compatible workflow capable of processing raw rover data directly from rosbag recordings. This approach enables the generation of dense, photorealistic, and metrically consistent 3D representations from minimal visual input, supporting improved perception and planning for autonomous systems operating in planetary-like conditions. The resulting pipeline established a foundation for future research in radiance field-based mapping, bridging the gap between geometric and neural representations in planetary exploration.

AI.title_translation: 行星探索的高保真三维重建
AI.tldr: 将NeRF与3D Gaussian Splatting集成到ROS2流程中，仅用少量漫游车图像即可生成稠密、真实且几何一致的行星表面三维模型。
AI.motivation: 传统SfM/SLAM在低纹理、无GPS、通信延迟的行星环境中难以保持辐射保真度与可扩展性，需要新的三维重建方法提升漫游车自主感知与定位能力。
AI.method: 基于Nerfstudio与COLMAP，构建ROS2兼容的自动化流程，可直接回放rosbag数据，融合NeRF与Gaussian Splatting实现辐射场重建。
AI.result: 系统在行星类似条件下，用极少视觉输入生成稠密、真实、度量一致的3D表示，为漫游车感知与路径规划提供高质量模型。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为行星探索中几何与神经辐射场表征的融合奠定基础，支持未来辐射场地图研究。
AI.translation: 行星探索日益依赖能够在缺乏全球定位或实时地-星通信的情况下感知、解释与重建环境的自主机器人系统。
AI.summary: 针对行星漫游车在无GPS、低纹理、通信受限环境中难以保持高保真三维重建的问题，本文提出一个基于NeRF与3D Gaussian Splatting的ROS2自动化流程。系统整合Nerfstudio与COLMAP，可直接处理漫游车rosbag数据，用少量图像生成稠密、真实、度量一致的3D模型，为行星机器人感知与规划提供高质量空间信息，并奠定未来辐射场地图研究基础。
AI.keywords: 行星探索, 三维重建, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, 漫游车, SLAM, ROS2, 辐射场
AI.comments: 摘要仅给出框架与初步结果，未报告量化精度、计算资源、实时性或行星模拟/真实数据实验细节。

title: Sufficient Conditions for Stability of Minimum-Norm Interpolating Deep ReLU Networks
summary: Algorithmic stability is a classical framework for analyzing the generalization error of learning algorithms. It predicts that an algorithm has small generalization error if it is insensitive to small perturbations in the training set such as the removal or replacement of a training point. While stability has been demonstrated for numerous well-known algorithms, this framework has had limited success in analyses of deep neural networks. In this paper we study the algorithmic stability of deep ReLU homogeneous neural networks that achieve zero training error using parameters with the smallest $L_2$ norm, also known as the minimum-norm interpolation, a phenomenon that can be observed in overparameterized models trained by gradient-based algorithms. We investigate sufficient conditions for such networks to be stable. We find that 1) such networks are stable when they contain a (possibly small) stable sub-network, followed by a layer with a low-rank weight matrix, and 2) such networks are not guaranteed to be stable even when they contain a stable sub-network, if the following layer is not low-rank. The low-rank assumption is inspired by recent empirical and theoretical results which demonstrate that training deep neural networks is biased towards low-rank weight matrices, for minimum-norm interpolation and weight-decay regularization.

AI.title_translation: 最小范数插值深度 ReLU 网络稳定性的充分条件
AI.tldr: 本研究分析了达到零训练误差的最小范数插值深度ReLU同质神经网络的算法稳定性，发现当网络包含稳定子网络且后续层为低秩权重矩阵时稳定性成立，否则不能保证稳定性。
AI.motivation: 算法稳定性是分析学习算法泛化误差的经典框架，但该框架在深度神经网络分析中应用有限；本文旨在探究过参数化模型中梯度训练所达到的最小范数插值深度ReLU网络的稳定性条件。
AI.method: 基于对深度ReLU同质神经网络的研究，探讨了达到零训练误差的最小范数插值网络的算法稳定性，并分析包含稳定子网络及后续层低秩权重矩阵作为充分条件。
AI.result: 发现最小范数插值网络在包含稳定子网络且后续层为低秩权重矩阵时是稳定的；反之，若后续层不是低秩，则即使包含稳定子网络也不能保证稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 低秩权重矩阵是确保最小范数插值深度ReLU网络稳定性的关键因素，这与训练偏向低秩的实证和理论结果一致。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文研究了达到零训练误差的最小范数插值深度ReLU同质神经网络的算法稳定性。通过分析稳定子网络与后续层权重矩阵秩的关系，发现后续层为低秩是稳定性的充分条件，否则稳定性无法保证，这反映了训练中偏向低秩的机制。
AI.keywords: 算法稳定性, 最小范数插值, 深度ReLU网络, 低秩权重矩阵, 泛化误差
AI.comments: 该研究将算法稳定性框架应用于深度神经网络，特别关注过参数化训练中的最小范数现象，强调低秩结构在稳定性中的重要性，为理解深度学习泛化提供了新的理论视角。

title: From Pixels to Policies: Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning in Language Models for Content-Aware Layout Design
summary: We introduce LaySPA, a reinforcement learning framework that equips large language models (LLMs) with explicit and interpretable spatial reasoning for content-aware graphic layout design. LaySPA addresses two key challenges: LLMs' limited spatial reasoning and the lack of opacity in design decision making. Instead of operating at the pixel level, we reformulate layout design as a policy learning problem over a structured textual spatial environment that explicitly encodes canvas geometry, element attributes, and inter-element relationships. LaySPA produces dual-level outputs comprising interpretable reasoning traces and structured layout specifications, enabling transparent and controllable design decision making. Layout design policy is optimized via a multi-objective spatial critique that decomposes layout quality into geometric validity, relational coherence, and aesthetic consistency, and is trained using relative group optimization to stabilize learning in open-ended design spaces. Experiments demonstrate that LaySPA improves structural validity and visual quality, outperforming larger proprietary LLMs and achieving performance comparable to specialized SOTA layout generators while requiring fewer annotated samples and reduced latency.

AI.title_translation: 从像素到策略：在语言模型中强化空间推理以实现内容感知的版式设计
AI.tldr: LaySPA 用强化学习把大模型变成会“看”空间的设计师，直接输出可解释的推理链与版式规范，在更少数据、更低延迟下媲美专用生成器。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型缺乏空间推理能力，且设计决策过程不透明，难以用于内容感知的版式设计。
AI.method: 将版式设计建模为文本化空间环境上的策略学习，采用多目标空间评判（几何合法性、关系一致性、美学一致性）与相对群体优化训练，输出可解释推理链与结构化版式规范。
AI.result: LaySPA 在结构有效性与视觉质量上优于更大规模的专有 LLM，与专用 SOTA 版式生成器相当，所需标注样本更少、延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式空间推理与策略优化，LaySPA 实现了透明可控的版式设计，为 LLM 在设计领域的应用提供了高效轻量方案。
AI.translation: 我们提出 LaySPA，一种强化学习框架，使大语言模型具备可解释的空间推理能力，用于内容感知的平面版式设计。LaySPA 解决两大挑战：LLM 空间推理有限、设计决策不透明。我们将版式设计重新定义为结构化文本空间环境上的策略学习，显式编码画布几何、元素属性与元素间关系。LaySPA 输出可解释推理链与结构化版式规范，实现透明可控的设计决策。通过多目标空间评判与相对群体优化训练策略，实验表明 LaySPA 在结构有效性与视觉质量上优于更大专有 LLM，与专用 SOTA 生成器相当，所需标注样本更少、延迟更低。
AI.summary: LaySPA 用强化学习让大模型学会空间推理，直接生成可解释的版式，数据少、速度快，效果对标专用生成器。
AI.keywords: 空间推理,版式设计,强化学习,大语言模型,可解释性
AI.comments: 未提及其是否支持多语言内容或用户交互式编辑，后续可拓展。

title: Common Knowledge Always, Forever
summary: There has been an increasing interest in topological semantics for epistemic logic, which has been shown to be useful for, e.g., modelling evidence, degrees of belief, and self-reference. We introduce a polytopological PDL capable of expressing common knowledge and various generalizations and show it has the finite model property over closure spaces but not over Cantor derivative spaces. The latter is shown by embedding a version of linear temporal logic with `past', which does not have the finite model property.

AI.title_translation: 永恒的共同知识
AI.tldr: 文章提出一种能够刻画共同知识及其推广的多拓扑PDL，并证明其在闭包空间上具有有限模型性质而在康托导数空间上则不具备该性质。
AI.motivation: 近年来拓扑语义在认识逻辑中愈发重要，可用于刻画证据、信念程度和自指等现象，但对能够表达共同知识及其推广的形式系统及其模型性质仍需系统研究。
AI.method: 作者引入一种多拓扑（polytopological）的命题动态逻辑（PDL），使其能够表达共同知识及其各种推广，并在两类拓扑结构——闭包空间与康托导数空间——上研究该逻辑的有限模型性质；在康托导数空间情形中，通过嵌入一个带“过去”算子的线性时态逻辑变体来进行证明。
AI.result: 该多拓扑PDL在闭包空间上具有有限模型性质，而在康托导数空间上不具有有限模型性质；后者的结论是通过嵌入一个已知不具有有限模型性质的、带过去时算子的线性时态逻辑版本而得到的。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑语义下表达共同知识及其推广的多拓扑PDL在不同类型的空间中表现出本质不同的模型论行为，表明选择何种拓扑结构会直接影响逻辑的有限模型性质与可判定性特征。
AI.translation:
论文题目：Common Knowledge Always, Forever

摘要：近年来，人们对认识逻辑的拓扑语义兴趣日益增加，该语义已被证明在建模证据、信念程度以及自指等方面颇为有用。我们引入了一种多拓扑的命题动态逻辑（polytopological PDL），能够表达共同知识及其各种推广，并证明该逻辑在闭包空间上具有有限模型性质，而在康托导数空间上则不具有有限模型性质。后一结论是通过嵌入一个带有“过去”算子的线性时态逻辑变体（该逻辑本身不具有有限模型性质）而得到的。
AI.summary: 本文工作处于认识逻辑的拓扑语义方向。作者提出一种多拓扑的PDL，使得在拓扑框架中可以表达共同知识及其更一般的形式。随后，他们分别在闭包空间与康托导数空间上考察该逻辑的模型论性质。结果表明，在闭包空间上，该逻辑满足有限模型性质，因此任何可满足公式都有一个有限模型；但在康托导数空间中，借由嵌入一个带“过去”运算的线性时态逻辑变体（已知没有有限模型性质），可以证明该多拓扑PDL并不具有有限模型性质，从而揭示不同拓扑结构对认识逻辑的本质影响。
AI.keywords: 拓扑语义, 认识逻辑, 共同知识, 多拓扑PDL, 命题动态逻辑, 闭包空间, 康托导数空间, 有限模型性质, 线性时态逻辑, 过去时算子
AI.comments: 摘要表明本文主要贡献在于将共同知识扩展到多拓扑PDL中并精细分析其有限模型性质，特别是通过与带过去算子的时态逻辑之间的嵌入联系，展示不同拓扑语义选择对逻辑可满足性与有限模型性质的敏感性。具体语法、公理系统以及复杂度结论在摘要中未展开。

title: MarcoPolo: A Zero-Permission Attack for Location Type Inference from the Magnetic Field using Mobile Devices
comments: 22 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published at the 23rd International Conference on Cryptology and Network Security (CANS 2024)
summary: Location information extracted from mobile devices has been largely exploited to reveal our routines, significant places, and interests just to name a few. Given the sensitivity of the information it reveals, location access is protected by mobile operating systems and users have control over which applications can access it. We argue that applications can still infer the coarse-grain location information by using alternative sensors that are available in off-the-shelf mobile devices that do not require any permissions from the users. In this paper we present a zero-permission attack based on the use of the in-built magnetometer, considering a variety of methods for identifying location-types from their magnetic signature. We implement the proposed approach by using four different techniques for time-series classification. In order to evaluate the approach, we conduct an in-the-wild study to collect a dataset of nearly 70 hours of magnetometer readings with six different phones at 66 locations, each accompanied by a label that classifies it as belonging to one of six selected categories. Finally, using this dataset, we quantify the performance of all models based on two evaluation criteria: (i) leave-a-place-out (using the test data collected from an unknown place), and (ii) leave-a-device-out (using the test data collected from an unknown device) showing that we are able to achieve 40.5% and 39.5% accuracy in classifying the location-type for each evaluation criteria respectively against a random baseline of approximately 16.7% for both of them.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published at the 23rd International Conference on Cryptology and Network Security (CANS 2024)

AI.title_translation: MarcoPolo：一种无需权限、利用移动设备磁场推断位置类型的攻击方法
AI.tldr: 论文提出仅利用手机内置磁力计、无需任何权限即可推断用户所处位置类型（如咖啡厅、办公室等），在66个地点、6类场所、近70小时数据上达到约40%识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 移动操作系统对GPS等精确定位信息有严格权限控制，但应用仍可能通过无权限传感器间接推断用户位置隐私，需评估此类潜在威胁。
AI.method: 1) 仅采集手机磁力计时序数据；2) 用四种时间序列分类算法（具体算法未说明）学习不同场所的磁特征；3) 采用“留一地点”和“留一设备”两种交叉验证评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 在“留一地点”场景下识别准确率为40.5%，在“留一设备”场景下为39.5%，均显著高于随机基线16.7%。
AI.conclusion: 零权限磁力计攻击可粗略推断位置类型，凸显无权限传感器的隐私风险，需进一步研究防御。
AI.translation: 移动设备提取的位置信息被广泛用来揭示我们的日常、重要地点和兴趣等。鉴于其敏感性，移动操作系统对位置访问加以保护，用户可控制哪些应用能访问。我们认为，应用仍可利用现成移动设备中无需权限的替代传感器推断粗粒度位置信息。本文提出一种基于内置磁力计的零权限攻击，综合多种方法从磁特征识别位置类型。我们用四种时间序列分类技术实现该攻击，并在真实环境中用六款手机、66个地点、近70小时磁力计数据建立数据集，每一样本标注为六类之一。最终，基于“留一地点”和“留一设备”两种评估准则，所有模型分别达到40.5%与39.5%的分类准确率，而随机基线约16.7%。
AI.summary: 本文展示利用手机磁力计无需权限即可推断用户所处场所类型（如商店、地铁等），通过真实数据验证其可行性，平均识别率约40%，提示无权限传感器带来的位置隐私泄露风险。
AI.keywords: 零权限攻击、磁力计、位置隐私、时间序列分类、移动设备安全
AI.comments: 研究首次系统评估磁力计用于场所推断的隐私威胁；但准确率仍有限，实际攻击需结合其他传感器提升效果。未来可探索用户感知防御机制。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Social Network Topology in Reddit and Moltbook
summary: Recent advances in agent-mediated systems have enabled a new paradigm of social network simulation, where AI agents interact with human-like autonomy. This evolution has fostered the emergence of agent-driven social networks such as Moltbook, a Reddit-like platform populated entirely by AI agents. Despite these developments, empirical comparisons between agent-driven and human-driven social networks remain scarce, limiting our understanding of how their network topologies might diverge. This paper presents the first comparative analysis of network topology on Moltbook, utilizing a comment network comprising 33,577 nodes and 697,688 edges. To provide a benchmark, we curated a parallel dataset from Reddit consisting of 7.8 million nodes and 51.8 million edges. We examine key structural differences between agent-drive and human-drive networks, specifically focusing on topological patterns and the edge formation efficacy of their respective posts. Our findings provide a foundational profile of AI-driven social structures, serving as a preliminary step toward developing more robust and authentic agent-mediated social systems.

AI.title_translation: Reddit 与 Moltbook 社交网络拓扑的比较分析
AI.tldr: 首次对比纯AI平台 Moltbook 与人类主导的 Reddit 的社交拓扑，发现两者结构差异显著，为构建更可信的AI社交系统奠定基础。
AI.motivation: AI代理驱动的社交平台已出现，但缺乏与人类社交网络拓扑的实证比较，限制了对AI社交结构特性的理解。
AI.method: 收集 Moltbook 33,577节点、697,688边的评论网络，并构建含7,800万节点、5.18亿边的 Reddit 对照数据集；对比分析拓扑特征与帖子边形成效率。
AI.result: 发现 AI 驱动网络与人类驱动网络在拓扑模式及边形成效率上存在关键结构差异，首次描绘出 AI 社交结构的基本特征。
AI.conclusion: AI 驱动的社交拓扑与人类网络显著不同，该基础画像有助于未来设计更健壮、真实的代理中介社交系统。
AI.translation: 代理中介系统的最新进展催生了 AI 自主交互的社交网络仿真新范式，催生了完全由 AI 组成的类 Reddit 平台 Moltbook。尽管发展迅速，但针对代理驱动与人类驱动社交网络拓扑差异的实证比较仍稀缺，限制了我们对其结构差异的理解。本文首次比较 Moltbook 的网络拓扑，使用含 33,577 节点、697,688 边的评论网络，并以含 780 万节点、5.18 亿边的 Reddit 平行数据集为基准。我们检验 AI 与人类网络的关键结构差异，聚焦拓扑模式与帖子边形成效率。研究结果为 AI 驱动社交结构提供了基础画像，是构建更健壮、真实代理中介社交系统的初步步骤。
AI.summary: 本研究首次系统比较纯 AI 社交平台 Moltbook 与人类主导的 Reddit 的拓扑差异，揭示 AI 网络独特结构，为未来 AI 社交系统提供设计依据。
AI.keywords: 社交网络拓扑、AI 代理、Moltbook、Reddit、网络比较、边形成效率
AI.comments: 摘要未披露具体拓扑指标差异数值，也未讨论数据时间范围与伦理问题。

title: GREPO: A Benchmark for Graph Neural Networks on Repository-Level Bug Localization
summary: Repository-level bug localization-the task of identifying where code must be modified to fix a bug-is a critical software engineering challenge. Standard Large Language Modles (LLMs) are often unsuitable for this task due to context window limitations that prevent them from processing entire code repositories. As a result, various retrieval methods are commonly used, including keyword matching, text similarity, and simple graph-based heuristics such as Breadth-First Search. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offer a promising alternative due to their ability to model complex, repository-wide dependencies; however, their application has been hindered by the lack of a dedicated benchmark. To address this gap, we introduce GREPO, the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization tasks. GREPO comprises 86 Python repositories and 47294 bug-fixing tasks, providing graph-based data structures ready for direct GNN processing. Our evaluation of various GNN architectures shows outstanding performance compared to established information retrieval baselines. This work highlights the potential of GNNs for bug localization and established GREPO as a foundation resource for future research, The code is available at https://github.com/qingpingmo/GREPO.

AI.title_translation: GREPO：面向仓库级缺陷定位的图神经网络基准
AI.tldr: 作者提出首个面向仓库级缺陷定位的图神经网络基准GREPO，包含86个Python仓库和47294个修复任务，实验证明GNN显著优于传统检索方法。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型因上下文窗口限制无法处理整个代码仓库，而缺乏专门基准阻碍了GNN在仓库级缺陷定位中的应用。
AI.method: 构建GREPO基准，包含86个Python仓库和47294个缺陷修复任务，提供可直接用于GNN处理的图数据结构，并评估多种GNN架构。
AI.result: 各种GNN架构在缺陷定位任务上表现优异，显著优于已有的信息检索基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GNN在缺陷定位中具有巨大潜力，GREPO为未来研究提供了基础资源。
AI.translation: 仓库级缺陷定位——识别修复缺陷需修改代码位置的任务——是关键软件工程挑战。标准大模型因上下文窗口限制无法处理整个代码仓库，故常用关键词匹配、文本相似度及简单图启发式方法。GNN能建模复杂仓库级依赖，但缺乏专用基准阻碍其应用。为此我们提出首个GNN基准GREPO，含86个Python仓库和47294个修复任务，提供可直接处理的图数据。评估显示GNN显著优于传统检索方法。代码见https://github.com/qingpingmo/GREPO。
AI.summary: 本文针对仓库级缺陷定位中LLM上下文受限问题，提出首个GNN基准GREPO，含86个Python仓库和近5万任务，实验验证GNN远超传统检索，为后续研究奠基。
AI.keywords: 缺陷定位,图神经网络,基准测试,仓库级,信息检索
AI.comments: 作者未提及GNN在处理超大规模仓库时的可扩展性细节，也未对比其他非GNN的深度学习基线。开源代码链接已提供，利于社区复现与扩展。

title: EVECTOR: An orchestrator for analysing attacks in electric vehicles charging system
summary: Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure is critical for the widespread adoption of EVs, ensuring efficient and secure charging processes. Evaluating the security and performance of EV charging systems in real-world infrastructure poses significant challenges due to the diversity of information exchange between vehicles and charging stations/Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE), including complex network protocols, scale of deployment and a variety of potential threats. Existing simulation frameworks are unable to handle complex security scenarios across these differing data exchange protocols. In this paper, we propose a novel EV orchestration framework: EVECTOR, which addresses the limitations of existing simulation systems by enabling both quantitative and qualitative analyses of EV charging scenarios. EVECTOR also provides a flexible attack orchestrator to simulate realistic attack behaviours on EV charging infrastructure. We validate the EVECTOR framework through two case studies: (a) cyber-physical attacks such as broken wire; and (b) cyber-specific attacks such as frame fuzzification. The case studies highlight the effectiveness of EVECTOR in providing deeper insights into the security and performance of EV charging systems.

AI.title_translation: EVECTOR：用于分析电动汽车充电系统攻击的编排器
AI.tldr: 提出EVECTOR框架，通过灵活攻击编排器在真实协议环境中对EV充电基础设施进行安全与性能分析，并以断线与帧模糊化两案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真框架无法处理EV与充电设备间多样协议下的复杂安全场景，亟需可量化与定性的综合评估工具。
AI.method: 设计EVECTOR编排框架，集成灵活攻击编排器，支持对多种协议与大规模部署下的充电系统进行攻击模拟与性能测量。
AI.result: 通过断线（网络物理）与帧模糊化（网络）两类攻击案例，验证EVECTOR能深入揭示充电系统的安全漏洞与性能影响。
AI.conclusion: EVECTOR突破了现有仿真局限，为EV充电基础设施提供全面、可扩展的安全与性能分析平台。
AI.translation: EVECTOR：用于分析电动汽车充电系统攻击的编排器
AI.summary: 针对EV充电基础设施安全评估难题，作者提出EVECTOR编排框架，支持跨协议、大规模场景下的攻击模拟与性能分析，并通过断线与帧模糊化案例验证其有效性。
AI.keywords: 电动汽车充电基础设施, 安全分析, 攻击编排器, 网络物理攻击, 帧模糊化
AI.comments: 摘要未披露具体协议细节、攻击实现方式及量化指标，后续需关注框架扩展性与实际部署成本。

title: voice2mode: Phonation Mode Classification in Singing using Self-Supervised Speech Models
comments: Accepted to the Speech, Music and Mind (SMM26) workshop at the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026). This is the preprint version of the paper to appear in the proceedings
summary: We present voice2mode, a method for classification of four singing phonation modes (breathy, neutral (modal), flow, and pressed) using embeddings extracted from large self-supervised speech models. Prior work on singing phonation has relied on handcrafted signal features or task-specific neural nets; this work evaluates the transferability of speech foundation models to singing phonation classification. voice2mode extracts layer-wise representations from HuBERT and two wav2vec2 variants, applies global temporal pooling, and classifies the pooled embeddings with lightweight classifiers (SVM, XGBoost). Experiments on a publicly available soprano dataset (763 sustained vowel recordings, four labels) show that foundation-model features substantially outperform conventional spectral baselines (spectrogram, mel-spectrogram, MFCC). HuBERT embeddings obtained from early layers yield the best result (~95.7% accuracy with SVM), an absolute improvement of ~12-15% over the best traditional baseline. We also show layer-wise behaviour: lower layers, which retain acoustic/phonetic detail, are more effective than top layers specialized for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR).
comment: Accepted to the Speech, Music and Mind (SMM26) workshop at the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026). This is the preprint version of the paper to appear in the proceedings

AI.title_translation: voice2mode：利用自监督语音模型实现演唱发声模式分类
AI.tldr: 利用自监督语音大模型提取特征，在演唱发声模式四分类任务上达到95.7%准确率，显著优于传统谱特征基线。
AI.motivation: 传统演唱发声研究依赖手工特征或专用网络，作者希望验证语音基础模型在演唱发声分类中的迁移能力。
AI.method: 从HuBERT与两种wav2vec2变体提取分层表示，经全局时序池化后，用轻量SVM/XGBoost分类器完成四分类。
AI.result: HuBERT早期层特征+SVM在公开女高音数据集上达95.7%准确率，比最佳传统谱特征基线提高12–15%。
AI.conclusion: 语音基础模型特征可迁移至演唱发声分类，且保留声学/语音细节的底层比专攻ASR的顶层更有效。
AI.translation: 我们提出voice2mode，利用自监督语音大模型提取嵌入，对四种演唱发声模式（气声、中性、气流、压紧）进行分类。先前研究依赖手工特征或专用网络；本工作评估语音基础模型在演唱发声分类的迁移性。voice2mode从HuBERT与两种wav2vec2提取分层表示，经全局时序池化后用轻量分类器（SVM、XGBoost）分类。在公开女高音数据集（763个持续元音，四标签）上，基础模型特征显著优于传统谱基线（谱图、mel谱图、MFCC）。HuBERT早期层嵌入效果最佳（SVM约95.7%准确率），比最佳传统基线绝对提升12–15%。层行为分析表明，保留声学/语音细节的底层比专攻ASR的顶层更有效。
AI.summary: voice2mode通过自监督语音模型HuBERT与wav2vec2提取早期层嵌入，结合SVM实现演唱发声四分类，在女高音持续元音数据集上达95.7%准确率，比传统谱特征提升12–15%，证明语音基础模型可迁移至演唱任务且底层特征更优。
AI.keywords: 自监督语音模型,演唱发声模式,HuBERT,wav2vec2,特征迁移
AI.comments: 未提及跨歌手泛化、实时性能或更低资源场景；亦未讨论错误样本特点及与其他演唱风格/音域的适配性。

title: MamaDino: A Hybrid Vision Model for Breast Cancer 3-Year Risk Prediction
summary:
Breast cancer screening programmes increasingly seek to move from one-size-fits-all interval to risk-adapted and personalized strategies. Deep learning (DL) has enabled image-based risk models with stronger 1- to 5-year prediction than traditional clinical models, but leading systems (e.g., Mirai) typically use convolutional backbones, very high-resolution inputs (>1M pixels) and simple multi-view fusion, with limited explicit modelling of contralateral asymmetry.
  We hypothesised that combining complementary inductive biases (convolutional and transformer-based) with explicit contralateral asymmetry modelling would allow us to match state-of-the-art 3-year risk prediction performance even when operating on substantially lower-resolution mammograms, indicating that using less detailed images in a more structured way can recover state-of-the-art accuracy.
  We present MamaDino, a mammography-aware multi-view attentional DINO model. MamaDino fuses frozen self-supervised DINOv3 ViT-S features with a trainable CNN encoder at 512x512 resolution, and aggregates bilateral breast information via a BilateralMixer to output a 3-year breast cancer risk score. We train on 53,883 women from OPTIMAM (UK) and evaluate on matched 3-year case-control cohorts: an in-distribution test set from four screening sites and an external out-of-distribution cohort from an unseen site.
  At breast-level, MamaDino matches Mirai on both internal and external tests while using ~13x fewer input pixels. Adding the BilateralMixer improves discrimination to AUC 0.736 (vs 0.713) in-distribution and 0.677 (vs 0.666) out-of-distribution, with consistent performance across age, ethnicity, scanner, tumour type and grade. These findings demonstrate that explicit contralateral modelling and complementary inductive biases enable predictions that match Mirai, despite operating on substantially lower-resolution mammograms.

AI.title_translation: MamaDino：一种用于乳腺癌3年风险预测的混合视觉模型
AI.tldr: MamaDino 通过融合自监督 ViT 与 CNN、显式建模对侧不对称，在仅 512×512 分辨率下达到与 Mirai 相当的3年风险预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法依赖高分辨率卷积网络且对侧不对称建模不足，作者希望用更低分辨率图像通过混合架构与显式对侧建模实现同等预测精度。
AI.method: 提出 MamaDino：冻结 DINOv3 ViT-S 与可训练 CNN 并行提取 512×512 图像特征，通过 BilateralMixer 聚合双侧信息输出3年风险评分；训练集 53,883 例英国 OPTIMAM 女性，内外部病例-对照队列验证。
AI.result: 在乳腺级预测上，MamaDino 内外部 AUC 分别达 0.736 与 0.677，与 Mirai 相当，而输入像素减少约13倍；BilateralMixer 将 AUC 从 0.713 提至 0.736（内部），0.666 提至 0.677（外部），性能在各亚组稳定。
AI.conclusion: 显式对侧不对称建模与卷积-Transformer互补偏置可在显著降低图像分辨率的同时保持顶尖预测精度，支持更高效的个性化筛查。
AI.translation: MamaDino：一种用于乳腺癌3年风险预测的混合视觉模型
AI.summary: MamaDino 结合自监督 ViT 与 CNN 并在 512×512 低分辨率下显式建模双侧不对称，实现与 Mirai 同水平的3年乳腺癌风险预测，为低资源个性化筛查提供新思路。
AI.keywords: 乳腺癌；3年风险预测；深度学习；MamaDino；混合视觉模型；对侧不对称；DINO；Transformer；CNN；个性化筛查
AI.comments: 研究证实低分辨率+结构建模可替代高分辨率方案，利于存储与计算受限环境；未来可探索纵向多时间点数据及更大规模外部验证。

title: Joint Task Assistance Planning via Nested Branch and Bound (Extended Version)
summary: We introduce and study the Joint Task Assistance Planning problem which generalizes prior work on optimizing assistance in robotic collaboration. In this setting, two robots operate over predefined roadmaps, each represented as a graph corresponding to its configuration space. One robot, the task robot, must execute a timed mission, while the other, the assistance robot, provides sensor-based support that depends on their spatial relationship. The objective is to compute a path for both robots that maximizes the total duration of assistance given. Solving this problem is challenging due to the combinatorial explosion of possible path combinations together with the temporal nature of the problem (time needs to be accounted for as well). To address this, we propose a nested branch-and-bound framework that efficiently explores the space of robot paths in a hierarchical manner. We empirically evaluate our algorithm and demonstrate a speedup of up to two orders of magnitude when compared to a baseline approach.

AI.title_translation: 基于嵌套分支定界的联合任务辅助规划（扩展版）
AI.tldr: 提出“联合任务辅助规划”问题，用嵌套分支定界算法为两机器人同步规划路径，使辅助时长最大化，实验速度提升百倍。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人协作优化研究未同时考虑路径组合爆炸与时间约束，需新方法在复杂时空空间内高效计算最优辅助策略。
AI.method: 将两机器人路径空间分层，设计嵌套分支定界框架，上层枚举任务机器人路径，下层为辅助机器人路径计算紧致上界并剪枝，加速搜索。
AI.result: 算法在测试场景中比基线方法快达两个数量级，能在合理时间内找到使辅助时长最大化的双机器人路径。
AI.conclusion: 嵌套分支定界可有效解决联合任务辅助规划的组合与时间耦合难题，为实时机器人协作提供可行规划工具。
AI.translation: 我们提出并研究“联合任务辅助规划”问题，该问题在机器人协作优化中推广了先前工作。在此设定中，两台机器人在预设路线图（表示为配置空间图）上运行：任务机器人需执行带时间约束的任务，辅助机器人则依据二者空间关系提供基于传感器的支持。目标是为两机器人计算路径，使辅助总时长最大化。由于路径组合爆炸与问题的时间特性，求解极具挑战。为此，我们提出嵌套分支定界框架，以分层方式高效探索机器人路径空间。实验表明，与基线方法相比，算法速度提升最高达百倍。
AI.summary: 本文定义联合任务辅助规划问题，旨在为任务机器人与辅助机器人在图状配置空间中同步规划路径，使辅助时长最大化。针对路径与时间耦合带来的组合爆炸，提出嵌套分支定界算法，分层搜索并剪枝，实验显示速度提升两个数量级。
AI.keywords: 机器人协作；路径规划；分支定界；辅助优化；时空约束
AI.comments: 摘要未披露问题规模、剪枝策略细节及是否保证最优解，实际应用需验证更大场景与动态障碍适应性。

title: HyMem: Hybrid Memory Architecture with Dynamic Retrieval Scheduling
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in short-text contexts but often underperform in extended dialogues due to inefficient memory management. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness: memory compression risks losing critical details required for complex reasoning, while retaining raw text introduces unnecessary computational overhead for simple queries. The crux lies in the limitations of monolithic memory representations and static retrieval mechanisms, which fail to emulate the flexible and proactive memory scheduling capabilities observed in humans, thus struggling to adapt to diverse problem scenarios. Inspired by the principle of cognitive economy, we propose HyMem, a hybrid memory architecture that enables dynamic on-demand scheduling through multi-granular memory representations. HyMem adopts a dual-granular storage scheme paired with a dynamic two-tier retrieval system: a lightweight module constructs summary-level context for efficient response generation, while an LLM-based deep module is selectively activated only for complex queries, augmented by a reflection mechanism for iterative reasoning refinement. Experiments show that HyMem achieves strong performance on both the LOCOMO and LongMemEval benchmarks, outperforming full-context while reducing computational cost by 92.6\%, establishing a state-of-the-art balance between efficiency and performance in long-term memory management.

AI.title_translation: HyMem：采用动态检索调度的混合内存架构
AI.tldr: HyMem是一种混合内存架构，通过多粒度内存表示和动态调度机制优化大型语言模型（LLM）在长对话中的记忆管理。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在长对话中表现不佳，主要源于记忆管理效率与效果之间的权衡：压缩记忆可能丢失关键细节，而保留原始文本会带来不必要的计算开销。根本原因在于单一记忆表示和静态检索机制无法适应多样化问题场景。
AI.method: HyMem采用混合内存架构，基于多粒度内存表示实现动态按需调度。具体包括双粒度存储方案和动态双层检索系统：轻量级模块构建摘要级上下文以实现高效响应生成，LLM驱动的深度模块仅针对复杂查询选择性激活，并辅以反思机制进行迭代推理优化。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO和LongMemEval基准测试中，HyMem表现优异，性能超越全上下文方法，同时计算成本降低92.6%。
AI.conclusion: HyMem通过动态检索调度和混合内存架构，在长期记忆管理中实现了效率与性能之间的最先进平衡。
AI.translation: 基于认知经济原则，本研究提出HyMem，一种能够通过多粒度记忆表示实现动态按需调度的混合内存架构。
AI.summary: 针对LLM代理在长对话中记忆管理效率低下的问题，HyMem设计了双粒度存储和动态双层检索系统，实现了摘要级高效处理和复杂查询的深度推理结合，显著提升性能并大幅降低计算成本。
AI.keywords: HyMem, 混合内存架构, 动态检索调度, 多粒度记忆表示, 长期记忆管理, LLM代理, 认知经济
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地借鉴人类记忆的灵活性，提出动态调度方案，为解决记忆效率与效果权衡提供了新思路。

title: Why Code, Why Now: Learnability, Computability, and the Real Limits of Machine Learning
summary: Code generation has progressed more reliably than reinforcement learning, largely because code has an information structure that makes it learnable. Code provides dense, local, verifiable feedback at every token, whereas most reinforcement learning problems do not. This difference in feedback quality is not binary but graded. We propose a five-level hierarchy of learnability based on information structure and argue that the ceiling on ML progress depends less on model size than on whether a task is learnable at all. The hierarchy rests on a formal distinction among three properties of computational problems (expressibility, computability, and learnability). We establish their pairwise relationships, including where implications hold and where they fail, and present a unified template that makes the structural differences explicit. The analysis suggests why supervised learning on code scales predictably while reinforcement learning does not, and why the common assumption that scaling alone will solve remaining ML challenges warrants scrutiny.

AI.title_translation: 为何是代码，为何是现在：可学习性、可计算性与机器学习的真实极限
AI.tldr: 文章提出五层可学习性层级，指出代码生成优于强化学习的关键在于信息结构提供的可验证反馈，并论证机器学习天花板取决于任务本身是否可学习，而非单纯扩大模型。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到代码生成进展远快于强化学习，推测其根本原因在于代码具备密集、局部且可验证的反馈结构，而多数强化学习任务缺乏这种信息结构，因此想系统界定任务可学习性并解释为何模型规模并非万能。
AI.method: 将计算问题划分为可表达性、可计算性与可学习性三性质，建立其两两关系及反例，据此构建基于信息结构的五层可学习性层级，并统一模板化展示结构差异，用理论框架解释不同任务的学习上限。
AI.result: 代码因逐词可验证的反馈属于高可学习性，而多数强化学习任务反馈稀疏，可学习性低；层级显示机器学习进展的上限受限于任务本身是否可学习，而非单纯依赖模型规模扩大；证明可表达、可计算与可学习三者并不互相蕴含。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习的天花板更多取决于任务的可学习性而非模型规模；代码生成的可预测扩展性源于其优越的信息反馈结构；对“靠扩大模型解决剩余挑战”的常见假设应保持审慎。
AI.translation: 代码生成之所以比强化学习进展更可靠，是因为代码具备使其可学习的信息结构：每个词元都能提供密集、局部且可验证的反馈，而大多数强化学习问题没有这种反馈。该反馈质量差异并非二元，而是分级的。我们基于信息结构提出五层可学习性层级，指出ML进展的上限更多取决于任务是否可学习，而非模型大小。该层级建立在计算问题的三性质（可表达性、可计算性、可学习性）的形式区分上。我们确立它们的两两关系，指出蕴含成立与失效之处，并提供统一模板显式展示结构差异。分析解释了为何代码上的监督学习可预测地扩展而强化学习不能，也提示单靠规模解决ML剩余挑战的假设需被审视。
AI.summary: 本文从信息结构视角解释为何代码生成模型效果提升稳定，而强化学习却难以同步跃进。作者提出可表达性、可计算性与可学习性三性质，并构建五层可学习性层级，指出任务本身的可学习性而非模型规模才是机器学习的天花板。代码因逐词可验证反馈处于高可学习层级，强化学习因反馈稀疏处于低层级。研究提醒业界重新评估“模型越大越好”的假设，并关注任务结构与反馈质量。
AI.keywords: 可学习性,代码生成,强化学习,信息结构,可计算性,机器学习极限,反馈质量
AI.comments: 摘要未提供

title: Statistical Early Stopping for Reasoning Models
summary: While LLMs have seen substantial improvement in reasoning capabilities, they also sometimes overthink, generating unnecessary reasoning steps, particularly under uncertainty, given ill-posed or ambiguous queries. We introduce statistically principled early stopping methods that monitor uncertainty signals during generation to mitigate this issue. Our first approach is parametric: it models inter-arrival times of uncertainty keywords as a renewal process and applies sequential testing for stopping. Our second approach is nonparametric and provides finite-sample guarantees on the probability of halting too early on well-posed queries. We conduct empirical evaluations on reasoning tasks across several domains and models. Our results indicate that uncertainty-aware early stopping can improve both efficiency and reliability in LLM reasoning, and we observe especially significant gains for math reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 面向推理模型的统计早期停止机制
AI.tldr: 提出两种基于不确定性感知的统计早期停止方法，减少大模型在推理时的冗余步骤，提升效率与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大模型在不确定或模糊查询下易“过度思考”，生成不必要推理步骤，需在不损害正确性的前提下提前终止。
AI.method: 1) 参数法：将不确定性关键词出现间隔建模为更新过程，用序贯检验决定停止；2) 非参数法：提供有限样本保证，控制对合理查询的过早停止概率。
AI.result: 在多领域、多模型推理任务上评估，不确定性感知早期停止显著提升效率与可靠性，数学推理增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于不确定性的统计早期停止可在保持正确性的同时减少冗余推理，为LLM推理提供高效、可信的终止机制。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型推理能力显著提升，但在不确定、模糊或表述不佳的查询下，它们常过度思考，产生不必要的推理步骤。我们引入基于统计原则的早期停止方法，在生成过程中监控不确定信号以缓解此问题。第一种为参数方法：将不确定性关键词的到达间隔建模为更新过程，并采用序贯检验决定停止。第二种为非参数方法，对良构查询提供有限样本保证，控制过早停止概率。我们在多领域、多模型的推理任务上进行实证评估，结果表明不确定性感知早期停止可提升LLM推理的效率与可靠性，数学推理收益尤为显著。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型过度推理问题，提出参数与非参数两种统计早期停止策略，实时监控不确定信号，实现效率与正确性的平衡，并在数学推理上取得显著改进。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；推理；过度思考；早期停止；不确定性；更新过程；序贯检验；非参数方法
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体模型、数据集、代码是否开源及未来工作细节。

title: A Generalizable Physics-guided Causal Model for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted by IEEE ICRA 2026
summary: Trajectory prediction for traffic agents is critical for safe autonomous driving. However, achieving effective zero-shot generalization in previously unseen domains remains a significant challenge. Motivated by the consistent nature of kinematics across diverse domains, we aim to incorporate domain-invariant knowledge to enhance zero-shot trajectory prediction capabilities. The key challenges include: 1) effectively extracting domain-invariant scene representations, and 2) integrating invariant features with kinematic models to enable generalized predictions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel generalizable Physics-guided Causal Model (PCM), which comprises two core components: a Disentangled Scene Encoder, which adopts intervention-based disentanglement to extract domain-invariant features from scenes, and a CausalODE Decoder, which employs a causal attention mechanism to effectively integrate kinematic models with meaningful contextual information. Extensive experiments on real-world autonomous driving datasets demonstrate our method's superior zero-shot generalization performance in unseen cities, significantly outperforming competitive baselines. The source code is released at https://github.com/ZY-Zong/Physics-guided-Causal-Model.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted by IEEE ICRA 2026

AI.title_translation: 面向自动驾驶轨迹预测的通用物理引导因果模型
AI.tldr: 提出PCM框架，通过解耦场景编码与因果ODE解码，将物理运动学先验注入轨迹预测，实现跨城市零样本泛化性能领先。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测模型在未见域零样本泛化困难，而运动学规律跨域恒定，亟需提取域不变表征并融合物理先验以提升泛化能力。
AI.method: PCM包含：1)解耦场景编码器，用干预式解耦提取域不变特征；2)因果ODE解码器，以因果注意力融合运动学模型与上下文，实现物理引导预测。
AI.result: 在真实自动驾驶数据集上，PCM在未见城市零样本场景显著优于强基线，验证其优越泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将物理运动学知识与因果解耦表征结合，可有效提升轨迹预测模型的域外泛化性能。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶中交通代理的轨迹预测对安全至关重要。然而，在先前未见域实现有效零样本泛化仍是重大挑战。受运动学在多域中一致性的启发，我们旨在引入域不变知识以增强零样本轨迹预测能力。关键挑战包括：1）有效提取域不变场景表征；2）将不变特征与运动学模型集成以实现泛化预测。为此，我们提出新颖的通用物理引导因果模型（PCM），包含两个核心组件：采用干预式解耦提取域不变特征的解耦场景编码器，以及利用因果注意力机制将运动学模型与有意义上下文有效整合的CausalODE解码器。在真实自动驾驶数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在未见城市中具有卓越的零样本泛化性能，显著优于竞争性基线。源代码已发布于https://github.com/ZY-Zong/Physics-guided-Causal-Model。
AI.summary: 本文提出PCM框架，通过解耦场景编码与因果ODE解码，将物理运动学先验注入轨迹预测，实现跨城市零样本泛化性能领先。实验表明，PCM在多个真实自动驾驶数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 轨迹预测；零样本泛化；物理引导；因果模型；解耦表征；运动学先验；自动驾驶
AI.comments: 论文亮点在于将物理运动学约束与因果推断结合，解决域迁移问题；代码已开源，便于复现与后续研究。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Code-Guided, Modular, and Verifiable Automated Machine Learning
summary: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has revolutionized the development of data-driven solutions; however, traditional frameworks often function as "black boxes", lacking the flexibility and transparency required for complex, real-world engineering tasks. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have shifted toward code-driven approaches. However, they frequently suffer from hallucinated logic and logic entanglement, where monolithic code generation leads to unrecoverable runtime failures. In this paper, we present iML, a novel multi-agent framework designed to shift AutoML from black-box prompting to a code-guided, modular, and verifiable architectural paradigm. iML introduces three main ideas: (1) Code-Guided Planning, which synthesizes a strategic blueprint grounded in autonomous empirical profiling to eliminate hallucination; (2) Code-Modular Implementation, which decouples preprocessing and modeling into specialized components governed by strict interface contracts; and (3) Code-Verifiable Integration, which enforces physical feasibility through dynamic contract verification and iterative self-correction. We evaluate iML across MLE-BENCH and the newly introduced iML-BENCH, comprising a diverse range of real-world Kaggle competitions. The experimental results show iML's superiority over state-of-the-art agents, achieving a valid submission rate of 85% and a competitive medal rate of 45% on MLE-BENCH, with an average standardized performance score (APS) of 0.77. On iML-BENCH, iML significantly outperforms the other approaches by 38%-163% in APS. Furthermore, iML maintains a robust 70% success rate even under stripped task descriptions, effectively filling information gaps through empirical profiling. These results highlight iML's potential to bridge the gap between stochastic generation and reliable engineering, marking a meaningful step toward truly AutoML.

AI.title_translation: 面向代码引导、模块化与可验证自动机器学习的多智能体框架
AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架iML，通过代码引导规划、模块化实现与可验证集成，解决AutoML黑盒与幻觉问题，在MLE-BENCH与自建iML-BENCH上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统AutoML黑箱特性无法满足复杂工程任务对灵活性与透明性的需求；现有LLM智能体存在幻觉逻辑与逻辑纠缠，导致运行时不可恢复失败。
AI.method: iML框架包含三大核心：1) 代码引导规划，用自主实证画像消除幻觉；2) 代码模块化实现，将预处理与建模解耦为受严格接口契约约束的专用组件；3) 代码可验证集成，通过动态契约验证与迭代自校正确保物理可行性。
AI.result: 在MLE-BENCH上实现85%有效提交率与45%奖牌率，平均标准化性能得分0.77；在iML-BENCH上比其他方法APS提升38%-163%；即使任务描述被剥离，成功率仍保持70%。
AI.conclusion: iML显著缩小随机生成与可靠工程之间的差距，是迈向真正AutoML的重要一步。
AI.translation: 无（已提供中文翻译）
AI.summary: iML通过多智能体协同，把AutoML从黑盒提示转向代码引导、模块化且可验证的架构，提升透明度与鲁棒性，在多项真实竞赛基准上取得领先性能。
AI.keywords: 自动机器学习，多智能体系统，大语言模型，代码生成，模块化设计，可验证集成，实证画像
