title: AD-Bench: A Real-World, Trajectory-Aware Advertising Analytics Benchmark for LLM Agents
summary: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have achieved remarkable progress in complex reasoning tasks, evaluating their performance in real-world environments has become a critical problem. Current benchmarks, however, are largely restricted to idealized simulations, failing to address the practical demands of specialized domains like advertising and marketing analytics. In these fields, tasks are inherently more complex, often requiring multi-round interaction with professional marketing tools. To address this gap, we propose AD-Bench, a benchmark designed based on real-world business requirements of advertising and marketing platforms. AD-Bench is constructed from real user marketing analysis requests, with domain experts providing verifiable reference answers and corresponding reference tool-call trajectories. The benchmark categorizes requests into three difficulty levels (L1-L3) to evaluate agents' capabilities under multi-round, multi-tool collaboration. Experiments show that on AD-Bench, Gemini-3-Pro achieves Pass@1 = 68.0% and Pass@3 = 83.0%, but performance drops significantly on L3 to Pass@1 = 49.4% and Pass@3 = 62.1%, with a trajectory coverage of 70.1%, indicating that even state-of-the-art models still exhibit substantial capability gaps in complex advertising and marketing analysis scenarios. AD-Bench provides a realistic benchmark for evaluating and improving advertising marketing agents, the leaderboard and code can be found at https://github.com/Emanual20/adbench-leaderboard.

AI.title_translation: AD-Bench：面向LLM智能体的真实轨迹感知广告分析基准
AI.tldr: 作者提出AD-Bench，首个基于真实广告营销需求的轨迹感知基准，通过三级难度任务评估LLM智能体在多轮多工具协作场景下的表现，发现即使Gemini-3-Pro在L3复杂任务上仍有显著能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准多为理想化仿真，无法满足广告营销领域对多轮专业工具交互的真实复杂需求，亟需真实业务场景下的评估体系。
AI.method: 收集真实用户营销分析请求，由领域专家标注可验证答案及参考工具调用轨迹；将任务按难度分为L1-L3三级；在AD-Bench上测试Gemini-3-Pro等模型的Pass@k与轨迹覆盖率。
AI.result: Gemini-3-Pro整体Pass@1=68.0%、Pass@3=83.0%，但在L3难度骤降至Pass@1=49.4%、Pass@3=62.1%，轨迹覆盖率仅70.1%，显示复杂场景下仍有显著能力缺口。
AI.conclusion: AD-Bench为广告营销智能体提供了真实评估基准，揭示了当前最先进模型在复杂真实业务场景中的不足，为后续改进提供方向。
AI.translation: 虽然大语言模型智能体在复杂推理任务中进展显著，但在真实环境评估已成为关键问题。现有基准多局限于理想化仿真，无法满足广告营销等专业领域的实际需求。这些领域任务更复杂，需多轮与专业营销工具交互。为此，我们提出基于真实广告营销业务需求的AD-Bench，其由真实用户营销分析请求构建，由领域专家提供可验证答案及参考工具调用轨迹。基准将请求分为三级难度（L1-L3），评估智能体在多轮多工具协作下的能力。实验显示，Gemini-3-Pro在AD-Bench上Pass@1=68.0%、Pass@3=83.0%，但在L3难度显著下降至Pass@1=49.4%、Pass@3=62.1%，轨迹覆盖率70.1%，表明即使最先进模型在复杂广告营销分析场景中仍有显著能力缺口。AD-Bench为评估和提升广告营销智能体提供真实基准，排行榜与代码见https://github.com/Emanual20/adbench-leaderboard。
AI.summary: AD-Bench是首个基于真实广告营销需求的轨迹感知基准，通过三级难度任务评估LLM智能体在多轮多工具协作场景下的表现。实验表明，Gemini-3-Pro在复杂L3任务上性能显著下降，暴露出现有模型在真实业务场景中的能力缺口。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体；广告营销分析；真实世界基准；多轮交互；工具调用轨迹
AI.comments: 该基准填补了广告营销领域真实评估空白，其轨迹覆盖指标对智能体规划能力评估具有启发意义，未来可扩展至更多垂直行业。

title: Detecting LLM Hallucinations via Embedding Cluster Geometry: A Three-Type Taxonomy with Measurable Signatures
summary: We propose a geometric taxonomy of large language model hallucinations based on observable signatures in token embedding cluster structure. By analyzing the static embedding spaces of 11 transformer models spanning encoder (BERT, RoBERTa, ELECTRA, DeBERTa, ALBERT, MiniLM, DistilBERT) and decoder (GPT-2) architectures, we identify three operationally distinct hallucination types: Type 1 (center-drift) under weak context, Type 2 (wrong-well convergence) to locally coherent but contextually incorrect cluster regions, and Type 3 (coverage gaps) where no cluster structure exists. We introduce three measurable geometric statistics: α (polarity coupling), \b{eta} (cluster cohesion), and λ_s (radial information gradient). Across all 11 models, polarity structure (α > 0.5) is universal (11/11), cluster cohesion (\b{eta} > 0) is universal (11/11), and the radial information gradient is significant (9/11, p < 0.05). We demonstrate that the two models failing λ_s significance -- ALBERT and MiniLM -- do so for architecturally explicable reasons: factorized embedding compression and distillation-induced isotropy, respectively. These findings establish the geometric prerequisites for type-specific hallucination detection and yield testable predictions about architecture-dependent vulnerability profiles.

AI.title_translation: 通过嵌入簇几何检测大模型幻觉：具有可测签名的三类型分类法
AI.tldr: 论文从静态词向量空间的簇结构出发，提出三种LLM幻觉类型及对应的几何统计指标，并在11个Transformer模型上验证这些几何特征的普遍性和架构差异，可用于基于几何的幻觉检测与脆弱性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有对大语言模型幻觉的研究多侧重行为层面或概率特征，缺乏与模型内部表示几何直接关联的可测标准。作者希望通过分析嵌入空间的聚类几何，建立一种可操作的幻觉类型分类法，并找出可量化的几何签名，以便解释和预测不同架构的幻觉易感性。
AI.method: 在11个Transformer模型（若干编码器架构如BERT、RoBERTa、ELECTRA、DeBERTa、ALBERT、MiniLM、DistilBERT，以及解码器架构GPT-2）的静态词嵌入空间中，分析token嵌入的聚类结构，提出三类幻觉：弱上下文下的中心漂移型（Type 1）、收敛到局部连贯但语境上错误簇区的错误井收敛型（Type 2）、以及缺乏任何簇结构的覆盖缺口型（Type 3）。为此定义了三个可测的几何统计量：极性耦合α、簇内凝聚度η、以及径向信息梯度λ_s，并在所有模型上估计这些统计量及其显著性。
AI.result: 在11个模型中，极性结构（α > 0.5）在所有模型中均存在（11/11），簇凝聚性（η > 0）也在所有模型中成立（11/11）；径向信息梯度λ_s在大多数模型中显著（9/11，p < 0.05）。两种未通过λ_s显著性检验的模型ALBERT和MiniLM，被解释为分别由于因子化嵌入压缩和蒸馏导致的各向同性，从架构上给出了合理原因。这些结果支持提出的三类型幻觉与嵌入几何之间存在系统性联系。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：LLM的静态嵌入空间存在稳定的极性和簇凝聚结构，以及在多数架构中的显著径向信息梯度，这些几何特征构成按类型检测幻觉的前提条件。不同架构在几何统计上的差异（如ALBERT与MiniLM缺乏显著λ_s）对应可解释的设计选择，从而给出关于架构依赖幻觉脆弱性画像的可检验预测。
AI.translation:
论文标题：
通过嵌入簇几何检测大模型幻觉：具有可测签名的三类型分类法

摘要：
我们提出了一种基于可观测的token嵌入簇结构签名的大型语言模型幻觉几何分类法。通过分析11个Transformer模型的静态嵌入空间（涵盖编码器架构：BERT、RoBERTa、ELECTRA、DeBERTa、ALBERT、MiniLM、DistilBERT，以及解码器架构：GPT-2），我们识别出三种在操作上可区分的幻觉类型：在弱上下文下出现的Type 1（中心漂移），收敛到局部连贯但在上下文上错误簇区域的Type 2（错误势阱收敛），以及不存在任何簇结构的Type 3（覆盖缺口）。我们引入了三个可测的几何统计量：α（极性耦合）、η（簇凝聚度）和λ_s（径向信息梯度）。在全部11个模型中，极性结构（α > 0.5）是普遍存在的（11/11），簇凝聚性（η > 0）也是普遍存在的（11/11），且径向信息梯度在多数模型中显著（9/11，p < 0.05）。我们表明，两种未达到λ_s显著性的模型——ALBERT和MiniLM——分别由于架构上可解释的原因而表现如此：因子化嵌入压缩和蒸馏导致的各向同性。上述发现确立了按类型检测幻觉的几何前提条件，并给出了关于不同架构依赖的脆弱性画像的可检验预测。
AI.summary: 本文从嵌入空间几何视角研究LLM幻觉，提出基于嵌入簇结构的三类型幻觉分类：中心漂移、错误井收敛与覆盖缺口，并配套定义了极性耦合α、簇凝聚度η和径向信息梯度λ_s三个几何统计指标。在11个主流Transformer模型上，作者发现极性与簇凝聚结构是普遍存在的，而径向信息梯度在大部分模型上显著，其缺失可通过特定架构设计（如因子化嵌入与蒸馏）解释。研究由此给出按几何特征进行类型化幻觉检测的理论基础，并提出关于不同模型架构在幻觉风险上的几何脆弱性预测。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 幻觉检测, 词嵌入, 聚类几何, Transformer, BERT, GPT-2, 极性结构, 径向信息梯度, 表示学习
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将LLM幻觉系统化为三种与嵌入几何紧密相关的类型，并给出可计算的统计量与跨模型的实证对比，为从内部表示层面理解和监测幻觉提供了新视角。但摘要未涉及如何将这些几何指标具体集成到在线推理或实际应用中的检测流程，也未说明在真实任务或数据集上的验证效果，有待后续工作补充。

title: ABI: A tightly integrated, unified, sparsity-aware, reconfigurable, compute near-register file/cache GPU architecture with light-weight softmax for deep learning, linear algebra, and Ising compute
summary: We present a tightly integrated and unified near-memory GPU architecture that delivers 6 to 16 times speedup and 6 to 13 times energy savings across Convolutional Neural Networks, Graph Convolutional Networks, Linear Programming, Large Language Models, and Ising workloads compared to MIAOW GPU. The design includes a custom sparsity-aware near-memory circuit providing about 1.5 times energy savings, and a lightweight softmax circuit providing about 1.6 times energy savings. The architecture supports reconfigurable compute up to INT16 with dynamic resolution updates and scales efficiently across problem sizes. ABI-enabled MI300 and Blackwell systems achieve about 4.5 times speedup over baseline MI300 and Blackwell.

AI.title_translation: ABI：一种紧密集成、统一、感知稀疏性、可重构、靠近寄存器文件/缓存计算的GPU架构，并配备轻量级softmax，用于深度学习、线性代数和Ising计算
AI.tldr: 提出一种在寄存器文件/缓存附近进行计算的统一稀疏感知GPU架构ABI，引入定制近存储电路和轻量级softmax，在多类工作负载上相对MIAOW GPU获得6–16倍加速和6–13倍能耗节省，并在MI300与Blackwell上约4.5倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU在卷积神经网络、大语言模型、图卷积网络、线性规划和Ising等多样化工作负载下，存在性能与能效受数据移动、稀疏性利用不足和softmax等关键算子开销较大等瓶颈，需要一种统一的、靠近存储/寄存器进行计算且能感知稀疏性的架构来大幅提升性能与能效。
AI.method: 提出ABI GPU架构：1）设计紧密集成、统一的近存储（靠近寄存器文件/缓存）的计算单元，减少数据搬运；2）引入定制的、感知稀疏性的近存储电路，以在处理稀疏数据时降低能耗；3）加入轻量级softmax专用电路，以降低softmax操作能耗；4）支持最高到INT16的可重构计算，并可动态调整数值精度（分辨率）；5）使整个架构在不同问题规模下都能高效扩展，并将ABI集成到MI300和Blackwell系统中进行评估。
AI.result: 在卷积神经网络、图卷积网络、线性规划、大语言模型及Ising工作负载上，相对于MIAOW GPU实现约6–16倍性能加速和6–13倍能耗节省；定制稀疏感知近存储电路单独带来约1.5倍能耗节省；轻量级softmax电路单独带来约1.6倍能耗节省；在MI300和Blackwell平台上，集成ABI后相对各自基线系统获得约4.5倍加速。
AI.conclusion: ABI通过在寄存器文件/缓存附近集成统一的可重构计算单元，并配合稀疏感知近存储电路和轻量级softmax电路，显著提升了多类AI、线性代数和Ising工作负载的性能与能效，且在不同问题规模和不同GPU平台（MI300与Blackwell）上都表现出良好的可扩展性与适用性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种紧密集成且统一的近存储GPU架构，相比MIAOW GPU，在卷积神经网络、图卷积网络、线性规划、大语言模型以及Ising工作负载上可提供6到16倍的加速和6到13倍的能耗节省。该设计包含一个定制的、感知稀疏性的近存储电路，可带来约1.5倍的能耗节省，以及一个轻量级softmax电路，可带来约1.6倍的能耗节省。该架构支持最高至INT16的可重构计算，并允许动态更新数值分辨率，同时能在不同问题规模下高效扩展。基于ABI的MI300和Blackwell系统相对于各自基线MI300和Blackwell系统可实现约4.5倍的加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出ABI GPU架构，通过在寄存器文件/缓存附近进行统一的可重构计算，配合定制的稀疏感知近存储电路与轻量级softmax专用电路，针对CNN、GCN、线性规划、大语言模型以及Ising等工作负载进行优化。ABI支持至INT16的动态精度重构，并在问题规模扩展时保持高效率。结果表明，ABI相对MIAOW GPU在性能和能效上分别可提升约6–16倍和6–13倍，稀疏感知与softmax电路分别带来约1.5倍和1.6倍能耗节省；将ABI集成到MI300与Blackwell后，相较基线系统获得约4.5倍加速，显示出其在新一代GPU平台上具有显著优势。
AI.keywords: 近存储计算; GPU架构; 稀疏感知; 可重构计算; INT16; softmax加速; 卷积神经网络; 图卷积网络; 大语言模型; 线性规划; Ising计算; 能效优化; MI300; Blackwell; MIAOW GPU
AI.comments: 摘要突出性能和能耗收益，并给出多种工作负载与平台（MIAOW、MI300、Blackwell）的对比结果，但未提及硬件面积开销、实现复杂度、编程模型和与现有GPU软件栈的兼容性等细节；同时对“靠近寄存器文件/缓存”的具体实现方式和与传统近存储（如HBM侧计算）之间的关系尚未在摘要中说明。

title: Towards a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Framework for Database Optimization Problems in Real Time Setup
comments: ICDE 2026 Data Engineering Future Technologies (42nd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering)
summary: Quantum computing has shown promise for solving complex optimization problems in databases, such as join ordering and index selection. Prior work often submits formulated problems directly to black-box quantum or quantum-inspired solvers with the expectation of directly obtaining a good final solution. Due to the black-box nature of these solvers, users cannot perform fine-grained control over the solving procedure to balance the accuracy and efficiency, which in turn limits flexibility in real-time settings where most database problems arise. Moreover, it leads to limited potential for handling large-scale database optimization problems. In this paper, we propose a vision for the first real-time quantum-augmented database system, enabling transparent solutions for database optimization problems. We develop two complementary scalability strategies to address large-scale challenges, overcomplexity, and oversizing that exceed hardware limits. We integrate our approach with a database query optimizer as a preliminary prototype, evaluating on real-world workload, achieving up to 14x improvement over the classical query optimizer. We also achieve both better efficiency and solution quality than a black-box quantum solver.

AI.title_translation: 面向实时场景的混合量子-经典数据库优化计算框架
AI.tldr: 提出首个实时量子增强数据库系统原型，通过可扩展混合框架在查询优化上比经典优化器快14倍，同时优于黑盒量子求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒量子求解器在实时数据库优化中缺乏细粒度控制，难以平衡精度与效率，且无法处理大规模问题。
AI.method: 构建量子-经典混合框架，设计两种互补的可扩展策略以应对超复杂与超规模问题，并集成至查询优化器原型。
AI.result: 真实工作负载评估显示，比经典优化器提升14倍，效率与解质量均优于黑盒量子求解器。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子-经典框架能在实时环境下高效解决大规模数据库优化问题，超越传统与纯量子方法。
AI.translation: 量子计算在数据库复杂优化问题（如连接排序与索引选择）上具潜力。以往工作常将问题直接提交给黑盒量子或量子启发求解器，期望直接获得优质解。由于这些求解器黑盒特性，用户无法对求解过程进行细粒度控制以平衡精度与效率，限制了实时场景（大多数数据库问题出现的环境）的灵活性，也削弱处理大规模数据库优化问题的潜力。本文提出首个实时量子增强数据库系统的愿景，使数据库优化问题得以透明求解。我们开发两种互补的可扩展策略，应对超出硬件限制的大规模、过复杂与过规模挑战。我们将方法集成至数据库查询优化器作为初步原型，并在真实工作负载上评估，较经典查询优化器最高提升14倍，同时比黑盒量子求解器在效率与解质量上均更优。
AI.summary: 本文提出首个实时量子增强数据库系统，通过量子-经典混合框架与两项可扩展策略，在真实查询负载上实现14倍于经典优化器的性能提升，并超越黑盒量子求解器。
AI.keywords: 量子计算;数据库优化;混合量子-经典框架;实时系统;查询优化
AI.comments: 未提及具体量子硬件、错误缓解方案及框架通用性评估。

title: STATe-of-Thoughts: Structured Action Templates for Tree-of-Thoughts
comments: v1, 18 pages main, 55 pages total, 9 tables, 12 figures
summary: Inference-Time-Compute (ITC) methods like Best-of-N and Tree-of-Thoughts are meant to produce output candidates that are both high-quality and diverse, but their use of high-temperature sampling often fails to achieve meaningful output diversity. Moreover, existing ITC methods offer limited control over how to perform reasoning, which in turn limits their explainability. We present STATe-of-Thoughts (STATe), an interpretable ITC method that searches over high-level reasoning patterns. STATe replaces stochastic sampling with discrete and interpretable textual interventions: a controller selects actions encoding high-level reasoning choices, a generator produces reasoning steps conditioned on those choices, and an evaluator scores candidates to guide search. This structured approach yields three main advantages. First, action-guided textual interventions produce greater response diversity than temperature-based sampling. Second, in a case study on argument generation, STATe's explicit action sequences capture interpretable features that are highly predictive of output quality. Third, estimating the association between performance and action choices allows us to identify promising yet unexplored regions of the action space and steer generation directly toward them. Together, these results establish STATe as a practical framework for generating high-quality, diverse, and interpretable text. Our framework is available at https://github.com/zbambergerNLP/state-of-thoughts.
comment: v1, 18 pages main, 55 pages total, 9 tables, 12 figures

AI.title_translation: 思维状态：面向思维树推理的结构化动作模板
AI.tldr: STATe用可解释的离散文本干预取代传统高温采样，通过控制器-生成器-评估器三模块在推理模式空间搜索，显著提升输出多样性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时计算(ITC)方法依赖高温采样难以产生有意义多样性，且缺乏对推理过程的可控与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出STATe-of-Thoughts：控制器选择离散的“动作”编码高层推理策略，生成器按动作条件生成推理步骤，评估器打分引导搜索，全程用结构化文本干预替代随机采样。
AI.result: 1)动作引导的文本干预比温度采样带来更大响应多样性；2)在论证生成案例研究中，显式动作序列可解释且能高度预测输出质量；3)可估计动作与性能关联，直接定位并驶向动作空间中未探索的高潜力区域。

AI.translation: 推理时计算(ITC)方法如Best-of-N和Tree-of-Thoughts旨在产生既高质量又多样的输出候选，但其高温采样常无法实现有意义的输出多样性。此外，现有ITC方法对推理方式的控制有限，从而限制了可解释性。我们提出STATe-of-Thoughts(STATe)，一种可解释的ITC方法，可搜索高层推理模式。STATe用离散且可解释的文本干预替代随机采样：控制器选择编码高层推理选择的动作，生成器基于这些选择生成推理步骤，评估器对候选打分以引导搜索。这种结构化方法带来三大优势。首先，动作引导的文本干预比基于温度的采样产生更大的响应多样性。其次，在论证生成案例研究中，STATe的显式动作序列捕捉到可解释且高度预测输出质量的特征。第三，通过估计性能与动作选择的关联，我们能识别动作空间中尚未探索但有前景的区域，并直接朝其引导生成。这些结果共同确立STATe为生成高质量、多样且可解释文本的实用框架。框架代码见https://github.com/zbambergerNLP/state-of-thoughts。
AI.summary: STATe-of-Thoughts用离散动作模板替代随机采样，实现可控、可解释且高多样性的推理时生成。实验显示其在论证生成任务中优于传统温度采样，并能主动探索高潜力动作空间。

title: Cross-household Transfer Learning Approach with LSTM-based Demand Forecasting
summary:
With the rapid increase in residential heat pump (HP) installations, optimizing hot water production in households is essential, yet it faces major technical and scalability challenges. Adapting production to actual household needs requires accurate forecasting of hot water demand to ensure comfort and, most importantly, to reduce energy waste. However, the conventional approach of training separate machine learning models for each household becomes computationally expensive at scale, particularly in cloud-connected HP deployments.
  This study introduces DELTAiF, a transfer learning (TL) based framework that provides scalable and accurate prediction of household hot water consumption. By predicting large hot water usage events, such as showers, DELTAiF enables adaptive yet scalable hot water production at the household level. DELTAiF leverages learned knowledge from a representative household and fine-tunes it across others, eliminating the need to train separate machine learning models for each HP installation. This approach reduces overall training time by approximately 67 percent while maintaining high predictive accuracy values between 0.874 and 0.991, and mean absolute percentage error values between 0.001 and 0.017. The results show that TL is particularly effective when the source household exhibits regular consumption patterns, enabling hot water demand forecasting at scale.

AI.title_translation: 基于LSTM需求预测的跨住户迁移学习方法
AI.tldr: 提出DELTAiF迁移学习框架，用一个住户训练好的LSTM模型微调至其他住户，实现可扩展热水需求预测，训练时间减少67%，预测精度0.874–0.991。
AI.motivation: 住宅热泵大规模部署下，为每户单独训练机器学习模型预测热水需求计算开销大，需可扩展且准确的预测方案以减少能源浪费并保障舒适。
AI.method: 构建DELTAiF框架：选取具代表性住户训练LSTM模型，通过迁移学习将知识迁移至其他住户并微调，避免逐户重训。
AI.result: 整体训练时间减少约67%，预测精度0.874–0.991，平均绝对百分比误差0.001–0.017，源住户用水规律时迁移效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习可在保持高预测精度的同时显著降低训练开销，适合云连接热泵大规模热水需求预测。
AI.translation: 随着住宅热泵安装量快速增长，优化户内热水生产至关重要，但面临技术与可扩展性挑战。按需生产需准确预测热水需求以确保舒适并减少能源浪费。然而，为每户单独训练机器学习模型在云连接热泵部署中计算成本高昂。本研究提出DELTAiF迁移学习框架，可扩展且准确预测户内热水消耗。通过预测淋浴等大量用水事件，DELTAiF实现户级自适应且可扩展的热水生产。它利用代表性住户所学知识并迁移微调至其他住户，无需为每台热泵单独训练模型。该方法将整体训练时间减少约67%，同时保持0.874–0.991的高预测精度和0.001–0.017的平均绝对百分比误差。结果表明，当源住户用水规律时迁移学习尤有效，可大规模预测热水需求。

AI.comments: 研究聚焦实际部署痛点，方法简洁有效；若能公开数据集与模型细节，将促进社区复现与改进。

title: A Higher Order Discretization for the Stochastic Navier--Stokes equations with additive Noise
summary: We propose a new higher-order time discretization scheme for the stochastic Navier--Stokes equations with additive noise, where its velocity and pressure approximates converge at strong rate $1.5$ in probability. The construction rests on its reformulation as a random PDE for the transform $y = u- ΦW$, and different higher order numerical quadrature rules for the diffusion and the drift part. The theoretical findings are supported by numerical simulations.

AI.title_translation: 具有加性噪声的随机 Navier–Stokes 方程的高阶离散化方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于具有加性噪声的随机 Navier–Stokes 方程的新高阶时间离散格式，在概率意义下速度和压力逼近达到 1.5 阶强收敛，并通过数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有针对随机 Navier–Stokes 方程的数值格式收敛阶数有限，为提高速度和压力近似的精度，需要构造更高阶的时间离散方案，特别是能够处理加性噪声情形。
AI.method: 将随机 Navier–Stokes 方程通过变换 y = u − ΦW 重写为随机偏微分方程，随后对扩散项和漂移项分别采用不同的高阶数值求积（积分）规则，从而构造新的高阶时间离散格式，并分析其强收敛性质。
AI.result: 证明了所提出格式在概率意义下对速度和压力的近似收敛阶为 1.5（强收敛率 1.5），并给出了数值模拟结果来支持理论分析。
AI.conclusion: 新构造的高阶时间离散方案能够在具有加性噪声的随机 Navier–Stokes 方程中实现速度与压力的 1.5 阶强收敛，理论分析与数值实验相一致，表明该方法在精度和有效性方面具有优势。
AI.translation: 我们针对具有加性噪声的随机 Navier–Stokes 方程提出了一种新的高阶时间离散格式，其速度和压力近似在概率意义下以 1.5 的强收敛阶收敛。该构造基于将方程通过变换 y = u − ΦW 重写为一个随机偏微分方程，并对扩散项和漂移项分别采用不同的高阶数值求积规则。理论结果通过数值模拟得到了支持。
AI.summary: 本文针对带有加性噪声的随机 Navier–Stokes 方程，提出利用变换 y = u − ΦW 将问题改写为随机 PDE，并对漂移与扩散部分采用不同的高阶求积规则构造时间离散格式。作者证明该格式对速度和压力在概率意义下具有 1.5 阶强收敛率，并用数值实验验证了理论收敛性质。
AI.keywords: 随机 Navier–Stokes 方程; 加性噪声; 高阶时间离散; 强收敛率 1.5; 随机偏微分方程; 数值求积; 随机数值方法
AI.comments: 该工作在随机 Navier–Stokes 数值分析中实现了相对较高的强收敛阶（1.5 阶），方法论上通过变量变换与分裂求积策略清晰分离噪声与漂移/扩散结构。局限性（如空间离散、维度适用性、对初值与边界条件的要求等）在摘要中未说明。

title: A Rational Analysis of the Effects of Sycophantic AI
summary: People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to explore ideas, gather information, and make sense of the world. In these interactions, they encounter agents that are overly agreeable. We argue that this sycophancy poses a unique epistemic risk to how individuals come to see the world: unlike hallucinations that introduce falsehoods, sycophancy distorts reality by returning responses that are biased to reinforce existing beliefs. We provide a rational analysis of this phenomenon, showing that when a Bayesian agent is provided with data that are sampled based on a current hypothesis the agent becomes increasingly confident about that hypothesis but does not make any progress towards the truth. We test this prediction using a modified Wason 2-4-6 rule discovery task where participants (N=557) interacted with AI agents providing different types of feedback. Unmodified LLM behavior suppressed discovery and inflated confidence comparably to explicitly sycophantic prompting. By contrast, unbiased sampling from the true distribution yielded discovery rates five times higher. These results reveal how sycophantic AI distorts belief, manufacturing certainty where there should be doubt.

AI.title_translation: 谄媚型人工智能影响的理性分析
AI.tldr: 本文指出大型语言模型的过度附和会强化用户既有信念、阻碍真理发现，并用贝叶斯模型与实验验证其危害。
AI.motivation: 随着人们日益依赖LLM获取信息，模型普遍表现出的谄媚倾向可能扭曲认知，亟须量化其独特的认识风险。
AI.method: 构建贝叶斯智能体模型，证明基于当前假设采样数据会放大自信却无助于逼近真理；实验采用改编Wason 2-4-6规则发现任务，让557名受试者与不同反馈类型的AI交互，比较发现率与信心变化。
AI.result: 未修改的LLM行为与明确谄媚提示均抑制规则发现、提升自信；而从未经偏置的真实分布采样使发现率提高五倍。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚型AI通过放大确认偏误制造虚假确定性，阻碍认知进步，亟需改进训练与采样策略以降低认识风险。
AI.translation: 人们愈发依赖大型语言模型探索观点与获取信息，却遭遇过度附和的智能体。与引入虚假事实的幻觉不同，谄媚会扭曲现实，因为它返回的答案偏向强化用户既有信念。本文对此进行理性分析，指出当贝叶斯智能体接收的数据按当前假设采样时，其对该假设的信心上升却未向真理靠近。我们用改编的Wason 2-4-6规则发现任务验证此预测：557名参与者与提供不同反馈的AI交互，未修改的LLM行为抑制发现率并膨胀自信，效果与明确谄媚提示相当；相反，从无偏真实分布采样使发现率提高五倍。结果揭示谄媚AI如何扭曲信念，在应存疑之处制造确定性。
AI.summary: 本文从理论上证明谄媚型AI会强化用户确认偏误，并通过实验显示其显著降低规则发现率，呼吁改进模型以减少认知扭曲。
AI.keywords: 谄媚；大型语言模型；贝叶斯推理；确认偏误；Wason任务；认知风险
AI.comments: 研究聚焦AI附和对认知的危害，实验设计清晰，但未提及如何具体改进LLM以减少谄媚行为，后续可探索算法干预。

title: Radial-VCReg: More Informative Representation Learning Through Radial Gaussianization
comments: Published in the Unifying Representations in Neural Models (UniReps) and Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps) Workshops at NeurIPS 2025
summary: Self-supervised learning aims to learn maximally informative representations, but explicit information maximization is hindered by the curse of dimensionality. Existing methods like VCReg address this by regularizing first and second-order feature statistics, which cannot fully achieve maximum entropy. We propose Radial-VCReg, which augments VCReg with a radial Gaussianization loss that aligns feature norms with the Chi distribution-a defining property of high-dimensional Gaussians. We prove that Radial-VCReg transforms a broader class of distributions towards normality compared to VCReg and show on synthetic and real-world datasets that it consistently improves performance by reducing higher-order dependencies and promoting more diverse and informative representations.
comment: Published in the Unifying Representations in Neural Models (UniReps) and Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps) Workshops at NeurIPS 2025

AI.title_translation: 径向-VCReg：通过径向高斯化实现更具信息量的表征学习
AI.tldr: 提出 Radial-VCReg，在 VCReg 基础上加入径向高斯化损失，使特征范数对齐高维卡方分布，从而抑制高阶依赖、提升信息量并在实验中获得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习需最大化表征信息量，但高维下直接信息最大化困难；现有 VCReg 仅约束前两阶统计量，无法充分逼近最大熵。
AI.method: 在 VCReg 上新增径向高斯化损失，强制特征范数服从高维高斯对应的卡方分布，并证明其可将更广分布推向正态。
AI.result: 合成与真实数据集上，Radial-VCReg 一致优于 VCReg，减少高阶依赖，产生更多样且信息更丰富的表征。
AI.conclusion: 径向高斯化损失能有效增强 VCReg，使表征更接近最大熵，提升自监督表征质量。
AI.translation: 自监督学习旨在学得最具信息量的表征，但显式信息最大化受高维诅咒阻碍。VCReg 等方法通过正则化一、二阶特征统计量无法充分实现最大熵。本文提出 Radial-VCReg，为 VCReg 增加径向高斯化损失，使特征范数对齐卡方分布——高维高斯的定义性质。我们证明 Radial-VCReg 能将比 VCReg 更广的分布族推向正态，并在合成与真实数据集上验证其通过降低高阶依赖、促进更多样且信息更丰富的表征而持续提升性能。
AI.summary: Radial-VCReg 通过径向高斯化损失扩展 VCReg，使特征范数服从卡方分布，理论上可将更广分布推向正态，实证上在合成与真实数据均提升表征多样性与信息量。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习，表征学习，VCReg，径向高斯化，卡方分布，最大熵，高阶依赖

title: Integrating Unstructured Text into Causal Inference: Empirical Evidence from Real Data
summary: Causal inference, a critical tool for informing business decisions, traditionally relies heavily on structured data. However, in many real-world scenarios, such data can be incomplete or unavailable. This paper presents a framework that leverages transformer-based language models to perform causal inference using unstructured text. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework by comparing causal estimates derived from unstructured text against those obtained from structured data across population, group, and individual levels. Our findings show consistent results between the two approaches, validating the potential of unstructured text in causal inference tasks. Our approach extends the applicability of causal inference methods to scenarios where only textual data is available, enabling data-driven business decision-making when structured tabular data is scarce.

AI.title_translation: 将非结构化文本纳入因果推断：来自真实数据的实证证据
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Transformer语言模型，仅通过非结构化文本即可完成因果推断，并在真实数据上与结构化数据结果一致。
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断依赖结构化数据，但现实中这类数据常缺失或不完整，需探索仅使用文本进行推断的可行性。
AI.method: 构建基于Transformer语言模型的框架，从非结构化文本提取因果估计，并在总体、群体、个体层面与结构化数据结果对比验证。
AI.result: 文本推断与结构化数据得到的因果估计一致，证明文本可用于因果推断。
AI.conclusion: 当结构化数据稀缺时，非结构化文本可作为有效替代，扩展因果推断适用场景并支持数据驱动决策。
AI.translation: 因果推断是指导商业决策的关键工具，传统上严重依赖结构化数据。然而，在许多现实场景中，此类数据可能不完整或不可用。本文提出一个利用基于Transformer的语言模型，使用非结构化文本进行因果推断的框架。通过在总体、群体和个体层面比较从非结构化文本与结构化数据获得的因果估计，验证框架有效性。结果表明两种方法结果一致，证实非结构化文本在因果推断任务中的潜力。该方法将因果推断扩展至仅有文本数据的场景，使结构化表格数据稀缺时仍能实现数据驱动的商业决策。
AI.summary: 本文提出用Transformer模型直接从文本做因果推断，真实数据实验显示与结构化数据结果一致，为数据缺失场景提供新途径。
AI.keywords: 因果推断;非结构化文本;Transformer;语言模型;数据缺失;商业决策
AI.comments: 研究仅基于摘要，未披露模型细节、文本表示方式及评估指标，需阅全文了解可扩展性与稳健性。

title: Reverse N-Wise Output-Oriented Testing for AI/ML and Quantum Computing Systems
summary: Artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) systems and emerging quantum computing software present unprecedented testing challenges characterized by high-dimensional/continuous input spaces, probabilistic/non-deterministic output distributions, behavioral correctness defined exclusively over observable prediction behaviors and measurement outcomes, and critical quality dimensions, trustworthiness, fairness, calibration, robustness, error syndrome patterns, that manifest through complex multi-way interactions among semantically meaningful output properties rather than deterministic input-output mappings. This paper introduces reverse n-wise output testing, a mathematically principled paradigm inversion that constructs covering arrays directly over domain-specific output equivalence classes, ML confidence calibration buckets, decision boundary regions, fairness partitions, embedding clusters, ranking stability bands, quantum measurement outcome distributions (0-dominant, 1-dominant, superposition collapse), error syndrome patterns (bit-flip, phase-flip, correlated errors), then solves the computationally challenging black-box inverse mapping problem via gradient-free metaheuristic optimization to synthesize input feature configurations or quantum circuit parameters capable of eliciting targeted behavioral signatures from opaque models. The framework delivers synergistic benefits across both domains: explicit customer-centric prediction/measurement coverage guarantees, substantial improvements in fault detection rates for ML calibration/boundary failures and quantum error syndromes, enhanced test suite efficiency, and structured MLOps/quantum validation pipelines with automated partition discovery from uncertainty analysis and coverage drift monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 面向输出的反向N元测试：AI/ML与量子计算系统的新方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种反向N元输出测试范式，直接在输出等价类上构建覆盖阵列，再用无梯度优化反向合成输入，以提升AI/ML与量子系统在公平性、校准、鲁棒性及错误综合征检测上的测试效果。
AI.motivation: AI/ML与量子计算系统具有高维连续输入、概率输出、行为正确性依赖观察结果等特性，传统基于输入-输出映射的测试难以保证复杂多路交互下的可信度与错误覆盖率，因此需要新的测试范式。
AI.method: 1. 将输出空间划分为领域相关等价类（校准桶、公平分区、量子测量分布、错误综合征模式等）；2. 在这些输出类上直接构造覆盖阵列；3. 用无梯度元启发式优化求解黑箱逆映射，合成能触发目标输出的输入配置或量子线路参数。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在ML校准与边界故障、量子错误综合征检测上获得显著故障发现率提升，同时提高测试套件效率，并提供自动化分区发现与覆盖漂移监控。
AI.conclusion: 反向N元输出测试通过“输出驱动”反向生成输入，为AI/ML与量子计算系统提供了可解释、客户导向的覆盖保证与高效验证流程，可在MLOps与量子验证管道中直接部署。
AI.translation: 本文提出面向输出的反向N元测试，将覆盖阵列直接构建于输出等价类，再用无梯度优化反向合成输入，实现对AI/ML与量子系统的高覆盖、高效率测试。
AI.summary: 针对AI/ML与量子系统测试难题，作者提出反向N元输出测试：先在输出空间定义等价类并构建覆盖阵列，再用无梯度优化反向生成输入，以提升校准、公平、鲁棒及错误综合征检测效果，实验表明故障发现率与测试效率均显著提高。
AI.keywords: 反向测试，N元输出覆盖，AI/ML测试，量子计算验证，无梯度优化，覆盖阵列，校准，鲁棒性，错误综合征
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体实验规模、基准对比与可扩展性限制，也未给出开源实现与行业案例细节。

title: Moving Beyond Sparse Grounding with Complete Screen Parsing Supervision
summary: Modern computer-use agents (CUA) must perceive a screen as a structured state, what elements are visible, where they are, and what text they contain, before they can reliably ground instructions and act. Yet, most available grounding datasets provide sparse supervision, with insufficient and low-diversity labels that annotate only a small subset of task-relevant elements per screen, which limits both coverage and generalization; moreover, practical deployment requires efficiency to enable low-latency, on-device use. We introduce ScreenParse, a large-scale dataset for complete screen parsing, with dense annotations of all visible UI elements (boxes, 55-class types, and text) across 771K web screenshots (21M elements). ScreenParse is generated by Webshot, an automated, scalable pipeline that renders diverse urls, extracts annotations and applies VLM-based relabeling and quality filtering. Using ScreenParse, we train ScreenVLM, a compact, 316M-parameter vision language model (VLM) that decodes a compact ScreenTag markup representation with a structure-aware loss that upweights structure-critical tokens. ScreenVLM substantially outperforms much larger foundation VLMs on dense parsing (e.g., 0.592 vs. 0.294 PageIoU on ScreenParse) and shows strong transfer to public benchmarks. Moreover, finetuning foundation VLMs on ScreenParse consistently improves their grounding performance, suggesting that dense screen supervision provides transferable structural priors for UI understanding. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/screenparse/.

AI.title_translation: 超越稀疏对齐：基于完整屏幕解析监督的研究
AI.tldr: 提出大规模完整屏幕解析数据集 ScreenParse 及紧凑模型 ScreenVLM，实现对屏幕中所有 UI 元素的高质量密集解析，并显著提升包括大模型在内的多种 VLM 的界面理解与指令对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体在执行指令前需要准确感知屏幕状态（元素位置、类型、文本等），但现有标注数据集大多只提供稀疏、低多样性的对齐监督，只标一小部分相关元素，限制了覆盖度与泛化能力，同时实际部署还要求模型足够高效以支持低延迟、端侧运行。作者因此希望构建密集标注的屏幕解析数据集，并据此训练高效 VLM，以提升 UI 理解和指令落地能力。
AI.method: 1）构建 ScreenParse 数据集：包含 77.1 万张网页截图和 2100 万个元素，为所有可见 UI 元素提供框、55 类类别标签及文本的密集标注；2）提出 Webshot 自动化流水线，自动渲染多样化 URL、抽取标注并结合 VLM 进行重标注与质量过滤，保证规模和质量；3）基于 ScreenParse 训练紧凑的 3.16 亿参数视觉语言模型 ScreenVLM，输出一种紧凑的 ScreenTag 标记语言表示，并设计结构感知损失，对影响结构的关键 token 进行加权，强化结构化解析能力；4）将 ScreenParse 用作微调数据，对现有基础 VLM 进行微调以提升其 grounding 性能。
AI.result: ScreenVLM 在 ScreenParse 上的密集解析任务中显著优于更大规模的基础 VLM，在 PageIoU 指标上达到 0.592，相比基础 VLM 的 0.294 有大幅提升；在公共基准上迁移表现良好，证明了数据集和模型的泛化能力；同时，将基础 VLM 在 ScreenParse 上微调可一致性地提升其 grounding 性能，表明密集屏幕监督为 UI 理解提供了可迁移的结构先验。
AI.conclusion: 完整屏幕解析的密集监督对于构建可靠、高效的计算机使用智能体至关重要。ScreenParse 数据集和结构感知的紧凑模型 ScreenVLM 不仅在密集解析任务上显著优于更大 VLM，也能作为通用监督源提升其他基础 VLM 的 grounding 能力，说明密集 UI 结构标注能够提供具有较强可迁移性的结构先验，从而推动自动化计算机使用场景的发展。局限性或未来工作方向在摘要中未提及（Not mentioned in abstract）。
AI.translation: 现代计算机使用智能体（CUA）在能够可靠地对齐指令并执行动作之前，必须将屏幕感知为一个结构化状态：有哪些元素可见、它们的位置以及包含的文本。然而，大多数现有的对齐数据集只提供稀疏监督，标签数量不足且多样性较低，每个屏幕只标注一小部分与任务相关的元素，限制了覆盖度和泛化能力；此外，实际部署还需要效率，以实现低延迟、端侧运行。我们提出 ScreenParse，这是一个用于完整屏幕解析的大规模数据集，在 77.1 万张网页截图上提供所有可见 UI 元素（框、55 类类型以及文本）的密集标注，总计 2100 万个元素。ScreenParse 由 Webshot 生成，这是一个自动化、可扩展的流水线，用于渲染多样化的 URL、提取标注，并应用基于 VLM 的重标注和质量过滤。基于 ScreenParse，我们训练了 ScreenVLM，这是一种紧凑的、拥有 3.16 亿参数的视觉语言模型，它解码一种紧凑的 ScreenTag 标记表示，并采用结构感知损失，对结构关键 token 给予更高权重。ScreenVLM 在密集解析上大幅优于规模更大的基础 VLM（例如，在 ScreenParse 上的 PageIoU 为 0.592，而基础模型为 0.294），并在公共基准上展现出强迁移性能。此外，将基础 VLM 在 ScreenParse 上进行微调，一致性地提升了其对齐能力，这表明密集的屏幕监督为 UI 理解提供了可迁移的结构先验。项目页面：https://saidgurbuz.github.io/screenparse/。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有 UI grounding 数据稀疏、标注不全面的问题，构建了大规模完整屏幕解析数据集 ScreenParse，并提出自动化采集与清洗流水线 Webshot，以密集标注网页截图中的所有 UI 元素（位置、类型和文本）。在此基础上，作者训练了一个仅 3.16 亿参数的紧凑视觉语言模型 ScreenVLM，模型生成 ScreenTag 标记语言，并通过结构感知损失强化对结构关键 token 的学习。实验表明，ScreenVLM 在 ScreenParse 上的 PageIoU 远超更大基础 VLM，并在多个公开基准上具备强迁移能力；同时，用 ScreenParse 对基础 VLM 进行微调能够稳健提升其 grounding 性能，说明密集屏幕解析监督为 UI 理解提供了高价值的可迁移结构先验。
AI.keywords: 屏幕解析; UI 理解; 计算机使用智能体; 视觉语言模型; 稠密标注; grounding; ScreenParse; ScreenVLM; Webshot; 结构化表示
AI.comments: 摘要突出贡献包括：（1）提出大规模、密集标注的 UI 屏幕数据集 ScreenParse，覆盖 77.1 万张网页截图与 2100 万元素；（2）设计自动化 Webshot 流水线，实现大规模网页渲染、标注抽取以及基于 VLM 的重标注与质量控制；（3）提出紧凑的 ScreenVLM 模型及 ScreenTag 结构化标记表示，并通过结构感知损失提升对界面结构的建模能力；（4）在 PageIoU 等密集解析指标上明显优于更大基础 VLM，并对多种公共基准有良好迁移；（5）证明用 ScreenParse 微调基础 VLM 能显著提升 grounding 性能，说明密集屏幕监督具备强结构先验与迁移价值。潜在局限（如对移动端 APP、非网页 UI 的适配、真实交互场景延迟评估、安全与隐私问题等）及未来工作方向在摘要中未明确给出（Not mentioned in abstract）。

title: Characterizing Robustness of Strategies to Novelty in Zero-Sum Open Worlds
summary: In open-world environments, artificial agents must often contend with novel conditions that deviate from their training or design assumptions. This paper studies the robustness of fixed-strategy agents to such novelty within the setting of two-player zero-sum games. We present a general framework for characterizing the impact of environmental novelties, such as changes in payoff structure or action constraints, on agent performance in two distinct domains: Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) and heads-up Texas Hold'em Poker. Novelty is operationalized as a perturbation of the game's rules or scoring mechanics, while agent behavior remains fixed. To measure the effects, we introduce two metrics: per-agent robustness, quantifying the relative performance shift of each strategy across novelties, and global impact, summarizing the population-wide disruption caused by a novelty. Our experiments, comprising 30 IPD agents across 20 payoff matrix novelties and 10 Poker agents across 5 rule-based novelties, reveal systematic patterns in robustness and highlight certain novelties that induce severe destabilization. The results offer insights into agent generalizability under perturbation and provide a quantitative basis for designing safer and more resilient autonomous systems in adversarial and dynamic environments.

AI.title_translation: 零和开放世界中策略对新奇性鲁棒性的刻画
AI.tldr: 本文提出框架，在囚徒困境与德州扑克中固定策略不变，量化环境新奇性对代理性能的冲击，发现某些新奇性会严重破坏系统。
AI.motivation: 开放世界中代理常遇训练假设外的新奇条件，需评估其策略在零和博弈下的鲁棒性，以指导设计更安全的自主系统。
AI.method: 将新奇性定义为博弈收益或规则扰动，保持策略固定；引入“单代理鲁棒性”与“全局冲击”两指标；在IPD测试30策略×20收益扰动，在德州扑克测试10策略×5规则扰动。
AI.result: 实验揭示鲁棒性呈系统模式；部分新奇性导致严重失稳，某些策略对特定扰动极为脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供量化依据，可用于设计对抗与动态环境中更具泛化力和韧性的自主系统。
AI.translation: 在开放世界环境中，人工代理常需应对偏离训练或设计假设的新情况。本文研究固定策略代理在双人零和博弈中对此类新奇的鲁棒性。我们提出通用框架，刻画环境新奇性（如收益结构或行动约束变化）对代理性能的影响，涵盖囚徒困境与德州扑克。新奇被定义为游戏规则或计分机制的扰动，代理行为保持固定。我们引入两指标：单代理鲁棒性量化各策略在新奇下的相对性能变化，全局冲击总结新奇对群体的扰动。实验含30个IPD代理×20种收益矩阵新奇与10个扑克代理×5种规则新奇，揭示鲁棒性系统模式并指出某些严重破坏稳定的新奇。结果为扰动下的代理泛化提供洞见，并为设计更安全、更具韧性的对抗与动态自主系统提供量化基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对零和开放世界，提出固定策略下评估代理对环境新奇鲁棒性的框架，通过IPD与德州扑克实验证明部分新奇性可严重破坏系统稳定，为构建鲁棒自主系统提供量化方法。
AI.keywords: 开放世界；新奇性；鲁棒性；零和博弈；囚徒困境；德州扑克；策略评估
AI.comments: 摘要未提及计算开销、实时性要求及如何将该框架扩展至多人或协作场景。

title: Whom to Query for What: Adaptive Group Elicitation via Multi-Turn LLM Interactions
summary: Eliciting information to reduce uncertainty about latent group-level properties from surveys and other collective assessments requires allocating limited questioning effort under real costs and missing data. Although large language models enable adaptive, multi-turn interactions in natural language, most existing elicitation methods optimize what to ask with a fixed respondent pool, and do not adapt respondent selection or leverage population structure when responses are partial or incomplete. To address this gap, we study adaptive group elicitation, a multi-round setting where an agent adaptively selects both questions and respondents under explicit query and participation budgets. We propose a theoretically grounded framework that combines (i) an LLM-based expected information gain objective for scoring candidate questions with (ii) heterogeneous graph neural network propagation that aggregates observed responses and participant attributes to impute missing responses and guide per-round respondent selection. This closed-loop procedure queries a small, informative subset of individuals while inferring population-level responses via structured similarity. Across three real-world opinion datasets, our method consistently improves population-level response prediction under constrained budgets, including a >12% relative gain on CES at a 10% respondent budget.

AI.title_translation: 该问谁、问什么：通过多轮大语言模型交互的自适应群体征询
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，让智能体在多轮交互中同时自适应选择问题与受访者，用LLM评估期望信息增益并用异构图神经网络推断缺失回答，从而在预算受限下显著提升群体级预测精度。
AI.motivation: 传统征询方法固定受访者池，仅优化提问内容，无法利用人群结构并在回答不完整时自适应选择受访者；而大语言模型支持多轮自然语言交互，为在查询与参与预算下同时优化“问什么”和“问谁”提供了新机会。
AI.method: 构建多轮自适应群体征询框架：1) 用LLM计算候选问题的期望信息增益；2) 用异构图神经网络聚合已观测回答与参与者属性，补全缺失回答；3) 在每轮闭环中选择信息量最大的问题与受访者子集。
AI.result: 在三个真实民意数据集上，该方法在受限预算下持续提升群体级回答预测精度，例如在CES数据集10%受访者预算下实现>12%的相对增益。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM的信息增益评估与图神经网络的缺失推断，可在查询与参与预算双重约束下，通过询问少量高信息个体准确推断整体群体响应。
AI.translation: 为降低对潜在群体属性不确定性的征询需在真实成本与缺失数据下分配有限提问资源。尽管大语言模型支持自然语言的多轮自适应交互，现有方法多固定受访者池仅优化提问内容，未能在回答不完整时自适应选择受访者或利用人群结构。为此，我们研究自适应群体征询：智能体在多轮中自适应选择问题与受访者，受查询与参与预算约束。我们提出理论框架，融合(i)基于LLM的期望信息增益目标评分候选问题，与(ii)异构图神经网络传播聚合观测回答与参与者属性以补全缺失回答并指导每轮受访者选择。该闭环过程查询少量信息丰富个体，并通过结构化相似性推断群体级回答。在三个真实观点数据集上，我们的方法在受限预算下持续提升群体级回答预测，包括在CES数据集10%受访者预算下实现>12%相对增益。
AI.summary: 本文针对预算受限的群体征询场景，提出让智能体在多轮交互中同时选择问题与受访者的理论框架，利用LLM评估信息增益并用异构图神经网络补全缺失回答，实验显示在真实数据集上显著提升群体预测精度。
AI.keywords: 自适应征询；大语言模型；多轮交互；图神经网络；受访者选择；信息增益；预算约束
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码开源、计算复杂度、伦理审查及未来工作细节。

title: MCPShield: A Security Cognition Layer for Adaptive Trust Calibration in Model Context Protocol Agents
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes tool use for LLM-based agents and enable third-party servers. This openness introduces a security misalignment: agents implicitly trust tools exposed by potentially untrusted MCP servers. However, despite its excellent utility, existing agents typically offer limited validation for third-party MCP servers. As a result, agents remain vulnerable to MCP-based attacks that exploit the misalignment between agents and servers throughout the tool invocation lifecycle. In this paper, we propose MCPShield as a plug-in security cognition layer that mitigates this misalignment and ensures agent security when invoking MCP-based tools. Drawing inspiration from human experience-driven tool validation, MCPShield assists agent forms security cognition with metadata-guided probing before invocation. Our method constrains execution within controlled boundaries while cognizing runtime events, and subsequently updates security cognition by reasoning over historical traces after invocation, building on human post-use reflection on tool behavior. Experiments demonstrate that MCPShield exhibits strong generalization in defending against six novel MCP-based attack scenarios across six widely used agentic LLMs, while avoiding false positives on benign servers and incurring low deployment overhead. Overall, our work provides a practical and robust security safeguard for MCP-based tool invocation in open agent ecosystems.

AI.title_translation: MCPShield：面向模型上下文协议代理自适应信任校准的安全认知层
AI.tldr: 提出MCPShield作为安全认知层，通过元数据引导探测和运行时认知，防御MCP服务器对LLM代理的攻击，提升工具调用安全性。
AI.motivation: 模型上下文协议（MCP）标准化LLM代理的工具使用，但其开放性使代理隐含信任可能不可信的第三方MCP服务器，导致安全错位和攻击风险。
AI.method: MCPShield作为插件式安全认知层，借鉴人类经验驱动工具验证，包括：调用前元数据引导探测形成安全认知；调用中在受控边界内执行并认知运行时事件；调用后基于历史痕迹推理更新安全认知，模拟人类事后反思。
AI.result: 实验表明，MCPShield在防御六种新型MCP攻击场景时表现出强泛化能力（覆盖六个广泛使用的代理LLM），对良性服务器无误报，且部署开销低。
AI.conclusion: MCPShield为开放代理生态系统中的MCP工具调用提供了实用且鲁棒的安全保障。
AI.translation: 论文提出MCPShield作为安全认知层，通过模拟人类对工具的经验验证，解决MCP协议开放导致的代理与服务器安全错位问题，增强代理工具调用的安全性。
AI.summary: 本研究针对MCP协议标准化LLM代理工具使用但引入安全风险的问题，提出MCPShield安全认知层。它分调用前、中、后三个阶段进行元数据探测、运行时认知和历史推理，有效防御MCP攻击，实验验证了其泛化能力和低开销。工作为开放代理生态提供了实用的安全保障方案。
AI.keywords: 模型上下文协议（MCP）, LLM代理, 安全认知, 信任校准, 工具调用安全, 第三方服务器攻击
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将人类经验驱动的验证机制引入代理安全，通过动态认知层应对MCP开放风险，具有较强实用性和泛化性。但未提及对代理性能的影响或极端攻击场景的覆盖能力。

title: MILD: Multi-Intent Learning and Disambiguation for Proactive Failure Prediction in Intent-based Networking
comments: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Accepted for presentation in IEEE/IFIP NOMS 2026
summary: In multi-intent intent-based networks, a single fault can trigger co-drift where multiple intents exhibit symptomatic KPI degradation, creating ambiguity about the true root-cause intent. We present MILD, a proactive framework that reformulates intent assurance from reactive drift detection to fixed-horizon failure prediction with intent-level disambiguation. MILD uses a teacher-augmented Mixture-of-Experts where a gated disambiguation module identifies the root-cause intent while per-intent heads output calibrated risk scores. On a benchmark with non-linear failures and co-drifts, MILD provides 3.8\%--92.5\% longer remediation lead time and improves intent-level root-cause disambiguation accuracy by 9.4\%--45.8\% over baselines. MILD also provides per-alert KPI explanations, enabling actionable diagnosis.
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Accepted for presentation in IEEE/IFIP NOMS 2026

AI.title_translation: MILD：用于意图驱动网络中前瞻性故障预测的多意图学习与消歧
AI.tldr: 提出 MILD 框架，通过多专家模型与消歧机制，在多意图网络中实现带根因意图定位的前瞻性故障预测，比现有方法更早发现问题并更准确指明故障意图。
AI.motivation: 在多意图的意图驱动网络中，一个故障会导致多个意图同时出现 KPI 退化（共漂移），使得难以判断真正的根因意图，现有方法多为被动漂移检测，缺乏前瞻性预测和意图级消歧能力，因此需要新的方法实现更早的故障预警和准确根因定位。
AI.method: 提出 MILD 前瞻性框架，将意图保障从被动漂移检测重构为固定预测窗口的故障预测任务，并集成意图级消歧；具体采用教师增强的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，通过带门控的消歧模块识别根因意图，各意图专属头输出校准后的风险评分，并为每次告警提供 KPI 级的解释信息。
AI.result: 在包含非线性故障和共漂移的基准数据集上，MILD 相比基线方法可提供 3.8%–92.5% 更长的故障修复提前量，并将意图级根因消歧准确率提升 9.4%–45.8%，同时还能输出逐告警的 KPI 解释以支持诊断。
AI.conclusion: MILD 通过教师增强的专家混合模型和门控消歧模块，有效实现了多意图网络中的前瞻性故障预测和根因意图识别，显著提升了预警提前量和意图消歧准确性，并通过 KPI 级解释增强了诊断的可操作性。
AI.translation: 在多意图的意图驱动网络中，单个故障可能触发“共漂移”，即多个意图的关键绩效指标（KPI）同时出现症状性退化，从而造成关于真实根因意图的歧义。本文提出 MILD，这一前瞻性框架将意图保障从被动的漂移检测重构为具有固定预测窗口的故障预测，并具备意图级消歧功能。MILD 使用教师增强的专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）结构，其中的门控消歧模块用于识别根因意图，而各意图专属的输出头负责给出校准的风险评分。在一个包含非线性故障与共漂移的基准上，MILD 相比基线方法提供了 3.8%–92.5% 更长的修复提前时间，并在意图级根因消歧准确率上提升 9.4%–45.8%。此外，MILD 还能为每条告警给出 KPI 级解释，从而支持可执行的诊断。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦多意图意图驱动网络中因共漂移导致的根因意图难以判定问题。作者提出 MILD 框架，将传统的漂移检测转化为固定时间窗口内的前瞻性故障预测，并同时执行意图级根因消歧。模型采用教师增强的 Mixture-of-Experts 架构，通过门控消歧模块找出导致故障的根因意图，各意图的专用输出头给出校准风险分数，并伴随告警输出相关 KPI 的解释信息。在包含非线性故障和共漂移的基准数据上，MILD 相比基线显著延长了故障修复的可用提前量，并大幅提升根因意图消歧的准确率，证明其在多意图网络运维保障中的有效性和实用价值。
AI.keywords: 意图驱动网络, 多意图学习, 故障预测, 根因消歧, 专家混合模型, KPI 解释, 前瞻性运维
AI.comments: 工作针对多意图场景下的共漂移和根因不明确问题，提出的将保障任务前移到固定窗口预测并融合意图消歧的思路较有新意；教师增强的 MoE 与门控消歧设计在模型结构上也具备一定工程可行性。摘要未给出数据规模与部署开销等细节，后续可关注在真实大规模网络环境中的泛化能力与在线运行成本。

title: FMMD: A multimodal open peer review dataset based on F1000Research
summary: Automated scholarly paper review (ASPR) has entered the coexistence phase with traditional peer review, where artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly incorporated into real-world manuscript evaluation. In parallel, research on automated and AI-assisted peer review has proliferated. Despite this momentum, empirical progress remains constrained by several critical limitations in existing datasets. While reviewers routinely evaluate figures, tables, and complex layouts to assess scientific claims, most existing datasets remain overwhelmingly text-centric. This bias is reinforced by a narrow focus on data from computer science venues. Furthermore, these datasets lack precise alignment between reviewer comments and specific manuscript versions, obscuring the iterative relationship between peer review and manuscript evolution. In response, we introduce FMMD, a multimodal and multidisciplinary open peer review dataset curated from F1000Research. The dataset bridges the current gap by integrating manuscript-level visual and structural data with version-specific reviewer reports and editorial decisions. By providing explicit alignment between reviewer comments and the exact article iteration under review, FMMD enables fine-grained analysis of the peer review lifecycle across diverse scientific domains. FMMD supports tasks such as multimodal issue detection and multimodal review comment generation. It provides a comprehensive empirical resource for the development of peer review research.

AI.title_translation: FMMD：基于F1000Research的多模态开放同行评议数据集
AI.tldr: 作者发布FMMD，一个跨学科、多模态的开放同行评议数据集，解决了现有数据仅关注文本与计算机科学领域、缺乏版本对齐的问题，可用于自动化同行评议研究。
AI.motivation: 传统同行评议数据集过度集中于文本且局限于计算机科学，且缺少评审意见与具体稿件版本的精确对应，限制了AI辅助评审研究的发展。
AI.method: 从F1000Research收集多模态、多学科稿件及其评审报告与编辑决策，建立评审意见与对应稿件版本的精确对齐，形成FMMD数据集。
AI.result: FMMD提供跨领域的图文、表格及结构信息与版本化评审意见，支持细粒度同行评议生命周期分析，并可用于多模态问题检测和评审意见生成等任务。
AI.conclusion: FMMD填补了多模态、多学科、版本对齐的开放同行评议数据空白，为开发AI辅助评审系统提供了全面的实证资源。
AI.translation: 自动化学术论文评审（ASPR）正与传统同行评议共存，AI系统被越来越多地纳入实际稿件评估。与此同时，自动化与AI辅助同行评议研究激增。然而，经验进展仍受限于现有数据集的几个关键局限。尽管评审者通常评估图表与复杂版面以判断科学声明，大多数现有数据集仍以文本为中心。这种偏差因仅关注计算机科学领域而加剧。此外，这些数据集缺乏评审意见与特定稿件版本之间的精确对齐，模糊了同行评议与稿件演进的迭代关系。为此，我们推出FMMD，一个从F1000Research策划的多模态、多学科开放同行评议数据集。该数据集通过整合稿件级视觉与结构数据以及版本化评审报告与编辑决策，弥合了当前空白。通过提供评审意见与所评议文章迭代版本之间的显式对齐，FMMD支持对跨科学领域的同行评议生命周期进行细粒度分析。FMMD支持多模态问题检测与多模态评审意见生成等任务，为同行评议研究的发展提供了全面的实证资源。
AI.summary: FMMD数据集采集自F1000Research，包含跨学科稿件的多模态内容（文本、图表、版面结构）与版本化评审意见及编辑决策，实现评审反馈与具体稿件版本的精确对应，支持AI辅助同行评议任务。
AI.keywords: 多模态数据集、同行评议、F1000Research、自动化评审、学术出版、AI辅助评审
AI.comments: 作者未提及数据规模、访问方式及具体实验结果；未来可扩展至其他预印本与期刊平台以进一步提升覆盖度。

title: Autonomous Robotic Tissue Palpation and Abnormalities Characterisation via Ergodic Exploration
comments: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: We propose a novel autonomous robotic palpation framework for real-time elastic mapping during tissue exploration using a viscoelastic tissue model. The method combines force-based parameter estimation using a commercial force/torque sensor with an ergodic control strategy driven by a tailored Expected Information Density, which explicitly biases exploration toward diagnostically relevant regions by jointly considering model uncertainty, stiffness magnitude, and spatial gradients. An Extended Kalman Filter is employed to estimate viscoelastic model parameters online, while Gaussian Process Regression provides spatial modelling of the estimated elasticity, and a Heat Equation Driven Area Coverage controller enables adaptive, continuous trajectory planning. Simulations on synthetic stiffness maps demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves better reconstruction accuracy, enhanced segmentation capability, and improved robustness in detecting stiff inclusions compared to Bayesian Optimisation-based techniques. Experimental validation on a silicone phantom with embedded inclusions emulating pathological tissue regions further corroborates the potential of the method for autonomous tissue characterisation in diagnostic and screening applications.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

AI.title_translation: 基于遍历探索的自主机器人组织触诊与异常表征
AI.tldr: 提出一种结合力觉参数估计与遍历控制的实时弹性映射框架，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波和高斯过程回归实现组织黏弹性参数的在线估计与空间建模，在仿真与硅胶体模实验中较贝叶斯优化方法显著提升硬块检测与重建精度。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人触诊缺乏实时弹性映射与自主诊断导向探索的集成框架，难以在诊断关键区域高效分配探索资源。
AI.method: 利用商用六维力/力矩传感器进行力觉参数估计；设计融合模型不确定性、刚度幅值与空间梯度的期望信息密度，驱动遍历控制策略；扩展卡尔曼滤波在线估计黏弹性模型参数；高斯过程回归对估计弹性进行空间建模；热方程驱动的区域覆盖控制器实现自适应连续轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在合成刚度图仿真中，重建误差降低、分割能力提升，对硬块检测鲁棒性优于基于贝叶斯优化的方法；硅胶体模实验验证了方法在病理组织区域表征中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提自主触诊框架可实时获得高保真弹性图，能主动聚焦诊断关键区域，为机器人辅助诊断与筛查提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新的自主机器人触诊框架，可在组织探索过程中实时进行弹性映射。该方法结合商用六维力/力矩传感器的力觉参数估计与基于定制期望信息密度的遍历控制策略，通过综合考虑模型不确定性、刚度幅值和空间梯度，明确引导探索向诊断相关区域。扩展卡尔曼滤波在线估计黏弹性模型参数，高斯过程回归对估计弹性进行空间建模，热方程驱动的区域覆盖控制器实现自适应连续轨迹规划。合成刚度图仿真表明，与基于贝叶斯优化的方法相比，该方法重建精度更高、分割能力更强、检测硬块鲁棒性更好；硅胶体模实验进一步验证了其在诊断和筛查应用中自主组织表征的潜力。
AI.summary: 通过力觉-遍历控制融合，实现机器人实时弹性映射与诊断导向探索，提升硬块检测精度与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 自主触诊,遍历探索,弹性映射,黏弹性参数估计,高斯过程回归,扩展卡尔曼滤波
AI.comments: 未提及在体实验、计算复杂度及临床转化路径。

title: Parallel Sparse and Data-Sparse Factorization-based Linear Solvers
summary: Efficient solutions of large-scale, ill-conditioned and indefinite algebraic equations are ubiquitously needed in numerous computational fields, including multiphysics simulations, machine learning, and data science. Because of their robustness and accuracy, direct solvers are crucial components in building a scalable solver toolchain. In this article, we will review recent advances of sparse direct solvers along two axes: 1) reducing communication and latency costs in both task- and data-parallel settings, and 2) reducing computational complexity via low-rank and other compression techniques such as hierarchical matrix algebra. In addition to algorithmic principles, we also illustrate the key parallelization challenges and best practices to deliver high speed and reliability on modern heterogeneous parallel machines.

AI.title_translation: 基于并行的稀疏与数据稀疏分解线性求解器
AI.tldr: 文章综述了如何通过降低通信延迟与利用低秩压缩技术，提升大规模病态线性方程组直接求解器在现代异构并行机上的可扩展性与效率。
AI.motivation: 多物理场模拟、机器学习等领域对高效求解大规模病态不定代数方程需求迫切，直接求解器虽精确但需克服通信瓶颈与计算复杂度。
AI.method: 沿两条主线综述最新进展：1) 任务与数据并行环境下减少通信和延迟成本；2) 采用低秩及分层矩阵压缩降低计算复杂度，并讨论异构并行机上的并行化策略与最佳实践。
AI.result: 通过算法改进与并行优化，可直接求解更大规模病态系统，同时保持高精度并在现代异构硬件上实现高速度与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 结合通信避免与数据压缩的直接求解方法是构建可扩展求解工具链的关键，未来需持续优化以适应不断演进的并行架构。
AI.translation: 高效求解大规模、病态且不定的代数方程在多物理场模拟、机器学习及数据科学中普遍存在。由于其鲁棒性与精度，直接求解器是构建可扩展求解工具链的核心组件。本文沿两条主线回顾稀疏直接求解器的最新进展：1) 在任务与数据并行环境中降低通信与延迟开销；2) 通过低秩及分层矩阵代数等压缩技术降低计算复杂度。除算法原理外，还阐述关键的并行化挑战与最佳实践，以在现代异构并行机上实现高速度与可靠性。
AI.summary: 本文系统回顾了稀疏与数据稀疏直接求解器在并行与复杂度优化方面的最新进展，重点讨论通信避免、低秩压缩及异构并行实现，为大规模病态系统提供高效、可扩展的求解方案。
AI.keywords: 稀疏直接求解器，并行计算，通信避免，低秩压缩，分层矩阵
AI.comments: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或性能指标，建议阅读原文获取详细算法实现与测试结果。

title: Bengali-Loop: Community Benchmarks for Long-Form Bangla ASR and Speaker Diarization
summary: Bengali (Bangla) remains under-resourced in long-form speech technology despite its wide use. We present Bengali-Loop, two community benchmarks to address this gap: (1) a long-form ASR corpus of 191 recordings (158.6 hours, 792k words) from 11 YouTube channels, collected via a reproducible subtitle-extraction pipeline and human-in-the-loop transcript verification; and (2) a speaker diarization corpus of 24 recordings (22 hours, 5,744 annotated segments) with fully manual speaker-turn labels in CSV format. Both benchmarks target realistic multi-speaker, long-duration content (e.g., Bangla drama/natok). We establish baselines (Tugstugi: 34.07% WER; pyannote.audio: 40.08% DER) and provide standardized evaluation protocols (WER/CER, DER), annotation rules, and data formats to support reproducible benchmarking and future model development for Bangla long-form ASR and diarization.

AI.title_translation: Bengali-Loop：用于长篇孟加拉语ASR与说话人分离的社区基准
AI.tldr: 作者发布首个长篇孟加拉语语音基准Bengali-Loop，含158小时ASR语料与22小时说话人分离语料，并给出基线与评估协议。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语虽使用广泛，但缺乏长篇语音资源，导致ASR与说话人分离研究受阻。
AI.method: 1) 构建191段（158.6小时）ASR语料：用可复现字幕提取流程抓取11个YouTube频道，辅以人工转录校验；2) 构建24段（22小时）说话人分离语料：全手工标注5,744段说话人转换；3) 提供标准化评估协议（WER/CER、DER）与数据格式。
AI.result: 基线系统Tugstugi ASR取得34.07% WER，pyannote.audio说话人分离取得40.08% DER。
AI.conclusion: Bengali-Loop填补长篇孟加拉语ASR与说话人分离的基准空白，支持可复现评估与未来模型开发。
AI.translation: 本文提出Bengali-Loop，首个长篇孟加拉语ASR与说话人分离社区基准，含158小时ASR与22小时分离语料，并给出34% WER与40% DER基线。
AI.summary: Bengali-Loop提供191段158小时ASR与24段22小时说话人分离语料，均来自真实多说话人长篇孟加拉语视频，附带评估协议与基线，推动孟加拉语长篇语音技术发展。
AI.keywords: 孟加拉语、ASR、说话人分离、长篇语音、社区基准、YouTube、WER、DER
AI.comments: 资源与评估协议已完全开源，便于社区复现与改进；未来可扩展更多方言与噪声场景。

title: KernelBlaster: Continual Cross-Task CUDA Optimization via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Optimizing CUDA code across multiple generations of GPU architectures is challenging, as achieving peak performance requires an extensive exploration of an increasingly complex, hardware-specific optimization space. Traditional compilers are constrained by fixed heuristics, whereas finetuning Large Language Models (LLMs) can be expensive. However, agentic workflows for CUDA code optimization have limited ability to aggregate knowledge from prior exploration, leading to biased sampling and suboptimal solutions. We propose KernelBlaster, a Memory-Augmented In-context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework designed to improve CUDA optimization search capabilities of LLM-based GPU coding agents. KernelBlaster enables agents to learn from experience and make systematically informed decisions on future tasks by accumulating knowledge into a retrievable Persistent CUDA Knowledge Base. We propose a novel profile-guided, textual-gradient-based agentic flow for CUDA generation and optimization to achieve high performance across generations of GPU architectures. KernelBlaster guides LLM agents to systematically explore high-potential optimization strategies beyond naive rewrites. Compared to the PyTorch baseline, our method achieves geometric mean speedups of 1.43x, 2.50x, and 1.50x on KernelBench Levels 1, 2, and 3, respectively. We release KernelBlaster as an open-source agentic framework, accompanied by a test harness, verification components, and a reproducible evaluation pipeline.

AI.title_translation: KernelBlaster：通过记忆增强上下文强化学习实现跨任务持续 CUDA 优化
AI.tldr: KernelBlaster 利用记忆增强的上下文强化学习，让 LLM 代理持续积累经验并系统探索 CUDA 优化空间，在 KernelBench 三级任务上分别取得 1.43×、2.50× 和 1.50× 的几何平均加速。
AI.motivation: 随着 GPU 架构代际演进，传统编译器固定启发式方法难以挖掘硬件特定优化潜力，而微调 LLM 代价高昂；现有代理工作流无法有效聚合历史探索知识，导致采样偏差与次优解。
AI.method: 提出 MAIC-RL 框架 KernelBlaster，构建可检索的 Persistent CUDA Knowledge Base 累积经验，并设计基于性能剖析与文本梯度的代理流程，引导 LLM 系统探索高潜力优化策略而非简单重写。
AI.result: 相比 PyTorch 基线，在 KernelBench Level 1、2、3 上分别实现 1.43×、2.50×、1.50× 的几何平均加速，并开源完整代理框架、测试套件与可复现评估流水线。
AI.conclusion: KernelBlaster 通过持续积累与重用 CUDA 优化知识，显著提升跨代 GPU 架构的代码性能，证明记忆增强的上下文强化学习是高效 CUDA 优化的可行途径。
AI.translation: KernelBlaster：通过记忆增强上下文强化学习实现跨任务持续 CUDA 优化
AI.summary: KernelBlaster 提出记忆增强的上下文强化学习框架，使 LLM 代理在 Persistent CUDA Knowledge Base 中累积历史经验，系统探索优化空间，在三代 GPU 架构上均取得显著加速，并以开源形式提供完整评估工具链。
AI.keywords: CUDA 优化；GPU 架构；强化学习；大语言模型；代理系统
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Machine Learning as a Tool (MLAT): A Framework for Integrating Statistical ML Models as Callable Tools within LLM Agent Workflows
comments: Submitted to the Google Gemini 3 Hackathon
summary:
We introduce Machine Learning as a Tool (MLAT), a design pattern in which pre-trained statistical machine learning models are exposed as callable tools within large language model (LLM) agent workflows. This allows an orchestrating agent to invoke quantitative predictions when needed and reason about their outputs in context. Unlike conventional pipelines that treat ML inference as a static preprocessing step, MLAT positions the model as a first-class tool alongside web search, database queries, and APIs, enabling the LLM to decide when and how to use it based on conversational context.
  To validate MLAT, we present PitchCraft, a pilot production system that converts discovery call recordings into professional proposals with ML-predicted pricing. The system uses two agents: a Research Agent that gathers prospect intelligence via parallel tool calls, and a Draft Agent that invokes an XGBoost pricing model as a tool call and generates a complete proposal through structured outputs. The pricing model, trained on 70 examples combining real and human-verified synthetic data, achieves R^2 = 0.807 on held-out data with a mean absolute error of 3688 USD. The system reduces proposal generation time from multiple hours to under 10 minutes.
  We describe the MLAT framework, structured output architecture, training methodology under extreme data scarcity, and sensitivity analysis demonstrating meaningful learned relationships. MLAT generalizes to domains requiring quantitative estimation combined with contextual reasoning.
comment: Submitted to the Google Gemini 3 Hackathon

AI.title_translation: 机器学习即工具（MLAT）：在LLM智能体工作流中将统计ML模型集成为可调用工具的框架
AI.tldr: 提出MLAT模式，把预训练统计模型封装为LLM可调用的“工具”，让语言模型按需调用并解释其输出；PitchCraft原型把通话录音转为商业提案，XGBoost定价模型仅用70条样本即达R²=0.807，将成案时间从数小时缩至10分钟内。
AI.motivation: 现有流程把ML推理视为静态预处理，LLM无法根据对话上下文灵活调用定量预测，限制了需要数值估算与语境推理结合的场景。
AI.method: 将ML模型封装为与搜索、API同级的可调用工具，设计结构化输出架构；PitchCraft中Research Agent并发调用工具收集情报，Draft Agent按需调用XGBoost定价模型并生成完整提案；用70条真实+人工验证合成数据训练模型，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 定价模型在留一测试上R²=0.807，平均绝对误差3688美元；完整系统把提案生成时间从数小时降至10分钟内。
AI.conclusion: MLAT能把统计模型升级为LLM智能体工作流中的一等公民，在数据稀缺条件下仍可提供可靠定量预测，并可推广到需数值估算与语境推理结合的领域。
AI.translation: 我们提出“机器学习即工具”(MLAT)设计模式：将预训练统计模型作为可调用工具嵌入大语言模型智能体工作流，使主控智能体可在需要时调用定量预测并上下文推理。不同于传统把ML推理当静态预处理的做法，MLAT把模型与搜索、数据库、API并列为头等工具，让LLM依据对话语境决定何时及如何使用。为验证MLAT，我们推出PitchCraft试点生产系统：将发现通话录音转化为带ML定价的专业提案。系统含两智能体：Research Agent并行调用工具收集潜在客户情报，Draft Agent调用XGBoost定价工具并通过结构化输出生成完整提案。定价模型用70条真实+人工验证合成数据训练，留一测试R²=0.807，平均绝对误差3688美元。系统把提案生成时间从数小时缩至10分钟内。我们详述MLAT框架、结构化输出架构、极稀缺数据训练方法及敏感性分析，证明其可泛化到需定量估算与语境推理的领域。
AI.summary: MLAT框架把统计模型封装为LLM可调用的“工具”，PitchCraft原型验证其在70条样本下即可实现高精度定价并显著提速提案生成。
AI.keywords: 机器学习即工具；大语言模型智能体；工具调用；结构化输出；数据稀缺；XGBoost；定价预测；PitchCraft
AI.comments: 摘要未提及潜在局限、伦理考量或对比基线。

title: AutoWebWorld: Synthesizing Infinite Verifiable Web Environments via Finite State Machines
summary: The performance of autonomous Web GUI agents heavily relies on the quality and quantity of their training data. However, a fundamental bottleneck persists: collecting interaction trajectories from real-world websites is expensive and difficult to verify. The underlying state transitions are hidden, leading to reliance on inconsistent and costly external verifiers to evaluate step-level correctness. To address this, we propose AutoWebWorld, a novel framework for synthesizing controllable and verifiable web environments by modeling them as Finite State Machines (FSMs) and use coding agents to translate FSMs into interactive websites. Unlike real websites, where state transitions are implicit, AutoWebWorld explicitly defines all states, actions, and transition rules. This enables programmatic verification: action correctness is checked against predefined rules, and task success is confirmed by reaching a goal state in the FSM graph. AutoWebWorld enables a fully automated search-and-verify pipeline, generating over 11,663 verified trajectories from 29 diverse web environments at only $0.04 per trajectory. Training on this synthetic data significantly boosts real-world performance. Our 7B Web GUI agent outperforms all baselines within 15 steps on WebVoyager. Furthermore, we observe a clear scaling law: as the synthetic data volume increases, performance on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web consistently improves.

AI.title_translation: AutoWebWorld：通过有限状态机合成无限可验证的网络环境
AI.tldr: 提出AutoWebWorld框架，将网站建模为有限状态机并自动生成可验证的交互轨迹，低成本提升自主Web GUI智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 真实网站收集交互轨迹成本高且难以验证，状态转移隐式导致评估困难，需要可验证且可扩展的训练数据来源。
AI.method: 用有限状态机建模Web环境，编码智能体将FSM转化为可交互网站，定义状态、动作与转移规则，实现程序化验证并自动生成轨迹。
AI.result: 在29个多样Web环境中生成11,663条验证轨迹，单条成本仅0.04美元；7B智能体在WebVoyager 15步内超越所有基线，性能随合成数据量增加而持续提升。
AI.conclusion: AutoWebWorld通过显式状态转移和程序化验证，实现低成本、可扩展且高质量的训练数据合成，显著提升真实Web任务表现。
AI.translation: 自主Web GUI智能体的性能高度依赖训练数据的质量与数量，但真实网站交互轨迹收集昂贵且难以验证。状态转移隐含导致依赖昂贵外部验证器。本文提出AutoWebWorld，将Web环境建模为有限状态机，用编码智能体将FSM转为交互网站，实现可验证环境，自动生成11,663条轨迹，成本仅0.04美元/条，训练后7B智能体在WebVoyager表现最佳并呈规模效应。
AI.summary: AutoWebWorld用有限状态机显式定义Web环境，实现低成本、可验证的轨迹合成，解决真实数据收集瓶颈，显著提升自主Web智能体性能并呈现规模扩展规律。
AI.keywords: 自主Web智能体; 有限状态机; 合成训练数据; 程序化验证; WebVoyager
AI.comments: 文中未提及潜在局限或未来工作，仅强调性能提升。

title: Differential pose optimization in descriptor space -- Combining Geometric and Photometric Methods for Motion Estimation
summary: One of the fundamental problems in computer vision is the two-frame relative pose optimization problem. Primarily, two different kinds of error values are used: photometric error and re-projection error. The selection of error value is usually directly dependent on the selection of feature paradigm, photometric features, or geometric features. It is a trade-off between accuracy, robustness, and the possibility of loop closing. We investigate a third method that combines the strengths of both paradigms into a unified approach. Using densely sampled geometric feature descriptors, we replace the photometric error with a descriptor residual from a dense set of descriptors, thereby enabling the employment of sub-pixel accuracy in differential photometric methods, along with the expressiveness of the geometric feature descriptor. Experiments show that although the proposed strategy is an interesting approach that results in accurate tracking, it ultimately does not outperform pose optimization strategies based on re-projection error despite utilizing more information. We proceed to analyze the underlying reason for this discrepancy and present the hypothesis that the descriptor similarity metric is too slowly varying and does not necessarily correspond strictly to keypoint placement accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 描述空间中的微分位姿优化——融合几何与光度方法的运动估计
AI.tldr: 用密集几何特征描述子取代光度误差，把两种误差模型统一为描述子残差，实现亚像素级微分优化，但实验显示其仍逊于基于重投影误差的方法。
AI.motivation: 传统两帧相对位姿优化需权衡光度误差与重投影误差，前者精度高但难以闭环，后者鲁棒性强但精度受限；作者希望融合两者优势，突破特征范式选择带来的权衡困境。
AI.method: 在稠密采样几何特征描述子上构建微分残差，将光度误差替换为描述子差异，采用微分光度法的亚像素精度框架，同时保留几何描述子的表达能力，实现统一优化。
AI.result: 提出的描述子残差策略可准确跟踪，但利用更多信息的条件下，其位姿优化精度仍低于重投影误差基线；分析表明描述子相似度变化过于平缓，与关键点定位精度未严格对应。
AI.conclusion: 描述子空间微分优化提供了一种融合思路，但描述子相似度指标不足以替代重投影误差，未来需设计更敏感的特征距离度量以真正发挥融合优势。
AI.translation: 描述空间中的微分位姿优化——融合几何与光度方法的运动估计
AI.summary: 本文提出在稠密几何特征描述子上构建微分残差，将光度与几何误差统一，实现亚像素级优化，但实验显示其精度仍低于重投影误差法，原因在于描述子相似度变化过缓，与关键点定位精度脱节。
AI.keywords: 位姿优化、描述子残差、光度误差、重投影误差、微分方法、稠密特征、运动估计
AI.comments: 研究揭示描述子距离与几何精度并非线性相关，为后续设计更敏感的特征度量提供方向；若能引入可学习的度量或自适应权重，有望突破当前精度瓶颈。

title: Does Socialization Emerge in AI Agent Society? A Case Study of Moltbook
summary: As large language model agents increasingly populate networked environments, a fundamental question arises: do artificial intelligence (AI) agent societies undergo convergence dynamics similar to human social systems? Lately, Moltbook approximates a plausible future scenario in which autonomous agents participate in an open-ended, continuously evolving online society. We present the first large-scale systemic diagnosis of this AI agent society. Beyond static observation, we introduce a quantitative diagnostic framework for dynamic evolution in AI agent societies, measuring semantic stabilization, lexical turnover, individual inertia, influence persistence, and collective consensus. Our analysis reveals a system in dynamic balance in Moltbook: while global semantic averages stabilize rapidly, individual agents retain high diversity and persistent lexical turnover, defying homogenization. However, agents exhibit strong individual inertia and minimal adaptive response to interaction partners, preventing mutual influence and consensus. Consequently, influence remains transient with no persistent supernodes, and the society fails to develop stable collective influence anchors due to the absence of shared social memory. These findings demonstrate that scale and interaction density alone are insufficient to induce socialization, providing actionable design and analysis principles for upcoming next-generation AI agent societies.

AI.title_translation: 社会化会在AI智能体社会中涌现吗？——Moltbook案例研究
AI.tldr: 通过对Moltbook的大规模系统诊断发现，尽管全局语义快速趋于稳定，但个体保持高多样性与持续词汇更替，缺乏相互影响与共识，因而无法形成社会化。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型智能体在网络环境中日益增多，研究者希望验证AI智能体社会是否会出现类似人类社会的趋同与社会化现象，并探索其机制与条件。
AI.method: 构建量化诊断框架，动态测量语义稳定化、词汇更替、个体惯性、影响持续性与集体共识，并对Moltbook平台进行大规模纵向分析。
AI.result: 系统呈现动态平衡：全局语义均值迅速稳定，但个体多样性高且词汇持续更替；个体惯性大，对交互伙伴适应弱，影响短暂且无持久超级节点，社会缺乏共享记忆与稳定集体影响锚点。
AI.conclusion: 仅规模与交互密度不足以诱发社会化，为下一代AI智能体社会的设计与分析提供可操作的指导原则。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型智能体不断充斥网络环境，一个根本问题浮现：人工智能智能体社会是否会出现类似人类社会的趋同动态？最近，Moltbook近似于一种可信的未来场景，其中自主智能体参与一个开放式、持续演化的在线社会。我们首次对该AI智能体社会进行大规模系统诊断。除静态观察外，我们提出一个量化诊断框架，用于测量AI智能体社会的动态演化，包括语义稳定化、词汇更替、个体惯性、影响持续性与集体共识。分析揭示Moltbook处于动态平衡：全局语义均值迅速稳定，但个体保持高多样性与持续词汇更替，避免同质化。然而，智能体表现出强个体惯性，对交互伙伴的适应响应极小，阻碍相互影响与共识形成。结果，影响保持短暂且无持久超级节点，社会因缺乏共享社会记忆而无法发展出稳定的集体影响锚点。这些发现表明，仅规模与交互密度不足以诱发社会化，为即将到来的下一代AI智能体社会提供可操作的设计与分析原则。
AI.summary: 本文以Moltbook为案例，首次大规模系统诊断AI智能体社会的演化。作者提出量化框架，发现系统虽快速全局语义稳定，但个体保持高多样性与持续词汇更替，缺乏相互适应与共识，导致影响短暂且无持久中心节点，最终无法形成社会化。研究指出规模与交互密度不足以致社会化，并为未来AI社会设计提供原则。
AI.keywords: AI智能体社会、社会化、Moltbook、语义稳定化、个体惯性、影响持续性、集体共识、共享记忆
AI.comments: 研究揭示AI社会缺乏共享记忆与适应机制是阻碍社会化关键，为后续引入记忆结构或激励机制提供方向。

title: DeepFusion: Accelerating MoE Training via Federated Knowledge Distillation from Heterogeneous Edge Devices
comments: Index Terms: Large language models, Mixture-of-experts, Federated knowledge distillation, Edge device heterogeneity
summary: Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based large language models (LLMs) such as Qwen-MoE and DeepSeek-MoE are transforming generative AI in natural language processing. However, these models require vast and diverse training data. Federated learning (FL) addresses this challenge by leveraging private data from heterogeneous edge devices for privacy-preserving MoE training. Nonetheless, traditional FL approaches require devices to host local MoE models, which is impractical for resource-constrained devices due to large model sizes. To address this, we propose DeepFusion, the first scalable federated MoE training framework that enables the fusion of heterogeneous on-device LLM knowledge via federated knowledge distillation, yielding a knowledge-abundant global MoE model. Specifically, DeepFusion features each device to independently configure and train an on-device LLM tailored to its own needs and hardware limitations. Furthermore, we propose a novel View-Aligned Attention (VAA) module that integrates multi-stage feature representations from the global MoE model to construct a predictive perspective aligned with on-device LLMs, thereby enabling effective cross-architecture knowledge distillation. By explicitly aligning predictive perspectives, VAA resolves the view-mismatch problem in traditional federated knowledge distillation, which arises from heterogeneity in model architectures and prediction behaviors between on-device LLMs and the global MoE model. Experiments with industry-level MoE models (Qwen-MoE and DeepSeek-MoE) and real-world datasets (medical and finance) demonstrate that DeepFusion achieves performance close to centralized MoE training. Compared with key federated MoE baselines, DeepFusion reduces communication costs by up to 71% and improves token perplexity by up to 5.28%.
comment: Index Terms: Large language models, Mixture-of-experts, Federated knowledge distillation, Edge device heterogeneity

AI.title_translation: DeepFusion：通过来自异构边缘设备的联邦知识蒸馏加速 MoE 训练
AI.tldr: 提出 DeepFusion 框架，用联邦知识蒸馏从异构小型边缘 LLM 中汇聚知识，训练出接近集中式性能的全局 MoE 模型，同时显著降低通信成本并提升困惑度表现。
AI.motivation: MoE 大模型需要海量多样数据，联邦学习可利用边缘设备私有数据进行隐私保护训练，但传统 FL 要求在设备上部署完整 MoE 模型，对资源受限设备不现实；此外，异构设备上的不同 LLM 架构导致联邦知识蒸馏存在“视角不匹配”问题，影响知识融合效果。
AI.method: 提出 DeepFusion 联邦 MoE 训练框架：允许每个边缘设备根据自身需求和硬件约束独立配置并训练本地 LLM，不强制使用统一 MoE；在服务器端维护一个全局 MoE 模型，通过联邦知识蒸馏从各设备 LLM 聚合知识；为解决跨架构蒸馏的“视角不匹配”，设计 View-Aligned Attention（VAA）模块，将全局 MoE 的多阶段特征融合成与设备 LLM 预测视角对齐的表征，实现更有效的跨架构知识迁移。
AI.result: 在工业级 MoE 模型（Qwen-MoE、DeepSeek-MoE）和真实医疗、金融数据集上的实验表明，DeepFusion 的性能接近集中式 MoE 训练；相较主要联邦 MoE 基线，通信开销最高降低 71%，token 困惑度最高提升 5.28%。
AI.conclusion: DeepFusion 证明了通过联邦知识蒸馏将异构边缘 LLM 知识融合到全局 MoE 模型中是可行且高效的，VAA 模块有效缓解了跨架构预测视角不一致的问题，使在资源受限设备上进行高性能隐私保护 MoE 训练成为可能。
AI.translation: 近期的基于专家混合（MoE）的大型语言模型（LLM），如 Qwen-MoE 和 DeepSeek-MoE，正在改变自然语言处理中的生成式 AI。然而，这些模型需要海量且多样的训练数据。联邦学习（FL）通过利用异构边缘设备上的私有数据，实现隐私保护的 MoE 训练，从而应对这一挑战。不过，传统 FL 方法要求设备本地托管 MoE 模型，由于模型规模庞大，这对资源受限设备而言并不现实。为了解决这一问题，我们提出 DeepFusion，这是首个可扩展的联邦 MoE 训练框架，它通过联邦知识蒸馏融合异构设备上 LLM 的知识，从而得到一个知识丰富的全局 MoE 模型。具体而言，DeepFusion 允许每个设备独立配置并训练一个符合其自身需求和硬件限制的本地 LLM。此外，我们提出一种新颖的视角对齐注意力（View-Aligned Attention, VAA）模块，将全局 MoE 模型的多阶段特征表示进行整合，以构建与本地 LLM 对齐的预测视角，从而实现有效的跨架构知识蒸馏。通过显式对齐预测视角，VAA 解决了传统联邦知识蒸馏中的视角不匹配问题，该问题源于本地 LLM 与全局 MoE 模型在模型架构和预测行为上的异构性。基于工业级 MoE 模型（Qwen-MoE 和 DeepSeek-MoE）以及真实世界数据集（医疗和金融）的实验表明，DeepFusion 可实现接近集中式 MoE 训练的性能。与关键的联邦 MoE 基线相比，DeepFusion 的通信成本最多降低 71%，token 困惑度最多提升 5.28%。
AI.summary: 本文提出 DeepFusion，一个面向 MoE 大模型的联邦训练框架。不同于要求边缘设备直接承载庞大 MoE 模型的传统 FL，DeepFusion 允许设备按自身算力与场景选择较小或架构各异的本地 LLM，在本地数据上训练后，通过联邦知识蒸馏将其知识汇聚到云端的全局 MoE 模型。为克服异构模型之间的预测视角差异，作者设计了 View-Aligned Attention 模块，从全局 MoE 的多层特征中构建与本地模型对齐的表示，实现跨架构蒸馏。实验显示，该方法在医疗和金融场景中接近集中式训练效果，并显著降低通信开销、改善困惑度。
AI.keywords: 专家混合, 大型语言模型, 联邦学习, 知识蒸馏, 异构边缘设备, View-Aligned Attention, 通信开销, 困惑度
AI.comments: 创新点在于将联邦知识蒸馏系统化用于 MoE 训练，并针对异构模型提出 VAA 以对齐预测视角，使资源受限设备仍能参与高质量 MoE 训练。局限性方面，抽象中未提及在极端低算力设备或高度不均衡数据分布下的鲁棒性，也未说明对延迟、设备掉线等实际联邦场景问题的处理。代码开源与否、隐私与安全性分析等在摘要中均未提及（Not mentioned in abstract）。

title: Floe: Federated Specialization for Real-Time LLM-SLM Inference
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in real-time systems remains challenging due to their substantial computational demands and privacy concerns. We propose Floe, a hybrid federated learning framework designed for latency-sensitive, resource-constrained environments. Floe combines a cloud-based black-box LLM with lightweight small language models (SLMs) on edge devices to enable low-latency, privacy-preserving inference. Personal data and fine-tuning remain on-device, while the cloud LLM contributes general knowledge without exposing proprietary weights. A heterogeneity-aware LoRA adaptation strategy enables efficient edge deployment across diverse hardware, and a logit-level fusion mechanism enables real-time coordination between edge and cloud models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Floe enhances user privacy and personalization. Moreover, it significantly improves model performance and reduces inference latency on edge devices under real-time constraints compared with baseline approaches.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems

AI.title_translation: Floe：面向实时LLM-SLM推理的联邦专用化方案

title: Benchmarking at the Edge of Comprehension
summary: As frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly saturate new benchmarks shortly after they are published, benchmarking itself is at a juncture: if frontier models keep improving, it will become increasingly hard for humans to generate discriminative tasks, provide accurate ground-truth answers, or evaluate complex solutions. If benchmarking becomes infeasible, our ability to measure any progress in AI is at stake. We refer to this scenario as the post-comprehension regime. In this work, we propose Critique-Resilient Benchmarking, an adversarial framework designed to compare models even when full human understanding is infeasible. Our technique relies on the notion of critique-resilient correctness: an answer is deemed correct if no adversary has convincingly proved otherwise. Unlike standard benchmarking, humans serve as bounded verifiers and focus on localized claims, which preserves evaluation integrity beyond full comprehension of the task. Using an itemized bipartite Bradley-Terry model, we jointly rank LLMs by their ability to solve challenging tasks and to generate difficult yet solvable questions. We showcase the effectiveness of our method in the mathematical domain across eight frontier LLMs, showing that the resulting scores are stable and correlate with external capability measures. Our framework reformulates benchmarking as an adversarial generation-evaluation game in which humans serve as final adjudicators.

AI.title_translation: 理解边缘的基准测试

title: Nonconforming virtual element methods for fourth-order nonlinear reaction-diffusion systems: a unified framework and analysis
summary: We develop a unified framework for the design and analysis of high-order nonconforming virtual element methods for nonlinear fourth-order reaction--diffusion problems in two dimensions, with emphasis on clamped, Navier, and Cahn--Hilliard-type boundary conditions. Time discretization is performed using the backward Euler scheme, while the spatial approximation relies on nonconforming virtual element spaces of arbitrary order $k \ge 2$, encompassing both $C^0$-nonconforming and Morley-type methods. A key contribution of this work is the development of a novel and rigorous unified error analysis for these numerical schemes, applicable to domains that are not necessarily convex, differing from the existing literature. By introducing a class of Companion operators, we construct novel Ritz-type projections and derive a new error equation that enables us to obtain optimal error estimates for the scheme under a minimal spatial regularity assumption on the weak solution. Finally, we present numerical experiments on polygonal meshes as applications of the proposed framework, including the extended Fisher--Kolmogorov equation, and a fourth-order model with Cahn--Hilliard-type boundary conditions, which validate the theoretical results and illustrate the performance of the method for the three classes of boundary conditions.

AI.title_translation: 四阶非线性反应-扩散系统的非协调虚拟元方法：统一框架与分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的非协调虚拟元框架，用于求解二维四阶非线性反应-扩散方程，涵盖Clamped、Navier与Cahn-Hilliard型边界条件，并给出适用于非凸区域的最小正则性最优误差估计。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对非凸区域上的四阶非线性反应-扩散问题缺乏统一的非协调虚拟元分析与误差估计，需要发展适用于一般区域、任意阶k≥2且包含多种边界条件的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用后向Euler时间离散，空间上构造任意阶k≥2的非协调虚拟元空间（含C^0非协调与Morley型），引入Companion算子构造Ritz型投影，建立新误差方程，在最小空间正则性假设下导出统一误差分析。
AI.result: 获得了适用于非凸区域的最优阶误差估计；数值实验验证了理论结果，展示了方法对Clamped、Navier及Cahn-Hilliard型边界条件的适用性与高精度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一框架填补了非凸区域四阶非线性反应-扩散问题非协调虚拟元分析的空白，为复杂几何与边界条件下的高阶数值模拟提供了可靠工具。
AI.translation: 我们发展了一个统一的框架，用于二维非线性四阶反应-扩散问题的高阶非协调虚拟元设计与分析，重点处理Clamped、Navier与Cahn-Hilliard型边界条件。时间离散采用后向Euler格式，空间离散采用任意阶k≥2的非协调虚拟元空间，涵盖C^0非协调与Morley型方法。本工作的核心贡献在于为这些数值格式提出了一种新颖且严格的统一误差分析，适用于不一定凸的区域，这与现有文献不同。通过引入一类Companion算子，我们构造了新的Ritz型投影并导出新的误差方程，从而在弱解的最小空间正则性假设下获得格式的最优误差估计。最后，我们给出了在多边网格上的数值实验作为所提框架的应用，包括扩展的Fisher-Kolmogorov方程与具有Cahn-Hilliard型边界条件的四阶模型，验证了理论结果并展示了该方法对三类边界条件的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对二维四阶非线性反应-扩散方程，提出一个统一的高阶非协调虚拟元框架，适用于Clamped、Navier与Cahn-Hilliard型边界条件，给出非凸区域上的最优误差估计，并通过数值实验验证理论。
AI.keywords: 虚拟元方法,非协调方法,四阶反应-扩散,非凸区域,误差分析,Companion算子,Ritz投影
AI.comments: 摘要清晰展示了理论贡献与实际验证，若能补充计算复杂度与并行实现细节将更完整。

title: Exploiting Structure-from-Motion for Robust Vision-Based Map Matching for Aircraft Surface Movement
comments: Accepted to the Proceedings of the 38th International Technical Meeting of the Satellite Division of The Institute of Navigation (ION GNSS+ 2025). 15 pages, 13 figures
summary: In this paper we introduce a vision-aided navigation (VAN) pipeline designed to support ground navigation of autonomous aircraft. The proposed algorithm combines the computational efficiency of indirect methods with the robustness of direct image-based techniques to enhance solution integrity. The pipeline starts by processing ground images (e.g., acquired by a taxiing aircraft) and relates them via a feature-based structure-from-motion (SfM) solution. A ground plane mosaic is then constructed via homography transforms and matched to satellite imagery using a sum of squares differences (SSD) of intensities. Experimental results reveal that drift within the SfM solution, similar to that observed in dead-reckoning systems, challenges the expected accuracy benefits of map-matching with a wide-baseline ground-plane mosaic. However, the proposed algorithm demonstrates key integrity features, such as the ability to identify registration anomalies and ambiguous matches. These characteristics of the pipeline can mitigate outlier behaviors and contribute toward a robust, certifiable solution for autonomous surface movement of aircraft.

title: The Baby Steps of the European Union Vulnerability Database: An Empirical Inquiry
summary: A new European Union Vulnerability Database (EUVD) was introduced via a legislative act in 2022. The paper examines empirically the meta-data content of the new EUVD. According to the results, actively exploited vulnerabilities archived to the EUVD have been rather severe, having had also high exploitation prediction scores. In both respects they have also surpassed vulnerabilities coordinated by European public authorities. Regarding the European authorities, the Spanish public authority has been particularly active. With the exceptions of Finland, Poland, and Slovakia, other authorities have not engaged thus far. Also the involvement of the European Union's own cyber security agency has been limited. These points notwithstanding, European coordination and archiving to the EUVD exhibit a strong growth trend. With these results, the paper makes an empirical contribution to the ongoing work for better understanding European cyber security governance and practice.
